zhes bya ba'i bar dang / gnas ma yin par yongs su rtogs pas/ sems can gang yang rung ba la sems rab tu sdang zhing ma dad pa/ yang dag par mi gnas—/ khro ba mi 'dor ba'i dus yod la/ de ltar yin dang las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos 'di ltar bslab par bya ste/sems can 'dis bdag la don ma yin pa byas so zhes bya ba nas/ bdag gi mi mdza' zhing yid du mi 'ong ba zhes bya ba'i bar dang / 'di la don byed par 'dod do zhes bya ba'i bar dang /① gang bdag gis de la rkyen med par mnar sems pa skyed par byed/ rab tu sdang ba'i sems kyis gnas par byed na/de lta na ni bdag nyid la bdag nyid don ma yin pa chen po skyed par byed par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs bcu thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad bdag la sangs rgyas kyi srun gyis gzigs par mdzad cing zhes bya ba nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la reg par mi 'gyur ro—/ /de ltar na bdag ni bdag nyid la mthong ba'i chos dang phyi ma la don ma yin pa chen po byed par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar de la ④las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mnar sems pa spong bar byed do/ /de ltar de la las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa dang ldan pa'i sems/ 'khon med pa/ 'gran zla med pa/ gnod pa med pa/spangs ④pa chen por gyur pa/ tshad med pa la legs par bsgoms ④pas phyogs gcig dhitu mos par byas te rdzogs par byas nas gnas so zhes bya ba'i bar dang /'og dang steng du byams pa dang ldan pa'i zhes bya ba'i bar dang / legs par bsgoms pas mos par byas te rdzogs par byas nas gnas kyi spyochags pa dang ldan 65—93

pas ma yin no zhes bya ba'i bar dang / rigs kyi bu 'di ni las dang po pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po'i sems can la dmigs pa'i byams pa—/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba ①thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa'o zhes bya ba gsungs so / /④rin po che'i ④phung po'i mdo las kyang / gang byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig byang chub sems dpa' la ④mnar sems pa'i busems bskyed pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mnar sems pa'i sems bubaskyed par 'gyur ro/ / sha ra dwa ④ti'i bu mtshams med pa lnga po las mtshams med pa gang yang rung ba zhig byas pa ni bla'i④/ byang chub sems dpa' la mnar sems pa'i sems bskyed pa ni ma yin pa nyid do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shā ri'i bu 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni byang chub sems dpa' las nges par byung ngo / /gal te byang chub sems dpa' sems can rnams la mnar sems pa'i sems bskyed na thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mi 'gyur ro/ /de ltar na byang chub kyi sems las byang chub sems dpa' byung zhing / byang chub sems dpa' las de bzhin gshegs pa byung ngo / /shā ri'i bu de'i phyir byang chub sems dpas/kye—/ byang chub sems dpa' la mnar sems pa'i sems bskyed par mi bya zhing / byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa' la brnyas par mi bya'o zhes gsungs so / /⑫snying rje chen po la 'jug pa'i mdo las kyang / dge slong mkhas pas ⑪tshul khrims ldan mthong nas/ /g.yo med par ni rtag tu bsnyen par bya/ /zhe sdang tha ba dag kyang rnam spangs te/ /dge slong chos smra rtag tu bsnyen par gyis/ /gnod sems khro ba dag kyang rnam spongs la/ /nga yi sras po chos skyong mchod par gyis/ /bskal pa bye ba mang por long ba dang /65—94

log par lhang zhing sdug bsngal gyur ta re/ /gcig la gcig kyang gnod sems byas na ni/ /de la tshul khrims thos pas skyob mi nus/ /bsam gtan mi skyob dgon sdeganas skyob mi nus/ /sbyin pas mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pas ②min/ /zhes gsungs so / /①nges pa dang ma nges pa la 'jug pa rtogs pa phyag rgya'i mdo las kyang / 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis—/ sdang ba'i sems kyis nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa dag gi ④zas dang gos bcad la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni/ khros te sdang ba'i sems kyis butheg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i zan gcig phrogs sam/ zan gcod du bcug na/ 'di rgo de bas ches sdig pa grangs med par ④bskyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'jam dpal 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims dang / bzod pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / bsam gtan dang / shes rab la sogs pa bskal pa bye ba grangs med pa nas/ yang dag par bsgrubs ⑦pa gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni rang gi sems kyi rgyud las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms par byed par zad kyi/ byang chub sems dpa' ni tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su skyes ⑧pa'i sems can la/ kham gcig tsam yongs su btang ⑨ba yang /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par 'gyur bar byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal yongs su brtag pa bzung ste ⑩rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis khros te sdang ba'i sems kyis/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dpag tu med grangs med pa dag gi ⑪tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 65—95

'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po med par byas la/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ①ni/ sdang ba'i sems kyis jeg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims tha na bslab pa gcig blangs pa tsam yang med par byas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa bskyed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po ni/ rang gi sems kyi rgyud las skyes pa'i nyon mongs pa rnams 'joms par byed par zad kyi/ 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' ni—/ tha na nyi ma gcig gi bslab pa gcig las byung ba'i tshul khrims kyi phung po dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi phung po dang / shes rab kyi phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i phung po dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung po thams cad ni/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa thams cad 'joms par byed pa nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi bar du thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis ⑤khros te gnod sems kyi sems kyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten rmi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad btson rar bcug la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni/ byang chub sems dpa' la khros te gnod sems kyi sems kyis 'di dang phrad par ma gyur cig ①ces rgyab kyis phyogs te 'dug na/'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed do④/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi 65—96

bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni/ khros te gnod sems kyi sems kyis byang chub sems dpa' la bltas na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed ①do//'jam dpal yongs su brtag pa bzung ste nan gyis ②dper byas na/ gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi mig phyung bar gyur la/ de nas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/byams pa'i sems kyis mig bskyed la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis ni theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la dga' ba'i sems kyis bltas na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa bskyed do zhes gsungs pa dang / yang mdo de ①nyid las kyang 'jam dpal theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gang la la zhig gis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad byang chub kyi sems la bkod la/ theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' gzhan zhig gis nirka/ theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rdzas med par tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'don du bcug na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed dudo/ /'jam dpal yongs su brtag pa bzung ste nan gyis dper byas na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can durnams—/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags rnams su skyes dhipar byas la/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis ni/65—97

byang chub sems dpa' gcig byang chub kyi sems las ①mos pa bzlog na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed ④do zhes gsungs so / /①dad pa'i stobs bskyed pa la 'jug pa'i mdo las kyang / 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byen pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ dge bsnyen ston pa gzhan la mi brten pa/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa gabyug la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bslab pa la bslabs pa yin no snyam nas/ nyin gcig zan gcig byen na 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ④do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du dge bsnyen ston pa gzhan la mi brten pa dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang ldan pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis/ dge slong gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed zudo/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa rgya mtsho gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi dge slong dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa 65—98

byin pa ①bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ dad pas rjes su 'brang meb gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig ④byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten byi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi dad pas rjes su 'brang bub dag la—/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan zhig gis/ chos kyis rju rjes su 'brang ba du gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ④do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi chos kyis durjes su 'brang ba dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas—/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis brgyad pa gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ de ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ⑨ do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi brgyad pa la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ rgyun du zhugs pa gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod 65—99

nams grangs med pa skyed ①do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rgyun du zhugs pa dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ lan cig ④phyir 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/de ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ①do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten kyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi lan cig phyir 'ong ba dag la nyin gcig ④bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ phyir mi 'ong ba gcig la nyin gcig ⑤zan gabyug yibyin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi ④rdul snyed kyi phyir mi 'ong ba dag ④la nyin gcig ⑨bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ dgra bcom pa gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ de ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ⑫do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul 65—100

snyed kyi dgra bcom pa dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byen pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ rang sangs rgyas gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ①do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi rang sdesangs rgyas dag la nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byen pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/sangs rgyas ri mor bris pa'am gzugs su byas pa mthong na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed de①/ thal mo sbyar ba'am/ me tog gam/bdug pa'am/ spos sam/ mar me 'bul ba lta ci smos te/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ④do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa phul ba dang / de bzhin du lha'i na bza' rnams phul ba bas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan ⑤gang zhig gis/ tha na phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa gcig la/ sangs rgyas la skyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung ba yongs su 'dzin te/ tha na nyin gcig zan gcig byin na yang / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed 65—101

do—/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ ra'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la—/ sangs rgyas la skyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung ba yongs su 'dzin te/tha na nyin gcig rmye zan gcig byin na yang / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed 3do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ glang po che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan ④gang zhig gis/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la/ sangs rgyas la skyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ci yang rung ba yongs su 'dzin te/ tha na nyin gcig zan gcig byin na yang / 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ④do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ zla ba dang nyi ma'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i 65—102

gos rnams sbyin pa byen pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo ①gang la la ⑤zhig gis/ nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ①do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la/ nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang ④zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la/ nyin gcig zan gcig byin na/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed ⑤do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ bskal pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed dag la/nyin gcig bzhin du lha'i zas ro brgya dang ldan pa byin pa dang / de bzhin du lha'i gos rnams sbyin pa byin pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di yi ger 'dri ba dang /yi ger 'drir 'jug pa dang / klog pa 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams grangs med pa skyed budo/ /bzlog ste/ bste stang ma byas pa'i mi dge ba'i las kyang de bzhin du brjod par bya'o/ /phyugs kyi shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / ra'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / glang bo che'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / nyi 65—103

ma dang zla ba'i shing rta lta bus 'gro ba dang / nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'ang de bzhin te/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi/ nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis ①'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams kyi bar chad byas pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' gcig la/ tha na dud 'gro'i skye gnas su gtogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bar chad byed cing / khro ba dang brnyas pa'i sems skyed sden/ 'di ni de bas ches bsod nams ma yin pa grangs med pa skyed ①do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul snyed kyi sems can thams cad kyi ④mig phyung nas bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis / byang chub sems dpa' la rkyen ci yang rung bas brnyas pa'i sems skyed bude / gshe ba dang / mi snyan par smra ba dang / rnyog ⑥par byed pa na/ de bas ches sdig pa mang du skyed ⑦do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ byang chub sems dpa' la rkyen ci yang rung bas brnyas pa skyed byede spyos na⑨/ de mi dge ba'i las des sems can dmyal ba ngu 'bod chen por lus dpag tshad lnga brgya par skye bar 'gyur te/ de la mgo lnga brgya yod par 'gyur ro/ /de'i mgo re re la yang kha lnga brgya lnga brgya yod par 'gyur/de'i kha re re la yang lce lnga brgya lnga brgya yod par 'gyur te/ lce re re la yang gshol lnga brgya lnga brgyas rmo bar 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am 65—104

rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su skyes pa'i sems can thams cad la dbyig pa dang mtshon kyis bsnun te bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/ byang chub sems dpa' la brnyas pa'i sems bskyed nas①/khro ba dang / gnod sems dang / tha ba dang khros pa'i sems skyed ②na/'di ni de bas ches sdog pa grangs med pa skyed ④do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ sdang ba'i sems kyis sems can rnams la gnod par 'dod cing / 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag la/ 'jig rten gyi khams re re dang / gling re re nabu/ dgra bcom pa gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag gi srog gcad dupa dang / rin po che'i mchod rten rin po che'i stegs bus yongs su bskor cing / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan ⑥btsugs pa gang shā'i klung gi bye ma snyed bshig ④pa bas/ 'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gzhan gang zhig gis/theg pa chen po la mos pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa chen po nyid la sgo btags te/ brnyas pa'i sems bskyed nas/ rkyen ⑧cis kyang rung bas/khro ba dang / gshe ba dang / mi snyan par zer ba dang / khyad du gsod par byed na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed ⑨do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' las de bzhin gshegs pa nges par 'byung ba'i phyir te/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs gcod pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin no/ /gang byang chub sems dpa' la skur pa des chos spangs pa ⑩yin no/ /chos kyang gzhan la/ chos yongs su 'dzin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' yang gzhan ma yin 65—105

te—/ byang chub sems dpa' nyid chos so/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig khros nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can thams cad btson ra mun nag dag tu ①btsud pa bas/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la khros te/ byang chub sems dpa' la rgyab kyis gruphyogs shing 'dug nas/ ma rungs pa 'di ni mi blta'o zhes zer na/'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed a+yo/do/ /'jam dpal rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad kyi bdog pa thams cad phrogs pa bas/ gzhan gang zhig gis byang chub sems dpa' ji lta bu yang rung ba la smad na/ 'di ni de bas ches sdig pa grangs med pa skyed ④do zhes gsungs so / / phyezhal ta byed pa la dgongs pa bstan pa/ nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las kyang /de nas bcom ldan 'das la rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to—/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das zhal ta ba zhes bgyi ba lags na/ bcom ldan 'das ji tsam gyis na zhal ta bar gdags par mdzad pa lags⑥/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po dge slong gnyis zhal ta bar ngas gnang ngo / /gnyis tshugang zhe na/ gang yang rnam par thar pa brgyad la bsgom 5pa'i dgra bcom pa dang / gang yang dge slong slob pa rgyun du zhugs pa yin te/ rgyal po chen po dge slong 'di gnyis zhal ta byed pa'i las byed par ngas gnang ngo zhes gsungs so / /⑨'od srungs kyis zhus pa'i mdo las kyang /de nas bcom ldan 'das la/ tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs kyis 'di skad ces 65—106

gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong ji lta bus zhal ta bgyi ba lags/bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'od srungs ngas ①zhal ta bya bar gnang ba'i dge slong gnyis te/ gnyis gang zhe na/ dge slong yongs su dag pa 'jig rten gyi khams pha rol du kha na ma tho bas 'jigs par lta ba las kyi rnam par smin pa la rton ②pas/ 'dzem pa dang ldan zhing 'gyod pa dang ldan pa dang /gang yang zag pa zad pa/ dgra bcom par gyur pa ste/ 'od srungs dge slong ma nyams pa 'di gnyis zhal ta byed par ngas gnang ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/'od srungs legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba 'di la/ rigs sna tshogs las rab tu byung ba/ sems kyi mos pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa spong ba'i phyir rnal 'byor sna tshogs la gnas pa/ kha cig ni dgon pa bas mtha'i mal stan la mngon par dga' ba/ kha cig ni bsod snyoms pa/ kha cig ni grong 'dab na gnas pa/ kha cig ni 'tsho ba yongs su dag pa/ kha cig ni mang du thos pa la mngon par brtson pa/ kha cig ni chos smra ba/ kha cig ni 'dul ba 'dzin pa/kha cig ni ma mo 'dzin pa/ kha cig ni grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / yul 'khor dang / pho brang 'khor dag tu zhugs nas chos ston pa ste—/ sems can gzhan dag gi sems kyi spyod pa rnams bsrung dka' ba'i phyir ro—/ /'od srungs de la dge slong ①zhal ta byed pas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad kyi sems mgu bar bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong dgon pa bas mtha'i mal stan gang yin pa de dag ni dge slong zhal ta byed pas las su bsgo rjobar mi bya'o/ /zhal ta byed pas dge slong dgon pa pa de dag bsrung bar bya ste/ dus ma yin par gsol bar mi bya/ dus ma yin par gtang khru 65—107

bar mi bya'o/ /'od srungs gal te dge slong dgon pa pa la dge 'dun kyi bya bar gtogs pa slob ①pa'i las res bab na/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa des las bdag nyid kyis bya'o/ /yang na dge slong gzhan zhig bskos pa ②la las de ①byed du gzhug ste/ dge slong dgon pa pa la gnod par mi bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong bsod snyoms spyod pa gang yin pa de la/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa des kha zas bsod pa bgo bsha' bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa gang yin pa de dag la dge slong zhal ta byed pas ④mthun pa'i 'tshog chas dang / na ba'i gsos sman dang / yo byad rnams sbyin par bya'o—/ /dge slong rnal 'byor spyod pa de sa byaphyogs gang la gnas pa'i sa phyogs der—/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa des sgra chen po dang skad drag po mi dbyung zhing byed du yang mi gzhug go/ /dge slong zhal ta byed pas dge slong rnal 'byor rjospyod pa de bsrung zhing mal cha yang sbyar bar bya'o/ /kha zas bsod pa dang /yi gar 'ong ba dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa'i sa dang mthun pa'i bza' ba dang /bca' ba rnams sbyin par bya'o/ /dge slong de la dge slong 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa ston pa'i phyir gnas pa yin te/ de la bdag gis ⑦rjes su mthun pa'i yo byad thams cad mang du sbyar bar bya'o snyam du shin tu phangs ⑧pa'i 'du shes bskyed par bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong mang du thos pa la mngon par brtson pa gang yin pa de dag la dge slong zhal ta byed pas lung nos ⑨shig /lhogs shig /kha ton gyis shig /kho bo ni khyod kyi rim gro byed pa yin gyis/ khyod ji lta ji lta bur mang du thos par gyur pa de lta de lta bur/dge slong gi dge 'dun mdzes par 'gyur bar ⑩gyis shig /'dul ba brjod 65—108

pas mdzes par gyis shig /bdag nyid kyi shes rab kyang mchog tu 'gyur bar kyis shig ces spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong zhal ta byed pas de dag dus ma yin par gtang bar mi bya/ las su bsgo bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong zhal ta byed pa des dge slong mang du thos pa de dag bsrung bar bya'o/ /'od srungs de la chos smra ba'i dge slong gang yin pa de dag dge slong zhal ta byed pas las su bsgo bar mi ①bya'o/ /grong dang grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang yul 'khor dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dag tu 'jug tu bcug la chos 'chad du gzhug go/ /chos nyan pa dag bsgo bar bya'o/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag par bya'o/ /'bel ba'i chos kyi gtam gyi phyir dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya'o/ /chos smra ba'i dge slong la dge slong gang dag gnod par byed pa'i dge slong de dag dge slong zhal ta byed pas bzlog par bya'o/ /dge slong zhal ta byed pas chos smra ba'i dge slong la rtag tu bsu bar bya④/ legs so zhes bya ba mang du bya'o/ /'od srungs de la dge slong gang dag 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin par gyur pa de dag gi gan du dge slong zhal ta byed pa de ①song la/ ji ltar na bdag rma med cing ma nyams pa dang ④/ ji ltar na bdag rtsang ba med pa'i chos kyi zhal ta bya zhes yongs su dri bar bya'o/ /de nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong de dag gis dge slong zhal ta byed pa'i bsam pa rig nas de'i bya ba dang / 'byung ba gang yin pa dang / byed pa gang yin pa de bstan par bya'o/ /dge slong zhal ta byed pas—/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa dang / ma mo 'dzin pa'i dge slong de dag la phangs par bya ba dang / dad pa dang gus pa dang / zhe sa rab tu bskyed par 65—109

bya'o—/ /dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa gang yin pa de dag dge slong zhal ta byed pas/dus dus su dge slong gi dge 'dun la 'bul ①bar bya'i/ dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa bsags shing sba bar mi bya ste/ ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du sbyin par bya/ ma bskul bar sbyin par bya/ gnod pa med par sbyin par bya'o/ /des 'dun pa dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / 'jigs pas 'gro bar mi bya'o/ /dge slong gi dge 'dun la rton par bya'i ④/ khyim pa'i phyogs la rton par mi bya'o—/ /dge 'dun gyi bya ba la rton par bya'i/ bdag dga' bar bya ba la rton par mi bya'o/ /dngos po gang la yang dbang bya ba'i 'du shes bskyed par mi bya'i/ bya ba ji tsam du chung ba yang dge 'dun gyi gros bzhin du ④bya zhing /rang dgar mi bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi'am/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi'am/mchod rten kyi yo byad gang ci yang rung ste/ ji lta ba bzhin du gzhag dupar bya ste/dge 'dun kyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi dang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa yang ⑤dge 'dun gyi dang bsre bar mi bya'o/ /dge 'dun gyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa mchod rten gyi dang ⑥bsre bar mi bya'o/ /mchod rten gyi rnyed pa yang dge 'dun gyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gye rnyed pa ④bsre bar mi bya'o/ /gal te phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la byel phongs su gyur la/ dge 'dun gye rnyed pa che bar gyur na/ dge slong zhal ta byed pas dge slong gi dge 'dun bsdus la gros mthun par bkyis dhite/dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa las/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la bshug ⑨par bya'o/ /gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten zhig ral du gyur la/ dge 'dun gyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa che bar gyur na/ dge slong zhal ta 65—110

byed pas/ dge slong gi dge 'dun thams cad bsdus la/ gros mthun par bgyis te/ 'di skad ces de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'di ni zhig ral du gyur la/ dge 'dun gyi dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa ni che bar gyur na/ gal te tshe dang ldan pa rnams gnod pa med cing dad pa dang ldan la bzod cing gnang na/ bdag gis ①dge 'dun gyi dang phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gye rnyed pa 'di las dngos po cung zad cig khyer te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten bcos par bya'o zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gal te dge 'dun gyis ②gnang na/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa des de bzhin du bya'o/ /ji ste dge 'dun gyis ④ma gnang na/ dge slong zhal ta byed pa des sbyin pa po dang /sbyin bdag la gsol ba thob la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gso bar bya'o—/ /'od srungs gal te mchod rten gyi rnyed pa ji ltar mang du gyur du zin kyang dge slong ④zhal ta byed pas dge 'dun dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun la bshug par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dad cing dang ba mang po dag gis mchod rten la phul ba ni/ tha na ras kyi kha tshar gcig ⑤tsam gang yin pa de yang lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod rten yin na/ rin po che'am/rin po cher smos pa dag lta smos kyang ci dgos/ mchod rten la gos phul ba gang yin pa de ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten de nyid du rlung dang / nyi ma dang / char pas rjodengs kyang bla'i⑦/ mchod rten la phul ba'i gos dbyig gam—/ dbyig gi rin du bsgyur bar mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ mchod rten gyi ni rin thang du cung zad kyang med la/ mchod rten ni cis kyang byel ④ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pas de ltar yongs su 65—111

dag par bya ste/ des dkon mchog gsum gyi dang ma 'bags par bya'o/ /bdag gi rnyed pas chog shes par bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs tūpa'i dngos po rnams la bdag gir 'du shes mi bya'o/ /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pa rab tu sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa gang la la zhig gis tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/ sbyin gnas rnams la sems khros sam/ dbang byed cing bsgo blag byed na/ de mi dge ba'i las des sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi'i 'jig rten du 'ongs tshun yang bran dang gzhan gyi las byed par 'gyur ba dang / khu tshur dang /thal lcag dang / lag cha bsnyems pas brdegs pa dang phrad par 'gyur ro/ /'od srungs gzhan yang gal te dge slong zhal ta byed pa dge 'dun gyi bya ba las 'das te/ rang dgar dge slong rnams la dbang byed cing bsgo ba dang /chad pas gcod pa dang / 'jigs par byed pa dang / basprugs pa dang /dus ma yin par brdeg byepa dang / dus ma yin par bsgo ④bar byed na/ de mi dge ba'i las des nyi tshe ba'i sems can dmyal ba phur pa mang po zhes bya ba der skye bar 'gyur te/ der skyes nas lus la lcags phur brgya stong zug cing de dag 'bar/ rab tu 'bar la/ kun du rab tu 'bar ba mched cing 'bar bar 'gyur ro/ /des tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/sbyin pa'i gnas rnams la bsdegs shing / ngag gi las gdug pa smras par gyur pa gang yin pa des der skyes nas/ lce'i dbang po'i khyon dpag tshad brgya par 'gyur zhing / de'i lce'i dbang po de la lcags phur brgya stong rab tu 'bab cing /de dag kyang 'bar rab tu 'bar kun tu rab tu 'bar la/ kun du rab tu 65—112

mched cing 'bar te/ mer 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des bsdigs shing ngag gi las gdug par smra bar gyur ①pa'i phyir ro/ /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pa gang la las dge 'dun gyi rnyed pa 'dus shing 'dus pa gzhag ④ste/ dus dus su mi sbyin zhing / mtho ①btsams la gtses nas sbyin pa dang / kha cig byinadu/ kha cig ma byin/ kha cig la byin la⑤/ kha cig la ma byin na/ de dumi dge ba'i las des yi dwags kyi skye gnas rkyag ⑦'jim byen pa nub ces bya ba der skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de der skyes nas yi dwags gzhan gyi ⑧kha zas blangs te/ de la bstan na de bstan pa'i tshe mig mi 'dzums par zas de ⑨blta zhing bkres pa dang / skom ⑫pas nyen pa'i sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba myong gi/lo brgya stong du yang zas de thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ste brgya la brgya lam na zas de thob kyang / ngan sgyugs dang rnag khrag tu 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar des ⑪tshul khrims dang ldan pa/ yon tan dang ldan pa/sbyin gnas rnams mgu bar ma byas shing / rang gi rnyed pas chog mi shes par gyur ⑩pa'i phyir ro/ /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pa gang la las dge 'dun gyi'am/ phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi'am/ mchod rten gyi 'chol bar byas na/ de'i rnam par smin pa ni ngas bskal par bgrangs pas kyang brjod kyis mi lang ngo / /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pa gang la las nyes dmigs kyi gnas 'di lta bu 'di dag thos nas/ khro ba'am/ gshe ba'am⑫/gnod par sems shing / khong khro ba skyed na/ de ni gsor mi rung ngo zhes ngas bshad do/ /'od srungs de lta bas na dam pa'i chos 'di lta bu ⑫thos nas/dge slong zhal ta byed pas lus dang ngag dang / yid yongs su dag par bya'o/ /65—113

bdag dang gzhan bsrung bar bya'o/ /'od srungs dge slong zhal ta byed pa rang gi sha la za yang bla'i/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i lhung bzed dam/ chos ①gos sam/ na ba'i gsos sman nam/ yo byad yongs su spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa 'od srungs chen pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ②lhod pa rnams kyi ①lhod pa'i chos dang / 'dzem dog mchis pa rnams kyi ④'dzem dog gi ⑤chos rnams bka' byed to zhes gsungs so/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa bskul ba'i mdo las kyang / de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' gang dag chos kyi mchog yongs su spangs nas/ las ngan pa rtsom pa de dag ni shes rab shin tu chung zhing / shes rab kyis ⑥dman par 'gyur ba lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po byams pa la 'di skad ces bka' byed to/ /byams pa de de bzhin te/ de de bzhin no/ / ji skad smras pa de bzhin te/khyobyang chub sems dpa' gang dag gis 3chos kyi mchog yongs su spangs nas las ngan pa rtsom pa de dag ni/ shes rab shin tu chung zhing shes rab kyis ⑨dman par 'gyur ba yin no/ /byams pa gzhan yang khyod mos par bya'o/ /khyod kyis ④khong du chud par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag la sbyor ba med cing /bsam gtan med la spong ba med cing 'don pa med pa dang / mang du thos pa yongs su tshol ⑨ba med pa de dag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa la rab tu byung ba ma yin no/ /byams pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa ni bsam 65—114

gtan dang spong bas phye ①ba dang / ye shes kyis 'dus byas pa dang / ye shes kyis mnyam par gzhag ①pa dang / brtson pas phye ba yin gyes/ khyim pa'i las dang zhal ta byed pas phye ba ni ma yin te/ 'di ltar zhal ta byed pa'i las de ni mi rigs ①pa la sbyor ba rnams dang / 'du byed la mngon par dga' ba rnams dang / 'jig rten pa'i bya bas sbags pa ste/ byang chub sems dpas de la 'dod pa bskyed dupar mi bya'o/ /byams pa gal te byang chub sems dpa' zhal ta byed pa la brtson pas/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten dag gis/stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di bkang na ⑤des ni nga mnyes par byas pa ma yin/ ri mor byas pa ma yin/ bkur ster byas pa ma yin gyidu/ byams pa gal te byang chub sems dpa' tha na pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang ldan pa'i tshig bzhi pa'i tshigs su bcad pa gcig tsam 'dzin tam/ rachang ngam—/ klog gam/ kun chub par byed dam 'chad pa de ni nga la bkur ster byas—/ bla mar byas/ ri mor byas/ mchod par byas par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byams pa de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi byang chub ni mang du thos pa las byung ba yin gyi④/ dngos po yongs su 'dzin pa las byung ba ni ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /byams pa gal te byang chub sems dpa' zhal ta byed pa la brtson pas/ byang chub sems dpa' lung nod pa dang / kha ton byed pa la brtson pa zhal ta byed pa'i sbags pas sbags par byed na/ bsod nams 'dod pa des ni④/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po chen po bskyed par 'gyur te/las kyi sgrib pa yang yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/bsod nams bya ba'i gzhi ⑨gsum po gang yin pa de dag ni shes rab las byung 65—115

ba'i phyir ro/ /byams pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' zhal ta byed pa la brtson pas/ byang chub sems dpa' lung nod pa ①dang / kha ton byed pa la brtson pa'i bar chad mi bya'o/ /'dzam ②bu'i gling 'di ①zhal ta byed pas yongs su gang bar gyur pa'i zhal ta byed pa de dag thams cad ni byang chub sems dpa' ④lung nod pa dang / kha ton byed pa la brtson pa gcig la/ rim gro dang bsnyen bkur bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /bden pa'i rnam pa'i mdo las kyang / /de la byang chub sems dpa'i zhal ta gang zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten dang / chos nyan pa dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon rnams la snyom ⑤las rnged pa dang / ltos ⑪pa med pas zhal ta byed pa'i bya ba la bya'o/ /shā ri'i bu byang chub sems dpa' gang la las tha na legs so zhes bya ba yang re bas zhal ta de mi bya/ de lta bu'i ngo bos zhal ta mi bya ste/ 'di ni zhal ta shes pa zhes bya'o zhes gsungs so/ /yongs su 'dzin pa la dgongs ④pa bstan pa/ ji lta bu zhig gi mdo las kyang / mod gal gyi bus gsol pa/ btsun pa dge slong gang la la zhig skyes bu gang zag brgyad kyi zhing la phul ba dang / phyogs bzhi'i dge 'dun chen po'i dkor gyis dādor ba dang / rgyal po'i khol po dang / sna chen po la gtogs pa dang / mdun na 'don ⑨dang / blon po dang / smad 'tshong ma mchog dang /rgyal po dang / btsun mo dam pa la brten nas/ bsod nams ⑩brgya phrag stong la dbang byed pa ⑫dang 'dra ⑫ba'i las gsar pa ⑫rtsom pa chen pos byed pa dang / thabs log pa de nyid kyis ⑫phyis ltung ba dang bcas par 'gyur ba des⑫/65—116

bsod nams ma yin pa ci 'dra ba zhig bskyed par bgyi①/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ dge sbyong dor ba/ gdug pa la brten pa srid pa'i khol po—/ 'khor ba rgyas par byed pa/ nyon mongs pa dang nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i dri mas sbags pa②/ slob dpon ltar snang bas dbang bskur ba/ byis pa mchil snabs 'phyag cing kha 'phro za ba rnams kyis rngubaskor ba de ni/ rma bya'i 'bag lta bus srin bu'i ④ras kha bsgyur ba'i gos dang / rams kyis kha bsgyur ba'i sha ⑤'gag dang / bkra ba dang nye bar bkra ba'i lham gyon nas/ bal mchog gi 'bol stan la gnas gnas bute/ dge slong des pa ④la smod cing 'dri/gshe ba dang / spyo ba dang sdigs mdzub dag gis gnas nas 'byin par byed/de dag la sngon du 'ong ba dang / rjes su 'brang ba dang / ldang ba dang /thal mo sbyar ba'i las 'dud pa'i phyag gis bka' bsgo zhing / chu mchog dang zas mchog dang / mal stan mchog yongs su longs spyod pas/ ④mtshams med pa dang nye bar 'dra ba'i sdig pa ches shin tu sogs rmyepar 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar gtsang sbra 'dod pa rnams kyis ⑩bdag gi lus dang / gos brlag par ma gyur cig snyam nas/ bshang gci ⑩ring du spong bar byed la/ de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sras po zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims kyi gtsang sbra 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang /de lta bu'i gang zag mthong nas/ lung dang rtogs pa'i chos kyi longs spyod gnyis las ring du byed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyud ma lta bur gyur pa ⑩rtag par mi dge ba byed pa/ shing dang lteng ka bskams pa dang 'dra ba/ dam pa'i chos kyi ljon shing gi bcud zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims 'joms pa/ lus zangs kyi gos kyis g.yogs pa/ lcags kyi gong bu 'bar ba za ba/ bdag nyid kyi khrag 65—117

khol ma 'thung ba/ mi ma rabs lo ma rul ba lta bu sgra snyan pa nyams pa'i dung gi skad ltar kun du spyod pa/ bdag dang gzhan rnam par 'joms pa ni/mthar gnas ltar rnal 'byor pas yongs su spong bar byed do/ /mod gal gyi bus gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das des bskal pa brgyad cur mnar med pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar bya dgos so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/mod gal gyi bu de de bzhin te/ bar gyi bskal pa brgyad cur bsdams ①pa bskal pa chen po der dge 'dun 'du ba'i sgo 'phrogs pa des ②der sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /las kyi zas can du 'gyur zhing / de'i lus bcu 'gyur dang / de gzhon sha chags pas mar sar dang ras bal gyi 'da' ba ④lta bu dang / tshor ba bcu 'gyur du rnam par chad pa med par gnad thams cad gcod pa'i sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur ro/ /las byas shing bsags pa de zhig cing bsal ba nyams par gyur pa/ yongs su zad par gyur gyi ④bar du kun nas 'bar ba rab tu 'bar ba/ yang dag par rab tu 'bar ba/ rgya skyegs kyi kha dog lta bur 'bar ba gcig tu gyur par ⑤'tshed do/ /de nas shi 'phos te skyo sdig pa'i bag chags kyi rgyu mthun pa'i 'bras bus/ gung dang / byi la dang / seng ge dang / stag dang / spyang ki'i mngal du snyig to can 'tshed par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der yang sngar ⑦sdig pa spyod cing des mun pa nas mun par 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las kyang /da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ nga'i bstan pa 'di dang / dam pa'i chos sam—/ dam pa'i chos kyi gzugs brnyan yun ji srid gnas par/ chos kyis ④gnas pa'i dge slong rnams la khyim dang kun dga' ra ba ⑫dang / zhing 65—118

dang bran dang / bran mo'i bar gang su dag gis de ltar bsngos dhipa de la/sdig pa spyod pa'i dge slong tshul khrims 'chal pa gang dag tha na 'dab ma gcig dang / 'bras bu gcig dang / me tog gcig cig yongs su spyod pa dag tu byed na—/ de ni mi blun po de la don ma yin pa dang / phan pa ma yin par 'gyur te/de la ①gnod pa bzhi yang 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na/ phyogs thams cad du mi snyan pa chen por ①'gro ba yin/ mdza' bo dang / nye du dang /snag gi gnyen mtshams dang / mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / rim gro pa dang sdug cing yid du 'ong ba dang myur du 'bral bar 'gyur ba yin/ nad tshabs chen po ④yun ring ba dag gis ⑤thebs par 'gyur ba yin④/ de'i chos gos dang / lhung bzed gang yod pa de yang 'jigs pa chen po lngas phrogs par 'gyur ba yin no/ /lnga gang dag gis she ④na/ 'di lta ste/ rgyal po dang /chom rkun dang / me dang chu dang / bgo skal la spyod pa'i mi mdza' ba dang lnga po ④de dag gis so/ /de'i 'jig rten pha rol gyi 'dod pa ma yin pa'i 'bras bu bzhi myur du 'grub par 'gyur ba yin te/ bzhi gang dag yin zhe na/ lus zhig nas sems can dmyal ba chen po mi bzad par skye bar 'gyur ba yin te④/gal te brgya la res 'ga' zhig dus ring zhig 'das nas/ sems can dmyal ba chen po de nas shi 'phos nas/ 'brog dgon pa ro skam gyi nang du/ dud 'gro dang / yi dwags kyi rigs su long ba dang / rkang lag med pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur zhing / de lo brgya stong mang po dag tu bkres pa dang / skom pas ⑪yongs su gdung ba chen po'i sdug bsngal nyams su stsong bar 'gyur ba yin/gal te brgya la res 'ga' zhig dus ring zhig 'das nas/ de nas shi 'phos 65—119

nas—/ lo brgya stong mang po dag tu sbrul gdug pa/ long ba rdul za ba dag gi nang du skye bar 'gyur ba yin/ de brgya la res 'ga' zhig de nas shi 'phos nas—/ gal te mi rnams kyi nang du skyes na①/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa stong pa dag tu/ mi nyid 'thob pa rnyed par 'gyur zhing /mong rtul ba dang tshul 'di mi shes par 'gyur ba dang / mig ma tshang ba dang /lag pa ma tshang ba dang / rkang pa ma tshang ba dang / khyi'i ②longs spyod kyi kha zas la gdu zhing / rkyag khung pa'i ①kha zas la za ba dang / 'dam rdzab dang /phyag dar khrod na gnas pa dang / 'brog dgon pa dang / lam po che rnams na 'tsho bar 'gyur la/ de de nas shi 'phos nas kyang yang sems can dmyal ba rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de'i 'bras bu 'dod pa ma yin te/ de ltar lci bar 'byung zhe na/ 'di ltar sdig pa spyod pa'i dge slong de ni/ 'di ltar chos kyis ④gnas pa rnams la khyim dang zhing dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / bran dang bran mo dang / phyugs dag gi bar yedag phrogs nas/ gang zag rang gi yongs su spyod pa la longs spyod par byed pa'i phyir te/ sdig pa spyod pa'i dge slong de lta bu de ni/ de ltar ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba thams cad kyi chos kyi ⑥tshul med par bya ba dang / rnam par gzhig pa dang / rgyun gcad ④pa dang / nub par bya ba'i phyir brtson pa yin no/ /de bzhin du dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung med par bya ba nas/ nub par bya ba'i bar du brtson pa yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar dge ba'i phyogs ni tshogs pa dang ldan pa yin la/ chos kyi tshul dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yang dge ba'i phyogs kyis rab tu 65—120

phye ba yin te/ de'i phyir ①nyid kyi mi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ④phyi ba mngon par 'grub pa yin no/ /de nas gnas brtan ga ya 'od srungs kyis ①mchi ma blags nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mi nyid rnyed pa ni ma thob ④kyang bla'i/ rab tu byung nas bza' ba dang btung ba'i slad du log par sgrub pa ni de lta ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ ga ya 'od srungs chen po de de bzhin no/ /ji skad smras pa de bzhin te—/ gong du de'i sngon gyi las rnams zad pa spyedag tu 'gyur ba'i sems can dmyal bar gnas pa ni bla'i/ 'di na ⑥gang gzhan du spyod pa ni de lta ma yin no//'on kyang skyes bu blun po kha cig mi nyid 'thob par dka' ba rnyed de/ legs par gsungs pa'i chos 'dul ba gang la sdug bsngal thams cad zad pa dang /zag pa thams cad mthar thug par 'gyur ba'i ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i rab tu byung ba rnyed par dka' ba dang / bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po thob nas/ 'on kyang skyes bu blun po gang gis mchod par mi 'gyur ba dang /bza' btung dang bral bar 'gyur la/ mi dge ba'i phyogs rnal 'byor yid la byed pa yongs su bsal nas rgyal rigs dang / bram ze'i rigs ④dang /rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dad pa can dag gis ④khyim dang zhing dang /kun dga' ra ba dang / skyed mos tshal dang / bran dang bran mo dang /rkang bzhi pa dag gi ⑨bar dge slong chos kyis ⑩ gnas pa/ yon tan gyis phyug pa dag longs spyad par bya ba'i phyir dang / dge ba'i phyogs dang mthun par bya ba'i phyir de ltar bsngos pa la/ sdog pa spyod pa'i dge slong de mang du thos pa'i mthu'amaske/ khyim na gnas pa'i mthus de dag la bsngos pa'i longs spyod dang nye 65—121

bar spyod pa phrogs nas/ bdag nyid kyis gang zag gi 'du shes kyis ①yongs su spyod par byed de/ skyes bu blun po de'i log par sgrub pa de ni de lta bur 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /yang mdo de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ rgyal po chen po legs so legs so/ /khyod kyis ①spobs pa legs so/ /rgyal po chen po ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ gang dag rgyal rigs dang /bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dag chos kyis ①gnas pa rnams la/ khyim kyi gzhi dang / zhing gi gzhi dang / kun dga' ra ba'i gzhi dang / skyed mos tshal dang / bran dang bran mo dang / mal cha dang stan dang / na ba'i gso ④sman dang / yo byad dag de lta de ltar bsngos pa dang /rkang bzhi pa'i bar bsngos pa yang / 'phrog par byed pa'am/ rku bar byed pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ rgyal rigs nas dmangs rigs kyi bar de dag thams cad ni mthong ba'i chos la 'byung bar ⑤ 'dod pa ma yin pa'i chos nyi shu dang myur du ldan par 'gyur ro/ /nyi shu gang dag ce ④na/ lha rnams kyis ⑦yongs su btang ba yin/ phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag tu yang de'i mi snyan pa grags par 'gyur ba yin/ mdza' bshes dang / snag gi gnyen mtshams dag gis kyang de zuyongs su gtong bar 'gyur ba yin/ de'i dgra bo dag kyang mang bar 'gyur ba yin/ nor dang nor gyi yo byad dag kyang yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba yin/ rnam par g.yeng ba ⑨mang ba yang yin/ yan lag ma tshang bar 'gyur ba yang yin/0 de gnyid med par 'gyur ba ⑩yin/ rtag tu ⑫sred pas gnod par 'gyur ba yang yin/ de'i bza' ba dang btung ba yang dug gi bya ba byed pa yin/ sdug pa dang yid du 'ong ba dag dang myur du 'bral 65—122

ba 'thob pa yin/ rtag tu gzhan dag dang 'thab mo 'byung ba yin/ pha dang ma dang spun dang / chung ma dang bu dang ①bu mo dang / bran dang bran mo dag kyang bsgo ba bzhin mi byed pa yin/ de'i gsang sngags gsang ba dag dang /nor gsang ba dang / be+es gsang ba dang / de'i dngos po gsang ba rnams kyang thams cad gsang ④shor ba dag tu 'gyur ba yin/ bgo ①skal la spyod pa mi mdza' ba la sogs pa lngas longs spyod dag chud za bar 'gyur ba yin/ nad tshabs chen po dag gis kyang myur du thebs par 'gyur ba yin/ sman dang rim gro ba dag dang 'bral ba yin/ sha dang khrag bskams nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su stsong ba yin/ rang gi bshang gci dag gi nang du 'chi ba'i dus byed par 'gyur ba yin te/ rgyal po chen po 'dod pa ma yin pa'i chos nyi shu po de dag dang myur du ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang dge slong chos kyis ④gnas pa rnams la bsngos pa'i longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod pa budang / nor byi yo byad 'phrog par byed cing / bdag nyid kyang yongs su longs gyespyod par byed pa de 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med par skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de der yang tshe bskal par lcags dang zangs zhun 'thung bar 'gyur zhing / lcags kyi thu lum za bar 'gyur la/ me'i gos dang / longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod par byed cing / gnod pa mi bzad pa chen po rnam pa sna tshogs nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /tshe bskal pa zad pa nas de nas shi 'phos nas kyang / 'brog dgon pa ro skam dag gi nang du lam du skyes pa'i yi dwags rnams dang skal ba mnyam par/ rkang pa dang lag pa dang / mig ma tshang bar skye bar 'gyur ro/ /der yang phyogs bzhi nas langs pa'i rlung kun du 65—123

tsha ba dag gis kun du gdung bar byed do①/ /sa spu gri dang 'dra ba'i steng du bsnyal ⑤bar byed/ yongs su bsnyal ①bar byed de zhes gsungs pa dang /yang mdo de nyid las/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to / /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das spyod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ④mtshan ma gang dag gis—/ dge slong tshul khrims 'chal pa sdig pa'i chos kun du spyod pa/ dge slong chos kyis rgyaganas pa rnams kyi nang du slan chad kyang gnas pa dang / longs spyod dang nye bar spyod par kyebagyi bar mi 'os pa 'tshal ba lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam pa 'di lta bus tshul khrims 'chal pa'i mgo 'byung bar 'gyur ro zhes gang gis kyang myur du rnam par shes par mi nus te/ rgyal po chen po 'di ni nang gi dang por sangs rgyas la ma gus pa yin no/ /chos dang dge 'dun dang / mkhan po dang slob dpon dang /bla ma'i gnas lta bu ⑦rnams la ma gus pa yin/ 'phags pa'i rigs btang ba yin / rnal 'byor yid la byed pa la kun dga' ba ma yin no/ /ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa rnam par spangs pa yin/ khyim na gnas pa dang 'dres pa yin / tshig 'khyal kyepa smra ba yin/ bdag la bstod pa yin/ gzhan la smod pa yin/ de lta bu dag la kun dga' ba yin/ sdig pa'i rnyi ⑨la chags pa yin / lam ngan par zhugs pa yin/ khengs pa yin/ kha drag pa yin/'phral g.yar can yin/ 'phyar po yin/ kha shing can yin/ g.yo sgyu can yin—/ sgyu byed pa yin/ dge sbyong g.yon rmye po yin/ dge sbyong g.yon can yin / dge sbyong snyi long lta bu yin/ dge slong gi dge 'dun mi mthun par 'dod par ⑫smra ba yin/ rnyed pa dang bkur ste dang / tshigs su bcad pa la 65—124

mngon par dga' ba yin/ 'du 'dzi kun la dga' ba yin/ sdig pa can gyi dge slong tshul khrims 'chal pa de ni ji srid du de'i tshul khrims 'chal pa'i mgo byung bar stim gyur gyi bar du gang gis kyang mtshan ma de dag gis zhumyur du shes par mi nus so/ /snyig pa can gyi dge slong de gang gi tshe/ khyim gyi gzhi dang /zhing gi gzhi dang / kun dga' ra ba'i gzhi dang / bran dang bran mo dang /glang po che dang / rta dang / rnga mo dang / bong bu dang / lug dag gang zag gis srel bar byed na/ de ni de'i tshul khrims 'chal pa'i mgo byung ba yin te/ tshul khrims 'chal pa'i mgo des na sdig pa can gyi dge slong de①/dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi nang nas dor ba yin/ gnas par bya ba ma yin/longs spyod par bya ba ma yin/ dge slong gi dngos po las lhung ba yin/ pham par gyur pa yin te/ dge sbyong gi tshul las kyang phyis babe+eng ④du med par 'gyur ba yin no/ /rgyal po chen po mi gdol pa gnas na gnas par byed pa ni bla'i—/ dge slong gdol pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa/ rgyud tshig pa don la mi lta ba/ 'jig rten pha rol btang ba⑤ / snying rje'i bsam pa med pa/phyi sa khung chen po dang 'dra ba/ bdud kyi lam du zhugs pa/ lha dang mi rnams la gnod par byed pa/ dus gsum thams cad kyi drang srong thub pa rnams la slu bar byed pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung chos kyi mar me med par byed pa/chos kyi rgya mtsho skems par byed pa/ chos smra ba'i dbyen byed pa/ sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag rnams la 'drid par byed pa dge slong chos kyis ④gnas pa rnams la tho 'tshal ⑦par byed pa/ dge 'dun mthun par byed pa'i rgyun gcod par byed pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /sdig pa can gyi dge slong de ni/ yongs su 65—125

'dzin pa'i rkyen gyis mtho ris kyi lam las rgyal po ldog par byed pa yin no/ /rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang /skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang bu mo sdog par byed pa yin no/ /ngan song gi lam gsum la rab tu gzhog par byed pa yin no/ /rgyal po chen po sdig pa can gyi dge slong de yongs su 'dzin pa'i khyad par gyi rgyu mtshan gyis ①lha dang mi ji snyed cig mi skyed par byed pa la ltos/ rgyal po chen po de lta bas na—/ yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i dge slong dang dge slong chos kyis gnas pa yon tan gyis ④phyug pa dag dang lhan cig tu kun dga' ra ba gcig dang / gtsug lag khang gcig tu gnas par mi bya'o/ /gal te sdig pa can kyi dge slong de kha drag cing ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod pa rnam par spangs te/dge slong de dag dang lhan cig gnas par byed na/ de'i phyir dge slong chos kyis gnas pa de dag gis /zhubyams pa dang ldan zhing chos dang mthun ④pas dran par byas te/ gal te sdig pa can gyi dge slong de gnas de nas 'gro ba lta na ni legs—/ gal te 'gro bar mi byed na ni/ der dge slong chos kyis ⑤gnas pa de dag dong la/ grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / grong dang ljongs dang ri 'or phyode dag na/ rgyal rigs sam/ bram ze'am/ rje'u rigs sam/dmangs rigs gang dbang byed du 'jug pa de la sbran par bya'o/ /gal te rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs des snyig pa can gyi dge slong yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa/ gnas de nas zlog ⑦par byed na/ der ni dge slong chos kyis ④gnas pa de dag gnas par bya'o/ /ji ste rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs 65—126

de dag bza' ba dang btung ba dang rnyed pa'i rgyus/ sdig pa can gyi dge slong yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs byed pa lta na/ de'i phyir dge slong chos kyis ①gnas pa de dag gis khro ba bstan par mi bya'o/ /chags pa ma yin/nga rgyal ma yin te/ 'on kyang cang mi smra bar gnas de nas 'gro bar bya zhing /dgon pa'i gnas sam/ nags khrod dam/ ri'am/ ri 'or ④gzhan gang na sgra gcom ①chung ba dang / nang du yang dag 'jog dang 'tsham pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang mthun pa der gnas par bya'o/ /yang rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mchi ma dag phyung nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / rnyed pa'i slad du sdig pa can gyi dge slong yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs bgyid cing /dge slong chos kyis gnas pa/ yon tan gyis buphyug pa rnams kyang gnas nas mchi bar 'gyur ba'i rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang /dmangs rigs de dag ni nyams pa lags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa mchog tu nyams pa lags so/ /de mi nyid rnyed pa ni rnyed par dka' lags te—/ 'khor ba na 'khor bar bkyid pa de mi nyid rnyed pa'i tha ma ni de lags so—/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa grangs ma mchis/dpag tu ma mchis pa gang bā'i klung gi bye ma snyed 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur bas kyang / gang dge slong chos kyis buganas pa rnams kyi tshig gus par mi nyan pa'i sems can de ni ngan song rnams las yongs su thar bar bgyi ba'am/mtho ris su gzhag rjopar mi spyod de/ de ni sdig pa'i las de lta bu dang ldan par 'gyur lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen 65—127

po ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ la lar gang dge slong chos kyis ①gnas pa rnams la shin tu dad pa'i rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang /dmangs rigs dag 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de dag gi don du dgon pa'i gnas dag byed par 'gyur ro/ /gtsug lag khang dang / dgon pa'i gnas der yang khyim gyi gzhi nas/ zhing gi gzhi dang / bran dang bran mo dang / kun dga' ra ba'i bar de dag gi longs spyod dang / nye bar spyod pa'i phyir yongs su gtong thubar 'gyur ro/ /de dag 'chi ba'i dus byas nas kyang rgyal rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba nas/ 'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi lha rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu yang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang phrad ④par 'gyur ba nas/ ring po mi thogs par sbyin pa po dang /sbyin bdag de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i bar du 'gyur te/ de dag ni nga'i bstan pa la dge slong chos kyis thuganas pa rnams yang dag par 'dzin par byed par 'gyur ba yin no/ /rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ gang khyod kyi bu'am spun nam/ bkrabs pa'am/sna chen po la gtogs pa gang yang rung ba zhig nyes pa dang bcas pa yin na/gang dang gang du rgyal po chen po'i dus ston nam/ dga' ston 'byung ba der/rgyal po chen po snyedaga' ba dang / bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs nyams su myong bar byed na/ rgyal po chen po de ji snyam du sems/ skyes bu de khyod kyi mdun du 'dug cing / skyid pa dang rtse ba myong bar byed pa'am/ dga' ba dang bde ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spyoganas par byed nus sam/ rgyal pos gsol pa/65—128

btsun pa bcom ldan 'das ma lags te/ skyes bu de bdag gi mdun na mchis par yang rngo mi thogs lags na/ skyid pa dang rtse ba myong bar bgyid pa lta smos kyang ci 'tshal/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal po chen po stide bzhin du gang zag gang zhig gang zag gir ②bran dang bran mo srel bar byed cing /khyim gyi gzhi'am/ zhing gi gzhi nas/ lug dag gi bar srel bar byed na/nga yang de'i ston pa ma yin la/ de yang nga'i nyan thos ma yin no/ /dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad la yang gnod par byed pa dang bcas pa yin te/ de ni chos kyis ①gnas pa rnams kyi gnas de ltar bsngos pa dag tu/ chos dang mthun pas gnas par 'os pa ma yin no/ /rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs gang yang sdog pa can gye dge slong yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i don byed pa dang / de nas 'gror mi ster ba'i rgyal rigs nas/ dmangs rigs kyi bar de ni dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad la yang gnod pa bubyed pa dang bcas pa chen po yin no/ /sbyin pa mang po sbyin par byed du zin kyang de 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ mnar med pa'i sems can dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi nang du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen po de lta bas na/ bdag la phan par yang dag par rjes su lta bas/ sdig pa can kyi dge slong yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas pa'i phyogs su gnas par mi bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni lha dang mi thams cad la yang gnod pa dang / phan pa ma yin pa dang /log par lhung ⑤bar bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung med par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyal po chen po rgyal 65—129

rigs sam/ bram ze'am/ rje'u rigs sam/ dmangs rigs gang zhig dge slong chos kyis rmye gnas pa rnams kyi phyogs la yang dag par gnas par byed cing / sdig pa can gyi dge slong rnams kyi phyogs la ma yin na/ de sbyin pa ma byen khudu zin kyang / 'on kyang de ni chos kyi phyogs kyi rgyu'i phyir dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyi sbyin bdag dam pa yin no—/ /de ni dam pa'i chos rjes su bsrung bar bya ①ba'i phyir dam pa'i chos 'dzin pa dam pa yin par blta'o④/ /'chi ba'i dus byas nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dag tu skye bar 'gyur ba nas/ ring po mi thogs par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i bar du 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po chen bo de lta bas na/ rgyal rigs 'tsham pa khyed kyi lag tu chos kyis gnas pa dang / bstan pa ngas yongs su gtad kyis/lnga brgya pa tha ma la gnas pa'i bar du khyed kyis rjonga'i chos kyis gnas pa yang dag par zung shig dang / de'i rkyen gyis nga'i chos kyi tshul 'di dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung yun ring du gnas par 'gyur zhing / lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang bde bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba'i bar dang / yang mdo sde de nyid las / de nas klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i pya bu pad+ma'i gdong zhes bya bas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag sug las gang gis 7klu'i rigs su skyes nas/gzugs mchog tu lham 3me zhing lus kyi reg pa gang cung zad ci reg kyang kun du tshig cing 'bar ba lags/ bdag dus thams cad du mchil ⑨lham bor nas gcer bur rgyu bar bkyid lags/ bdag gi pha de ni dpal phun sum tshogs pa ches khyad par du 'phags pa myong ste/ dper na gling bzhi pa'i 'khor los sgyur 65—130

ba'i rgyal po bzhin lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' sprul pa/ kye lag ①'gro sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus bskal pa sum cu rtsa gcig 'das pa de'i ④tshe de'i dus na/ de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zhes bya ba'i bar du gtsug tor can zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de'i tshe rgyal po me tog bral zhes bya ba zhig byung ste/ rgyal po me tog bral des kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa gtsug tor can nyan thos dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun brgya stong phrag mang po'i 'khor dang ldan pa de la/ zla ba gsum yo byad thams cad phul nas/ rtag tu chos mnyan te/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu smon lam btab bo/ /bcom ldan 'das de'i gtsug lag khang yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa zhig kyang brtsigs so/ /rgyal po me tog bral de'i bu srid sgrub bcas zhes bya ba ④zhig yod de④/ de shin tu 'khor bas skrag nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du rab tu byung ste/ pha'i dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba de rjes su skyong zhing 'dug go/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong gang dag gnas pa dang / de nas gang dag bza' ba dang / btung ba dang / mal cha la longs spyod par byed pa thams cad la me tog bral gyi bu dge slong srid sgrub bcas de phrag dog byed do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge slong de dag kyang gnas de nas dong ngo / /de yang yid mchog tu dga' nas bdag nyid kyis kyang longs spyad par mi byed/gzhan la yang mi ster ro zhes bya ba nas/ dge slong de yang 'chi ba'i dus byas nas—/ sems can dmyal ba chen po rnams kyi nang du skyes so zhes bya ba'i bar du'o—/ /de lo khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang por sems can dmyal ba chen bo'i 65—131

nang du skyes nas btsos so/ /de nas shi 'phos nas yi dwags rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ lo brgya stong phrag mang por der sdug bsngal stsong ngo / /phyis yang sems can dmyal ba dang / yi dwags rnams kyi nang du sdug bsngal pyong ngo / /lag 'gro 'khor bas skrag pa'i sems dang ldan pa srid sgrub bcas zhes ①bya ba rab tu byung ste/ de nas shi 'phos nas de ltar yun ring por ngan song du sdug bsngal myong ba zhude gzhan zhig yin par khyod sems na gzhan yin par yang blta ①bar mi bya ste/ de ltar las kyi sgrib pa dam pos duzin pa yang khyod yin no/ /'di phan chad bskal pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu khyod rtag par ngan song gsum gyi nang du skyes so/ /de'i las kyi sgrib pa lhag ma lus pa des 'dir klu rnams kyi nang du skyes pa ni gzhan ma yin gyi khyod yin te/ sdug bsngal gyi tshor ba de lta bu myong ngo //gang khyod 'di nas shi 'phos nas phyis kyang sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dwags rnams kyi nang du rtag tu sdug bsngal gyis gzir bar 'gyur ba 'di ni gnas yod do/ /klu'i bu de mchog tu yid mi dga' nas rab tu ngu zhing bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das byis pa ji lta ba dang / myos pa ji lta bu dang / mi gsal ba dang / mi mkhas pa ji lta ba bzhin du bunongs pa so sor 'chags lags so/ / nongs pa so sor 'chags lags so/ /dubatsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag gi bsam pas sdom pa gzung ④bar bgyi'o/ /bdag de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge bsnyen lags te/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa ④ spang bar bgyi lags so/ /bdag bcom ldan 'das la skyabs su mchis pa lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu legs so 65—132

legs so/ /khyod lhag pa'i bsam pas nga la skyabs su song bas khyod kyi ngan 'gro thams cad yongs su zad do/ /'di ①nas shi 'phos nas khyod kyis ⑤byams pa'i tshe na mi'i rnyed pa thob par 'gyur te/ byams pa'i thad du rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur zhing dgra bcom pa nyid kyi bar du mngon sum du byed par 'gyur ro/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na gang gis ①gtsug tor can 'khor dang bcas pa la zla ba gsum du yo byad thams cad kyis rjorim gro byas pa dang / de'i phyir dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra ba yo byad thams cad phun sum tshogs par byas pa'i rgyal po me tog bral zhes bya ba gzhan zhig yin par khyod sems na de gzhan du yin par ⑤mi blta ste/ de ni klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho 'di yin no/ /'di ni bskal pa sum cu rtsa gcig tu nam yang ngan 'gror ma skyes so/ /lha'i dpal dang skal bu /ba bzang po phun sum tshogs pa shin tu rgya chen po myong ngo / /'di ni bla na med pa'i theg pa'i phyir smon lam gyi dbang gis ④'dir klu rnams kyi nang du skyes te/ 'dir dpal dang skal ba bzang po de lta bu myong ngo / /de skad ces thos nas klu thams cad skyo zhing mchog tu yid mi dga' nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchog tu gus pa skyes shing nye bar rtogs pas gces par byed par gyur to zhes gsungs pa dang /yang mdo de nyid las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ spu gri rnon po dag gis su/ /rang gi yan lag gtubs dupa bla'i/ /bsngos zin pa yi dngos po ni/ /khyem pa rnams la sbyin mi bya/ /me lce 'bar ba lta bu yi/ /lcags kyi thu lum zos pa bla'i/ /dge 'dun dag las gar de ni/ /dge 'dun gyi ⑨la longs mi spyad/ /lhun po dang ni 'dra ba'i mi/ /blang bar byas te zos pa bla'i//khyem par gyur pas dge 'dun kyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /thams cad 65—133

'byung bar byas pa dang / /gsal shing steng du bteg pa bla'i/ /khyim par gyur pas ①dge 'dun gyi/ /longs spyad par ni mi bya'o/ /me mdag gis ni gang ba yi/ /gnas khang der ni zhugs pa bla'i/ /khyim pas dge 'dun gnas khang du/ /mtshan mo gnas par mi bya'o/ /me lce 'bar ba lta bu yi/ /lcags kyi thu lum blangs pa bla'i/ /rab tu byung bas khyim pa yi/ /dbyeg ni blang bar ①mi bya'o/ /'khor lo rnon pos bdag gi ①lus/ /kun du gtub dhipar byas pa bla'i—/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos rnams la/ /rgyags dang gshe ba bskyed mi bya/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos can gyis/ /mig ni rang gis phyung ba ⑤bla'i—/ /sems can du ni bgrangs pa la/ /khros pas skye dgu mi mngag go/ /legs par gsungs pa'i chos can gyis⑥/ /me yi gos ni gon pa bla'i/ /tshul 'chos pa dang mthu yis su/ /khyim pa las ni gos mi blang ⑦/ /me 'dra bar ni bskol ba yi bye/ /rtsub 'gyur chu ni 'thungs pa bla'i/ /rab tu byung bas ⑨g.yo sgyu yis/ /bza' btung blang bar mi bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so / /⑩nam mkha'i spyan ⑪gyi mdo las kyang / yang de'i tshe lha'i dbang po dang / klu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dang / lha ma yin gyi dbang po dang /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po dang / mi'am ci'i dbang po dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dang / grul bum gyi dbang po dang / yi dwags kyi dbang po dang / sha za'i dbang po dang / sa la rgyu ba dang nam mkha' la rgyu ba ⑫ khyed rnams kyi lag tu chos kyi rnam grangs 'di ngas yongs su gtad par bya'o/ /da lta ⑫dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus su gang zag don yid la byed pa/ chos la gnas pa—/ chos kyi rjes su mthun pa'i chos sgrub pa/ chos dang mthun pa'i chos spyod pa/65—134

dbe+en pa la mngon par dga' ba rnams srungs shig /yongs su skyongs shig /de'i sbyin pa po dang / sbyin bdag de dag kyang srungs shig /yongs su skyongs shig /gang dag de rnams kyi yo byad 'dzin pa dang / yongs su skyong ba de dag kyang srungs shig /yongs su skyongs shig /de ni khyed cag la yun ring por phan pa dang bde ba byed par 'gyur ro/ /de nas lha'i dbang po de snyed thams cad nas/ sha za'i dbang po dang / nam mkha' la rgyu ba dang sa la rgyu ba'i bar thams cad kyis ①mgrin gcig gis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das de ltar lags so/ /btsun pa bde bar gshegs pa de ltar lags so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus na ji srid du de bzhin gshegs pas ④byin gyis brlabs pa'i chos kyi tshul 'bar ba de srid du ④kho bo cag gis ④rang gi sug las dor nas de bzhin gshegs pas bstan pa'i chos 'dul ba bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bubar bgyi'o/ /chos la gnas pa ⑥tshul khrims kyis dze+ephyug pa/yon tan dang ldan pa/ yongs su 'dzin pa med pa/ dben pa la mngon par dga' ba/ chos kyi rjes su mthun par chos la zhugs pa'i gang zag rnams chos gos dang / zas dang / mal stan dang / na ba'i rkyen sman gyi yo byad rnams kyis ⑧bsrung bar bgyi/ yongs su bskyang ⑨bar bgyi'o/ /nad med pa dang stobs dang bde ba la reg par ⑩ gnas pa nyid kyis/ dge ba'i phyogs dang rjes su mthun pa nyid bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /ji srid du de dag sangs rgyas kyis ⑪bcas pa'i bslab pa la yongs su rdzogs par spyod pa brtson 'grus brtsams pa—/ rab tu rnam par dben pa/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pas gnas shing /yongs su 'dzin pa thams cad dang / kun dga' ra ba dang / khyim dang zhing 65—135

dang / bran pho dang / bran mo dang / nor dang / 'bru dang / grags pa dang / rnyed pa dang / bkur ste dang / tshigs su bcad pa mchog dang /tshul 'chos dang / kha gsag dang / gzhogs slong ①rnams dang thams cad du ldu/ma 'dres par gnas pa de srid du/ kho bo cag gis gnod sbyin gdug pa nas—/ lus srul po gdug pa'i bar du bzlog ①par bgyi'o/ /bde bar gshegs pas rab tu bstan pa'i bstan pa la de dag dad pa bskyed par bkyi'o/ /ji srid du de dag zla ba dang nyi ma dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang nyin mo dang mtshan mo dang / lo dang dus tshigs yang dag par 'da' ba de srid du/ kho bo cag gis 'thab pa dang rtsod pa dang g.yul ngo dang nad dang pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang mu ge dang g.yo dang slu ba dang brdzun du smra ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i rlung dang char 'bab pa dag rab tu zhi bar bgyi'o/ /bdag cag gis rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs dang / skyes pa dang / bud med dang / khye'u dang bu mo ji snyed pa'i bar rnams mi dge ba'i chos rnams las bzlog par bgye'o/ /dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad la sbyar bar bya'o④ / /gang zag chos la gnas pa sbyin pa dang dul ba dang yang dag par bsdams 5pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa dang / yon tan gyis phyug dhipa rnams kyis ⑦spyad pa'i spyod pa la gzud par bgyi'o/ /ji srid du bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos re ba thams cad yongs su mi 'dzin cing chos kyi 'du shes kyis mngon par dga' bar 'gyur ba de srid du/ bdag cag gis grong khyer dang /grol rdal dang / ri sul dang yul 'khor dang ljongs de dag dang / sbyin pa po dang sbyin bdag de dag kyang bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /yongs su bskyang bar bgyi'o//65—136

nor dang / 'bru dang / dga' ba dang / rtse ba dang / nad med pa dang /phan tshun du rab tu dga' bas tshogs pa dang / tshe ring ba nyid ma tshang ba med par bsgrub par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ ji srid du bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos re ba thams cad mi 'dzin cing / chos la gnas pa chos kyi rjes su mthun pas ①chos bsgrub par gnas par 'gyur ba de srid du 'di na yun ring por sa'i bcud dang sems can gyi gzi mdangs dang / chos kyi gzi mdangs mi nub par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /ji srid du yun ring por lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang mi'i 'jig rten na mngon par dga' bar gyur pa de srid du yun ring por sems can rnams che'i dus byas nas lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du sems can dbang che bar grags pa dbang che bar grags pa de dag tu skye bar 'gyur/de srid du yun ring por lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du sems can dbang che bar grags pa khrurnams kyis yongs su gang bar 'gyur/ de srid du yun ring por chos la gnas pa'i byang chub 1sems dpa' rnams gnas par 'gyur/ de srid du 'di ltar chos ma yin pa'i phyogs tshar gcad pa'i phyir bdag cag stobs dang brtson 'grus ④dang pha rol gnon pas gnas par 'gyur/ de srid du yun ring por bdag cag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la ma dad pa'i sems can rnams dad par bya ba'i phyir nus par 'gyur/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das gang gi phyir 'dir ⑤ ma 'ongs pa'i dus na bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos yongs su 'dzin pa dang bcas par 'gyur bas/ rnal 'byor yid la byed pa dang / chos la gnas pa dang / dgon pa dang / nags khrod na gnas pa dang / bas mtha'i gnas mal spong bar 'gyur/ phrag dog gi ngang tshul can dang bsags pa 65—137

mang bas gnas par 'gyur/ bslab pa dang ngo tsha shes pa dang khrel yod pa spong bar 'gyur/ khyim na gnas pa dang 'dre ①ba dang / rnyed pa dang bkur ste la dga' bar 'gyur/ de dag khyim pa'i stobs dang nor gyi phung po'i stobs kyis ②phan tshun 'joms par byed/ 'thab pa la dga' zhing khyim pa'i mdun du rtsod par 1byed/ brdzun dang dutshig rtsub mo smra ba ⑤mi srung bas/ khyim pa rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa theg pa chen po la dad pa skyed par mi 'gyur/ rgyal rigs dang / bram ze dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs pa de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa la dad pa rgyun gcod par 'gyur ro zhes gsungs pa dang /yang mdo de nyid las/ da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ rgyal rigs khyed cag thams cad kyi lag tu nyan thos kyi babe+eb pa khrims su bca' ba gtad par bya'o—/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na nga'i bstan pa la gang zag lam ngan pa gdul dka' ba ngo tsha ba dang khrel spangs pa spyod pa legs par ma byas pa rnams gnas par 'gyur/ gang dag gnyen bshes kyi stobs sam khyem pa'i stobs sam mang du thos pa'i stobs sam/ 'khor gyi stobs kyis basbab dupa dag la smas ñju par spyod cing / khyim pa'i rtags dang khyim pa'i longs spyod dag la lta bar byed/ yongs su 'dzin pa yang len par byed/ dge slong nyung bar gnas pa rnams kyis chamyur bar dge 'dun gyi nang nas dbyung ba dang /ji ltar babe+eb pa bcas pa bzhin chad pa gcad par mi nus pa de'i phyir bslab pa bca' ba'i bya ba rgyal rigs rnams kyi lag tu gtad par bya'o/ /rgyal rigs de dag de lta bu'i ngo bo'i gang zag rnams la ji ltar bcas pa bzhin chad pa gcod du 'jug par byed do/ /rgyal rigs gang dag da lta ba dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus 65—138

lnga brgya pa tha ma'i bar du de ltar brtson pa dang pha rol gnon pas nga'i bstan pa srung bar byed/ yongs su skyong ①bar byed/ chos kyi tshul yang dag par 'bar bar byed par 'gyur ba'i rgyal rigs de dag ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcad ④par bya ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin no/ /sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yongs su skyong ba'i lha rnams kyis srung bar 'gyur/ yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs de dag yun ring por rgyal po nyid byed par 'gyur/ gang las bskal pa brgyar byang chub kyi phyir spyod par 'gyur ba bsod nams ches mang po bskyed par 'gyur ro/ /yang gang dag da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ nga'i bstan pa la btang snyoms par gnas par 'gyur ba'i rgyal rigs de dag ni/ lha thams cad kyis yongs su spong bar 'gyur/ nyan thos dang rang rgyal ba thams cad kyis ①spong bar 'gyur/ gang nga'i bstan pa la btang snyoms pa'i rgyal rigs de ni 'jig rten pha rol tu lha dang mir skye bar mi 'gyur/ dkon mchog gsum byi gdung rnam par bcad rjopa'i phyir zhugs pa yin/ chos kyi sgon ma yongs su bsnub pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin/ chos kyi bcud bskam ⑪ pa'i phyir zhugs pa yin/sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi mig dbyung ba'i phyir zhugs pa yin no/ /rgyal po chen po 'di ji snyam du sems/ gang zag gang sems can thams cad kyi mig 'byin par byed pa des/ bsod nams ma yin pa ji tsam zhig dang ldan par 'gyur—/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mchi ma blags te 'di skad ces gsol to—/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das mang lags so/ /gang zag des bsod nams ma yin pa gzhal du med grangs med pa rab tu bskyed pa ④lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyal rigs gang zhig da ltar dang ma 65—139

'ongs pa'i dus na bdag gi bstan pa de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa 'bar gyi bar du/ chos la gnas pa'i gang zag bsrung bar mi 'gyur/gang zag lam ①ngan pa pa rnams ②chos ji lta ba bzhin du slob par mi byed pa'i rgyal rigs de bsod nams ma yin pa ches mang du bskyed do/ /gang rgyal rigs de sngon bskal pa brgyar sbyin pa btang bar gyur/ tshul khrims bsrungs pa nas shes rab bsgoms zhupa'i bar du gyur pa dang / theg pa gsum po gang yang rung ba'i theg pas yang dag par rab tu gnas par gyur pa de/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa dang rab tu brlag pa'i rgyus/ de'i sngon bsags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de thams cad yongs su zad pa dang yongs su gtugs par 'gyur ro/ /de'i yul du chos ma yin pa gsum po mu ge dang 'thab mo dang g.yul 'gyed pa 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de la lhas btang snyoms su byed/ lha rnams kyis ④'dor/de'i yul du bka' lung mi 'jug gobye/ /de'i yul du g.yo dang slu ba dang brdzun smra ba sna tshogs kye'abyung bar 'gyur ro⑦/ /pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis ④chos kyi phung po 'phrog par 'gyur/ mes 'tshig spupa'am chus 'khyer bar 'gyur/rgyal rigs de yun ring por mi thogs par nad mi bzad pas thebs par 'gyur/myur du mdza' bo dang yid ⑫du 'ong ba rnams dang 'bral bar 'gyur/ che'i ⑩dus byas nas sems can ⑫dmyal ba rnams su skye bar 'gyur ro/ /gal te brgya ⑩lam na shin tu yun ring po nas yun ring po ④zhig na mi nyid du skyes pa na⑫ /myur du mig nyams par 'gyur/ nye bar longs spyod pa dang / yongs su longs spyod pa thams cad dang bral ⑩zhing / ljan ljin na gnas par 'gyur/yun ring por 'tsho zhing 'chi ba'i dus byas nas/ des sems can dmyal ba 65—140

rnams su skye bar 'gyur/ gnas ma yin pa yongs su rtog ①par byed par 'gyur/de sangs rgyas 'byung ba med par mi'i thob pa rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal rigs ji lta ba ④de bzhin du bram ze dang / rje'u rigs dang / dmangs rigs la sogs pa grong khyer gyi gtso bo rnams la yang 'gyur ro/ /yul gyi gtso bo dang /grong gi gtso bo dang / ri brag pa'i gtso bo dang / grong rdal gyi gtso bo rnams la yang 'gyur ro/ /gang zhig bag med pa'i rgyu'am/ nor gyi rgyus nga'i bstan pa la chos la gnas pa'i gang zag rnams ci nus par mi srung zhing / gang zag las ①ngan pa pa ji lta bu'i chos kyis ④mi 'dzin pa thams cad ni/ de lta bu'i ngo bo'i las kyi sgrib pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po gzugs can snying pos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /btsun pa bcom ldan 'das da ltar dang ma 'ongs pa'i dus na/ rgyal rigs rnams kyis ④mi'i thob pa ni rnyed par ⑪dka'o/ /gang dag kun nas bag med pas mang du gnas shing / tshul khrims dang ldan pa/yon tan gyis phyug ⑦pa chos la gnas pa rnams la mchod pa dang rim gro ⑧byed la/dam pa'i chos yun ring du gnas pa'i phyir dang / dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi gcad par bya ba'i phyir/ gang zag lam ngan pa pa ngo tsha ba dang khrel spangs pa chos kyis tshar gcod par mi byed pa de ni/ shin tu brlag pa dang /rtag tu ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ro zhes gsungs so/ /yul 'khor skyong gi mdo las kyang / bsam gtan dang ni kha ton btang nas su/ /rtag tu gtsug lag khang gi las la brtson/ /gnas la brkam zhing khro gnyer 'byin par byed/ /de dag slob ma 'khor kyang ma dul ba/ /nga ni gtsug lag khang gi lag gi bla'i⑨/ /bdag gi ched du 'di ni ngas byas te/ /dge slong gang dag nga yi rjes mthun pa//65—141

gtsug lag khang 'dir de dag gnas yod do/ /gang dag tshul khrims ldan zhing yod tan ldan/ /chos 'dzin skye bo'i don la mngon brtson pa/ /dul zhing yang dag sdom la rtag brtson pa/ /de dag gnas ni sdud par mi byed do/ /'di ni nga yi gnas su bskos pa ste/ /'di ni nga dang lhan cig gnas pa ①yin/ /'di ni nga yi dga' bar byed pa yin/ /khyed kyi duganas 'di gang yang med kyis sotsa / /'dir ni dge slong dag kyang mang bkod de/ /mal cha rnams kyang ma lus bgos zin la/ /'di ni rnyed pa 'byung ba yod ma yin/ /'dir ni ci zhig spyad kyis dge slong song / /de dag la ni mal stan bgo bya ba/ /nam du dusrid par 'gyur ba ma yin tethu/ /de dag khyim pa lta bur sogs 'gyur zhing / /'tshog chas ⑥rnams dang g.yog 'khor mang bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /dkon mchog sprin gyi mdo las kyang / rigs kyi bu chos bcu dang ldan na/ byang chub sems dpa' khyem gyi gnas nas mngon par byung ba rnams yin no/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nye bar len pa med pa rnams yin/ 'du 'dzi me+ed par spyod pa rnams yin/ yul la rgyab kyis spuphyogs pa rnams yin/ yul la sred pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ yul gyi nyes pas mi gos pa rnams yin/de bzhin gshegs pas tshul khrims bcas ④pa la rim gro byed cing brtson pa shin tu bslabs ⑨pa rnams yin/ gos dang bsod snyoms dang mal cha ngan ngon dang nad kyi rkyen rtsi dang yo byad ngan ngon dag gis chog shes pa rnams yin/ lhung bzed dang chos gos dang yo byad sogs pa dang bral ba rnams yin/ rtag par 'jigs pa'i yid dang ldan zhing yul rnams la skyo ba rnams yin/ dben pa la dga' zhing rtag tu bsgom pa la brtson pa rnams yin no/ /rigs kyi bu chos bcu 65—142
