bla med lam du gsungs/ /thi ①gu las sbrul 'dir bsal med/ /thi ①gu'ang gsar gzhag ci yang med/ /mar mes thi ④gu yang dag mthong / /de mthong 'jigs pa rnam par spangs/ /'di la bsal bya ci yang med/ /gzhag rjopar bya ba'ang cung zad med/ /yang dag nyid la yang dag lta/ /yang dag mthong na phyernam grol bshad/ /'di dag dman par bsgoms rjon ni/ /'phags lam byang chub dman nyid 'thob/ / bsam sor ⑦yang ni dman nyid kyis/ /bdag tu lta ba spong bar byed/ /rgya chen 'gro ba'i don bsgrubs ④pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyid kho nas/ / bsam pa la sogs khyad par kyis/ /⑨sku gsum byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /bdag gis 'di bsdus bsod nams ni/ /bskrun gyur gang des skye bo kun/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob nas/ /'gro la phan bde sbyin par shog /dge slong shākya'i dpal bzang ming / /bdag dang tsegadul bya lhan cig tu/ /byams mgon 'phags pa'i zhabs pad drung / /skyes nas de dgongs gsal byed shog /byang chub sems dpa'i lam gye rim pa de kho na nyid bsdus pa/ dpal chos kyi rje sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang ⑪bral ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po/ ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gsum par yongs su grags pa'i kha che shākya shrī bzang pos mdzad pa rdzogs so // //⑫paṇ+ḍi ta chen po de nyid dang lo tsā ⑫ba byams pa'i dpal ④gyis rgyang ro sa lu'i gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// //⑩65—532

baspur mchan/529 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉tha g.ya/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rim pa mdor bsdus pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉thamarga/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rab shes/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgrub/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazung / rjo〈〈pe 〉mitsun/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bstan/ dze+e〈〈pe 〉zhe/ 〈'ar 〉tsā/53༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra ngas/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉rdzang / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skorathob/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉〉bdag ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉skyed/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉〉kyis/531 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zo nga dag ldan/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thamanyan/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉zo nga rjes 'brengs/ bu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉snangabyin/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)sa/ du〈〈snar 〉thar/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉8/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ras/⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thagyur/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7phyir ro/ /rgyu/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉'phen/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉8/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉mis/532 ①④①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skab/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉༄zhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉zadas/ ⑥〈〈snar 〉ra sgom/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sams sogs/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgrub / ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉gibasam pa la sogs khyad par gyis/ /⑩〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉kyang / ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉ra dang / ⑫〈〈pe 〉ska/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉skopo ra 〉〉lots+tsha/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 ldan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉dze' ra 〉7dpal ldan byang chub sems dpa'i lam/ /mdor bsdus rim pa legs mnyan pa'i/ /bsod nams bdag gis gang bsgrubs des/ /'gro kun bde gshegs myur thob shog /lnga rig brtul zhugs dri med rnam thar dang / /bstan pa'i snying po bsgrub pa lhur mdzad pa/ /nyi 'og khams na mtshuras med gcig pu de'i/ /gsung 'di phyogs su nyi ltar rgyas gyur cig/ //65—533
bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (143)

༄ga /theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi tshigs su bcad pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ma hā yā na u ⑤pa de sha gā thā/ bod skad du—/ theg pa chen po'i man ngag gi ①tshigs su bcad pa/ rje btsun mi pham mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnyed dka'i dal 'byor myur du 'jig /'jig rten las 'bras sdug bsngal yin/ /de spang ④stong nyid snying rje bsgom/ /bde gshegs bstan pa'i snying po'o/ /bde 'dod skyes bus bsod nams bsags/ /de yang rang bzhin med par bsgom/ /rang bzhin med shes bsod nams mchog /de phyir bsod nams bde ba'i rgyu/ /bsod nams bsags pas bde ba 'thob/ /de phyir mis ni bsod nams bsags/ /de yang yang dang yang du bsgrub/ /di ⑤ring nyid nas 'dun te bsgrub/ /chos kun rang sems rnam par snang / /rang bzhin 'od gsal dri ma med/ /stong nyid snying rje ro gcig thabs/ /de bsgom ④'bras bu byang chub mchog /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub 65—535

mchog gnyis sems bskyed de/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can/ /bsgom bya de 'bras sku gsum 'thob/ /bsam pa rin chen sems gnyis 'byel/ /sbyor ba dka' spyad dang len dang / /rnam pa kun du mi dmigs shes/ /gnod pas skyo med sangs rgyas sras/ /skye 'gag gnas med byang chub sems/ /rgya chen sems can don la mkhas/ /tshogs gnyis rgyun chad med pa'i lam /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po'o/ /rmi lam lta bur phyi rol min/ /sgyu ma lta bur bden don med/ /nam mkha' lta bur mtshan nyid bral/ /chos kun rang bzhin 'od gsal yin/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal nyid las 'dir/ /ma skyes skye ba'i rten can gyi/ /byang chub sems gnyis rjes 'byel bas/ /sems can kun don spyad par bya/ /dam pa gsum gyis sdig las bzlog① /dri med gnyis kyis dge tshogs bsgrub/ /mnyam par gzhag ①pas rang sems gdul/ /bdag nyid chen po'i bsgrub ①pa'o/ /sems ni rtag par byang chub 'dod/ /bya ba lus can don la brtson/ /bde sdug rmi lam 'drar shes pas/ /mkhas pas gzhan don sgrub par byed/ /khrims kyis dal 'byor snying po blang / / thos pas tshe yi snying po blang /bya /bsgrub pas bstan pa'i snying po blang / /de yi snying po gzhan don no/ /rtse gcig gnas pas dran pa bsten/ /byang chub sems kyis tshogs gnyis bsags/ /ma bcos mthong bas mnyam par gzhag⑤ /bsgrub pa'i snying po mdor bsdus pa'o/ /gang gis ⑥skye dang gnas mthong ba/ /rmi lam mar me dag dang mtshungs/ /'gro ba brdzun pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /rigs ldan skyes bu rtag tu bslus/ /'du byed gar mkhan lta bu ste/ /de yi rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra/ /mkhas pas don kun bsgrub 'dod pas/ /65—536

bden gnyis mtshan nyid rtogs par byos/ /bya byed phra men rdzu 'phrul 'dra/ /'chi bdag ri gzar chu drag bzhin/ /mdza' sdang rmi lam dgra gnyen mtshungs/ /'jigs pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho yin/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong rkyen kyis bsgrub/ /dge sdig kun slong bsam pas bsgrub/ /①thams cad las kyis 'grub gyur ④te//kye ma dal 'byor don yod byos/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' chags sdang gis/ /gtan sdug sdog pa 'phel 'gyur na/ /thams cad slu ba'i chos can la/ /kye ma yid brtan su zhig 'cha'/ /yid mthun tshong grogs lta bur 'bral/ /mi mthun lam kha'i tsher shing bzhin/ /rang srog bum nang bung ba 'dra/ /thams cad sha lam grog tshang mtshungs/ /legs bshad me tog ci ①ltar phan/ /nyes spyad sbrul gdug so ltar gdug /kun kyang bdag sdug mi 'dod na/ /dal ba don med ci tha tshig /nyin mtshan glog rgyun lta bur 'das/ /tshe srog chu bur ④ji bzhin 'gag /bde sbyor chu 'gram bye ma bzhin/ /kye ma ji ltar bdag 'chi grang / /'du byed rmi lam yul 'dra ste/ /mdza' bshes srang sdod tshong grogs mtshungs—/ /dge sdig rang lus grib ma bzhin/ /ci byas mi bzad tshor ba'i rgyu—/ /gshin rje'i pho nyas phyi bzhin gtugs/ /gnyan phyenor na bun lta bur dengs—/ /'jigs chen g.yangs ṣ+pesar bdag lhung ④na/ /kye ho bsod nams su zhig sogs④/ /srid gsum sdug bsngal me 'obs 'bar/ /skye bo don med 'ching bas bcings/ /de bas snying brtse brtson 'grus kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsgrub par bya/ /phung po bdag med sgyu ma 'dra/ /yid ni me long gzugs bzhin te/ /sems can sgyu ma'i 'bras dang mtshungs/ /chos kun stong pa nyid shes bya/ /'khrul phyir snang ba phyi rol min/ /sna tshogs snang phyir 65—537

snang min te/ /shes byed med phyir shes yod min/ /de phyir chos kun stong ①pa nyid—/ /brtse ba tsam gyis srid par 'phen/ /shes rab smad pas ②mya ngan 'da'—/ /de phyir phan tshun mnyam ldan pas/ /rgyal bas bla med lam du gsungs—/ /nyin mtshan sdod med res 'jog 'gro/ /tshe 'di snod med rtag tu 'brid/ /gzhan du 'od ①cir 'gyur gding rjomed na/ /'chi tshe bdag yid ji ltar bde/ /gang bsags bung ba'i rtsi ltar 'dor/ /gnyan ⑤sdug sbrul tshang bya khyung bzhin/ /bdag gcig rjoya nga'i thang la rgyug /kyi hud bzod dka'i tshor bas 'jigs/ /mi sdug gshin rje'i pho nyas bzung / /yid 'ong gnyen dang bshes pas spangs/ /skyabs gcig bsod nams rgyang bsrings natshu —/ /de tshe gnas skabs ci 'dra zhig /de ④ring nyid kyang 'chi srid na/ /lo brgyar bde bar gnas sam ci/ /nams kyang mi sdod 'gro 'gyur gyis/ /bdag ⑨don bdag gis bsgrub par gyis/ /'di la mi 'jigs su yang med/ /'jigs nas gding ⑫thob ci'ang med/ /gdeng ⑪drod dge las gzhan med na/ /ci phyir bdag yid bde bar 'dug /sngon chad ma myong bde sdug med/ /gang myong de la snying po med/ /kye ma rmi lam sgyu 'dras ⑫bslus/ /da ni bla ma'i bka' bsgrub rigs/ /ji lta ji ltar sna tshogs spyod yul gang snang ba/ /rgyal sras spyod tshe yul dus ngo bo de med bsgom/ /de lta de ltar mnyam nyid 'gro 'ong med gnas nas/ /sems can don brtson tshogs gnyis 'du byed mkhas par 'gyur—/ /gson tshe rtswa rtse'i zil pa 'dra/ /pha rol la yang shin tu nye/ /gcig pur gar 'gro nges med de/ /thams cad slu ba'i chos can nyid/ /bdag gis bdag don ma bsams na/ /nyin mtshan don med 'da' bar zad/ /65—538

mi dge spyad pas sdug bsngal 'byung / /de bas bag yod brtson par rigs/ /ma thob thob na dga' snyam sems/ /thob nas cung zad cis kyang skyo/ /mi skyo na yang chog shes med/ /chog shes gang med dbul po yin/ /dbul pos 'byor pa'i chog mi shes/ /phyug po rgyal pos chog mi shes/ /rgyal po lha yi dbang phyug 'dod/ /des kyang mi chog brgya stong 'dod/ /gos med tshe na gos 'dod de/ /gos thob gos zas mang po 'dod/ /des kyang mi chog de bzhin du//rgya ①yul sogs kyi gos gzhan tshol/ /nor med tshe na nor 'dod de/ /gcig gis mi chog khri phrag tshol/ /de snyed ②na yang pa ru sha'i/ /rta glang gser ri la sogs 'dod/ /gcig thob brgya 'dod brgya rnyed na/ /stong 'dod de yis ④mi chog ste/ /gnyis 'gyur de bzhin gsum ④'gyur dang / /brgya 'gyur la sogs 'dod me mched/ /de phyir gang la chog shes yod/ /de la nor rnams thams cad yod/ /gang la de med thams cad med/ /phyug po dbul po'i khyad par ci/ /dbul po cung zad dngos pos phongs/ /cung zad thob na'ang che thob sems/ /phyug po chog dumed mang pos phongs/ /chen po rnyed kyang chung ngur sems/ /srid la yid skyo nges 'byung mchog3 /bdag 'dul sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog /'chi bdag mi bzad dgra bo'i sde/ /pha rol don shes rnyed pa'i mchog /bag byed khrel yod chos 'dul yin/ /rang blo rang sbyong lhag pa'i sems/ /phyi nang stong shes shes rab ste/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sgol ba'i gru/ /bstan rtsa bslab pa bsrung 'dod pas/ /'bad pas kun gyis sems bsrung bya/ /bslab pa ma bsrungs lus don ci/ /sems ma bsrungs na chos don med/ /rang sems rang gis bsrung 'dod na/ /bsrung lcebral mtshan 65—539

ma med bsgom bya/ /sprul pa lta bu'i dran pa yis/ /thams cad 'bad de bsrung bar byis/ /bdag gi mnyam nyid rang bzhin te/ /yang dag don shes bsrung ba'i mchog /gang gis ①lus sems sgyu 'drar ni/ /gnas nas yang yang mnyam gzhag ②bya/ /sdig byas 'bras bu rnam gsum ste/ /sdug bsngal chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab/ /sna tshogs 'jigs pa char bzhin te/ /mi 'dod nyi so grib 'dra'o/ /yid 'ong thob dang dge rgyun 'phel/ /gang dang gar ④'gro mdun stong dang / /de dang der song 'dod dgu gsum/ /'di dag bsdom nas ④ mchod 'os 'bras/ /ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas chos rje shākya shrīs yul 'khor so sor byon pa'i tshe zhu ba po rnams kyi skal ba dang sbyar te zhar byung du brtsams shing gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa kha 'thor ba rnams rdzogs so// //dpal sa'i steng na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā byeb byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o // // rjo65—540
bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (144)65wa 542

༄ga /rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ dzi na mārga a ②ba tā ra/ bod skad du/rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang zhig bag la nyal ni bag chags bcas dang bdud dgra ma lus thams cad ni/ /gnyen po yang dag gzung ba'i stobs kyis nges bcom byang chub mchog ni rgyas ldan zhing / /kun mkhyen bde gshegs thugs rje bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin skyob pa rab ston mnga' bdag po/ /de dang bla ma mchog dang dge 'dun bcas la gus pas rtag par kun nas 'dud/ /gnyen po yongs su gzung ba yis/ /mi mthun phyogs de kun spang ①dang / /byang chub mchog ni rjortogs pa dang / /'gro ba'i don ni 'dod pa yis/ /rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa 'di/ /ji ltar lung bzhin mdor bsdus pas/ /rang gis rtogs par bya ba dang / /dge slong mkhas pa byams dpal bzang / /65—543

zhes bya chos kyi don gnyer ba/ /de yis gus par bskul ba dang / /rang nyid mchog tu goms 'phel phyir/ /rang gi shes rab kyis brtags brjod/ /spyod yul min la goms byas nas/ /don mchog rig ①pa ldan 'gyur ②te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa yis/ /tshod ma sbyin la'ang 'bad bzhin no/ / mdor na ①dal 'byor rnyed dka' dang / /mi rtag nyid dang sred ④sdug bsngal//thog med srid pa'i sdug bsngal kyi/ /mtsho las 'gro ba bsgral 'dod dang / /dpal ldan bla ma'i mtshan nyid dang / /byang sems bskyed dang sdom pa dang /⑤ /sdig bcu 'bras bu dang bcas dang / /bag med 'dod sred bud med chang / /bag la nyal dang de bzhin du/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs dang bdag med/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung 'khor lo dang / /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnams dang / /dam chos mnyan pa la sogs dang / /pha rol phyin bcu rnams gsungs pa/ /'jig rten pa dang don dam dang / /mi sdug rnam pa gsum dang ni/ /gzhan yang dbugs rngub 'byung rjes dran/ /spyor ba'i lam dang mthong ba'i lam/ /bsgom pa'i lam dang de bzhin du/ /khyad par lam zhes grags pa dang / /sa rnams yongs su sbyang ba dang / /yongs smin sku bzhi brjod pa dang / /de bzhin du ni smon lam ste/ /rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa 'di/ /mdo ru bsdus te yongs brjod na/ /'di ltar le'u sum cur ni/ /go rims bye bzhin du gnas pa yin/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las mdor bsdus kyi le'u zhes bya ba ste dang po'o// //mi yi dngos po rnyed par shin tu dka'/ /rab bsngags skye ba yongs su 65—544

'dzin pa dang / /rab bsngags yul dang 'tshe dang skrag pa med/ /nad med pa dang dbang po tshang gyur dang / /lang tsho ldan gyur nas kyang tshe ring ①dang / /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal chu bor g.yengs pas 'jigs/ /dka' tshegs med pa'i gos dang bza' la sogs/ /snying po yod med dpyod shes blo ldan dang / /sangs rgyas byon dang de yis ④chos gsungs dang / /chos thos 'dod cing mngon par brtson pa dang / /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bsnyen bkur dang / /thos don sems dang bsgom sogs shin tu dkon/ /de ltar ston pas gsungs te 'jig dus kyi/ /rlung gis cher g.yengs gcig gyur ④rgya mtsho yis/ /gnya' shing bu gar lo brgya nas 'thon pa'i/ /rus sbal mgrin pa chud ltar mi rnyed dka'/ /sngar bshad las ltos lhag par khyad par du/ /de de rim pa rim pas ④rnyed par dka'—/ /de phyir dal 'byor rin chen legs rnyed pa/ /mi yi lus kyi skyes bu'i don bsgrubs te/ /gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsams na/ /phyis ni gsungs pa'i dal 'byor ga la rnyed/ /bla ma'i bka' lung rang gi rigs chapa yis/ /blo dang ldan pas brtag cing dpyad par bya/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba brgyud pa'i rim pa'i le'u ste ṭuganyis pa'o// //skyes pa tsam nas skye 'gro yi/ /mdun na brtse ba med pa yi/ /'chi ba zhes bya'i 'dre chen gnas/ /shin tu bzlog dka' 'jigs par byed/ /ma dang pha dang bu dang ni/ /spun dang sring mo de bzhin du/ /chung ma gnyen bshes memadza' bo dang / /mi mdza' kun kyang gshin rjes gsod/ /byis pa rgan po gzhon nu dang / /dar ma dang ni mchog gzugs can/ /lang tsho ④can 65—545

dang lang tsho med/ /khrel med 'chi ①bas za ba'o/ /'khor los sgyur dang mi yi ni—/ /dbang po blun po la sogs dang / /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams dang / /nor rgyas la sogs klu rnams te/ /'di dag kun kyang 'chi bas zos bsam gtan can dang shes pa can/ /zhi dang thub dang snying rje mchog /gtong dang dge ba'i las can dang / /sna tshogs rig pa'i pha rol phyin/ /bde ldan rnyed ldan kha drag dang / /smra mkhas pa dang chos smra rnams/ /'chi ba yis ni 'joms pa ste/ /kun la gtong ba gang yang med/ /gcugs pa dang ni ngo yang med/ /dad pa can dang gus can med/ /sa mtshams dang ni rtog dpyod med—/ /gar yang 'chi bdag 'di ni 'byung / /snod dang sems can 'jig rten grags/ /dus gsum gyi ni khams gsum rnams/ /skyes pa nas bzung ②brlag gi bar/ /mdor na 'jigs pa'i rjes su phyogs/ /yid brtan mi rung 'chi bdag 'di/ /byas dang ma byas mi sdod 'dzoms/ /bde dang mi bde yid brtan med/ /gnam lcags chen po glo bur la④/ /gsod pa'i gnas su gsod bya ba'irngu/ /skyes bu stobs kyis khrid pa ltar/ /skye 'gro rnams ni skye tsam gyis—/ /de ni skad cig skad cig 'chi/ /dal 'byor rin chen rnyed dka' ste//rnyed kyang skad cig 'jig rang bzhin/ /de mthong yang ni ci nas ⑤rang / /'chi ba nyid du mi rtogs te/ /rgas med 'chi med bdag nyid du/ /go zhing lus can gsod pa ste/ /'dod dang gti mug 'jigs khro yis/ /bla ma dang ni phan 'dogs dang / /gang yang rung ste su yang gsod/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang yang / /yon tan can dang sdug phongs kyi/ /rdzas ni dogs pa med pas ⑥'phrog /longs spyod don du lha bzhin du/ /'dod pas log 65—546

par spyod pa rnams/ /rung dang mi rung rnam dpyod med①/ /gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnyed bzhin du/ /rten cing rab tu tshim par byed/ /brdzun ②dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang / /ngag 'khyal ba yi tshig dang ni/ /rol rtsed byed dang sems can ni—/ /pha rol sems la zug rngu byed/ /gzhan gyi nor la bdag por ni/ /'dod pa skyed par byed pa dang / /gzhan la gnod ④par sems par byed/ /chos dang chos min phyin ci log /'di ltar sdig pa byas kyang ni/ /rgas med 'chi ba med bzhin rol/ /shin tu lhung dhiste cher rtsub pa'i/ /dmyal ba mi bzad stsong bar 'gyur/ /mchog tu tshe ring mi rnams kyang / /tshe lo brgya pa yin par brjod/ /stong phrag sum cu rtsa drug gi/ /zhag la lo ni brgya yin te/ /de rnams nang nas gang rung ba'i/ /nyin zhag la ni nges par 'chi/ /kha cig mngal du 'chi bar 'gyur/ /kha cig skyes ma thag tu 'chi/ /skad cig 'jig pa'i rang bzhin du/ /chos rnams yang dang yang du bsam/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum po la/ /blo ldan 'bad pas skyabs su 'gro/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las mi rtag pa bstan phyepa'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// //spyir ni 'khor ba snyug bsngal gyi/ /phung por rab tu grags pa yin/ /skye dang rga dang na dang 'chi/ /de bzhin du ni ngan song gsum/ /sdug bsngal rang bzhin nyid du gsungs/ /'khor ba cis kyang 'byung ba yin/ /zhing las g.yo dang tshong dang ni/ /phyugs skyong ba yi sdug bsngal dang / /sdug pa dang bral sdug bsngal dang / /mi sdug dang phrad sdug bsngal dang / /'dod don ④btsal yang ma rnyed dang / /shin tu bkres skom snyug bsngal dang / /dbul 65—547

ba'i sdug bsngal shin tu che/ /dgra rnams sna tshogs sdug bsngal dang / /bsam pa ma grub nor zad dang / /grogs med sdug bsngal sdug bsngal nyid/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal chen po ni/ /dbang po lnga ni rgyas byed pa'i/ /dbang po'i spyod yul longs spyod kun/ /de bzhin rgyal bo dbang phyug sogs/ /khams gsum po ni ma lus kyi/ /mdor na zag bcas bde ba 'di/ /mthar ni 'bral bar 'gyur ba ste/ /'di ni sdug bsngal nyid yin no/ /nges par sdug bsngal 'di rnams kyi/ /nyer len rgyu ni sred pa ste/ /de bzlog pa yi ched du ni/ /chos kyi bdag med bsgom par bya/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal brjod pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// //thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba ru/ /las rlung shugs kyis gang 'khor ba/ /'di dag dal ba rnged par 'khor/ /sdug bsngal 'chi ba'i chos can de/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor bar ni/ /skye ba brgyud mar 'khor ba na/ /res 'ga' la lar gang la la/ /pha dang ma dang bu dang ni/ /snag gnyen sogs su brgya stong du / /'di la gang zhig ma gyur med/ /bu dang tsha bo sogs 'byel ba/ /nye 'khor gnyen dang rtsa lag rnams/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ru/ /byeng ba'i sems can bsgral ba'i phyir/ /nan tan kyis ni legs brtags nas/ /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsten/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las 'gro ba bsgral bar 'dod pa'i le'u ⑩ste lnga pa'o// //lta ba kun gye gnad shes shing / /snying po yod med rnam dpyod can/ /65—548

rtog ge'i bstan bcos kun don dang / /dbu ma'i don la rnam dag blo/ /rgyags min nga rgyal med pa dang / /snyoms shing mchog tu snying rje can/ /srid pa'i longs spyod don mi gnyer/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum la brten/ /gzhan las rnyed pa don mi gnyer/ /chog shes rang gi las la sems pha rol dpal dang rnyed pa dang / /bkur ste yon tan grags pa yis/ /bde dang ldan na shin tu dga'/ /mdo dang chos mngon 'dul ba yi/ /'gal ba'i don ni gsal byed cing / /bla ma brgyud ①pa'i rim pa yi/ /theg pa chen po'i don ston pa/ /brtan zhing dul la blo gros ldan/ /bzod ldan gsong por legs smra ba/ /tshul khrims 'chal yang lam la gnas/ /byas pa'i rtsang ba 'chos par byed/ /de la sogs te gsung rab las/ /gsungs pa'i bla ma'i mtshan nyid ldan/ /de 'dra'i dpal ldan bla mar bya/ /de las gzhan pa bdud kyi phyogs/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las ⑤dpal ldan bla ma'i mtshan nyid bstan pa'i le'u ste drug pa'o// //rnam dag tshes dang gza' la sogs/ /rjes su mthun pa kun bzung la/ /gus pas bla ma dkon mchog la/ /cho ga bzhin du mchod byas te/ /tha ma 'bring sogs dbye ba ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas sku ④cho ga yis/ /bla ma dang ni dkon mchog la/ /ci nus pa yi yon dbul bya/ /'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis skrag pa'i/ /yid kyis bstod cing phyag kyang bya/ /byang chub snying po ma thob bar//dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro/ /bla ma mchod pa la sogs pa'i④/ /thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ /tshe rabs 'di 'am gzhan dag tu/ /bdag 65—549

gis ma 'tshal sdig bkyis pa'am/ /bkyid du sprul ba nyid dang ni/ /gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te/ /rjes su yi rang gang bkyis pa/ /nongs pa de dag mthong bgyis nas/ /bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags/ /bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni/ /pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la/ /nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang / /yid kyis gnod bgyis gang lags dang / /nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i/ /sdog can bdag gis sdog pa gang / /shin tu mi bzad kyebagyis pa de/ /thams cad 'dren pa rnams la 'chags/ /sdig pa bshags pa'o/ /'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig /nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /slan chad bdag ni yang rngumi bgyid/ /mi byed par sdom pa'o/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ /'jig rten khams na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas byang sems de dag kun/ /dus gsum du ni byung rnams dang / /nyan thos bse ru sangs rgyas dang / /'phags min lus can rnams kyi ni/ /dus gsum bsod nams thams cad la/ /dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo / /bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /rjes su yi rang bgyis pa las/ /bsod nams dpag med gang skyes pa/ /dge des skye bo thams cad rnams/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob gyur cig /bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba'o/ /'jig rten khams brjod sangs rgyas gang / /dus gsum 'byung ba'i brtse can rnams/ /rnam pa kun du grags chapar ni/ /chos ni gsung zhing bstan tu gsol/ /bskul ba'o/ /yongs su mya ngan 'da' bzhed pa'i/ /skyob pa rtag par bzhugs su gsol/ /dam chos thos te pyasems can rnams/ /srid pa las ni phyir phyogs shog /gsol ba'o/ /65—550

mgon po khyod la thams cad du/ /nges par bdag nyid dbul bar bgyi/ /deng nas bzung nas bran nyid du/ /'khor ba'i 'jigs pas mchi bar bkyi/ /mgon po bla ma sangs rgyas dang / /byang chub sems ①kyis bdag bzung mdzod//mi 'jigs pa ni bdag la stsol②/ /deng nas 'gro ba'i don bgyi'o/ /bdag nyid dbul ba'o/ /de nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi/ /sems ni bla na med par bskyed/ /lung las gsungs pa'i cho ga yis④/ /sems ni rtse gcig dad byas la/ /'di lta ste/ phyogs bcu nam mkha' kun khyab pa'i/ /'jig rten khams na bzhugs pa yi/ /ji snyed bsangs rgyas thams cad dang / /de sras byang chub sems rnams dang / /'phags pa nyan thos byang chub gang / /'dren pa rang rgyal rnams dang ni/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po'i lha la sogs/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs pa'i/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba dam po las/ /sems can khams rnams bsgral phyir dang //rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob bya'i phyir/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims rnam pa gsum bsrungs te/ /sangs rgyas sbyor skyes sdom pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims ni/ /bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /deng nas brtsams nas gzung ⑤bar bgyi/ /de ltar sems ni bskyed nas kyang / /de nas de la mi mthun phyogs/ /chom rkun skabs tshol spang ba'i phyir/ /de la zhugs te sems kyis bsrungs bu/ /sgrib pa'i mun pa kun 'joms shing / /65—551

kun mkhyen ye shes byed pa po/ /gang la phan yon dpag med pa/ /thub pa skyes mchog gis gsungs shing / /dpal ldan kun du bzang spyod sogs/ /smon lam mtha' yas kyis bcings pas/ /rdo rje lta bur brtan pa ste/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i mchog /phun sum tshogs pa kun bskyed cing / /bdud ni thams cad 'jigs byed pa/ /sdug bsngal rgya mtsho kun skyob pa'i/ /rin thang med pa'i rin chen mchog /byang chub spyod 'jug la sogs su/ /bdag nyid chen po rnams kyis ni/ /sems can kun la brtse ba yis/ /mdor bsdus 1 gsungs pa rig par bya/ /ji ltar yid bzhin nor bu dang / /bum pa bzang po mi zad gter/ /dpag bsam shing gi myu gu ni/ /rnyed bzhin 'bad las ②bsrung bar bya/ /cho ga bzhin du sdom blangs na/ /byang chub smon pa ldan 'gyur te/ /stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pas/ /byang chub sems su rab tu grags—/ /sems bskyed ④pa ni gzhan don phyir/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dbye ba 'am/ /de bzhin lhan cig skye bar brjod—/ /nyon mongs la sogs kyis bsgribs phyir/ /de yi gzugs ni mi gsal ba'i/ /ma rig pa yi gzugs yin phyir/ /rnam par rig byed min zhes brjod—/ /sdom par brjod pa de yang ni/ /dkar po'i phyogs kyi rgyun yin no//thar pa'i cha mthun gnas pa ni/ /chung ngu la sogs dbye ba gsum/ /'dun pa lhan cig mtshungs ldan sems/ /dag cing bzang ba'i zhing sa bzhin/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs mchog yin d+ngha/ /skye zhing 'byung ba'i rten yin no/ /bsam pa rjes su zhugs pa'i sems/ /dag pa'i gser dang mtshungs pa ste/ /da ltar dang ni phyi nas kyang / /rnam pa kun du 'gyur ba med/ /lhag pa'i 65—552

bsam pa mtshungs ldan pa'i/ /dkar phyogs zla ba tshes pa bzhin/ /dge ba'i chos ni thams cad kyang / /gong nas gong du 'phel bar byed/ /las ni dang po par gnas la/ /rim pa bzhin du gsum gsungs pa/ /chung ngu 'bring dang chen po ste/ /thar pa'i cha dang mthun gyur pa'o①/ /sbyor ba'i lam dang mtshungs ldan pa'i/ /sems ni me dang 'dra ba ste/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi bud shing bsreg /rab tu sbyor ba 'phro phyir 'byung / /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin ldan pa//mi zad pa yi gter dang 'dra/ /'dod don kun gyis tshim byas kyang / /'dod don yongs su zad pa med/ /tshul khrims pha rol phyin ldan pa/ /rin chen 'byung gnas lta bur 'gyur/ /yon tan rin chen de dag kun/ /skye ba'i rten ni de yin no/ /bzod pa'i phar phyin rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sems ni rgya mtsho chen po bzhin/ /mi 'dod pa kun thog bab kyang / /rgyud la bde ba 'khrug mi 'gyur/ /brtson 'grus pha rol phyin ldan pas/ /rmad du byung ba'i rdo rje bzhin/ /yid ches mngon par brten kyepa ste/ /bdud kyi ris zhukyis mi phyed ④/pa'o/ /bsam gtan phar phyin rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sems ni ri rgyal lta bu ste/ /dmigs pa kun kyis g.yengs pa yi/ /bdag nyid che rnams mi bskyod pa'o—/ /shes rab pha rol phyin ldan pa/ /lha rdzas sman chen lta bu ste/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib pa'i nad/ /des ni kun du 'joms pa yin/ /thabs kun gyis ni phar phyin ldan/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen lta bu ste/ /kun nas rtag par thams cad du/ /sems can don ni yongs mi gtong / /smon lam dang ni mnyam ldan pa'i/ /sems ni yid bzhin nor bu bzhin/ /rton lam gyi ni nus pa yis/ /'bras bu smon ④pa 'phel ba nyid/ /stobs kyi pha rol phyin 65—553

ldan pa'i/ /sems ni nyi ma lta bu ste/ /rang gi gdul bya'i lo tog kun/ /yongs su smin pa nyid du byed/ /ye shes pha rol phyin ldan pa/ /glu dbyangs snyan pa sgogs pa bzhin/ /chos rnams yang dag bstan pas ni/ /sems can 'dun par byed pa ponyu/ /sems ni bcu po 'di rnams ni/ /rim pas sa ni bcu po zhuste/ /mthong lam bsgom lam zhes pa las/ /der ni gcig dang go rims bzhin/ /mngon par shes dang mtshungs ldan dang / /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po bzhin/ /thogs pa med pa'i mthu yis ni/ /sems can don kun byed pa nyid/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs ldan pa/ /bang mdzod dang ni mtshungs pa ste/ /bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyis/ /mdzod no nges par gnas pa nyid/ /byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams dang / /ldan pas spyod ①lam dang 'dra ba④/ /'phags pa'i gang zag ma lus pa/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba nyid/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong ldan pa ni/ /bzhon pa lta bur dgongs pa yin//zung 'jug lam du 'gro bas na/ /srid dang zhi bar mi rtsang nyid/ /gzungs ⑤dang spobs pa dang ldan pa/ /bkod ma'i chu dang 'dra ba ste/ /thos dang ma thos chos rnams kun/ /rtag par 'dzin cing ston pa'o/ /rim pa bzhin du brjod pa yi/ /sems ni lnga po 'di dag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sa la ni—/ /khyad par lam gyis bsdus pa'o/ /chos kyi sbyin pa dang ldan pa/ /kun dga'i sgra brnyan ༅lta bu ste/ /thar pa 'dod pa'i gdul bya la/ /kun dga'i tshig ni sgogs sprupar byed/ /'di ni byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sa dang 'byel te sangs rgyas sar/ /'jug sbyor ba yi lam gyes bsdus/ /de las gzhan yang gang zhig ni/ /bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam gyis ni/ /rjes zhugs 65—554

gang gā'i chu rgyun bzhin/ /snying brtse shes rab dbyer med cing / /gcig tu sbyor bas gzhan don byed/ /chos sku mngon par ldan pa yi/ /sems ni sprin dang 'dra bar 'dod/ /mtha' yas lus kyi sprul sprin byi①/ /sems can don byed rgyu nyid do/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi sas bsdus pa'i/ /sems 'di ⑤gnyis ni rim pa bzhin/ /sngon du gsung ba dngos gzhi'i skabs/ /phyi ma rjes kyi skabs su 'dod/ /'di ni 'jug pa byang chub kyi/ /sems kyi dbye bar gsungs pa yin/ /smon dang 'jug pa'i dbye ba yis/ /byang chub sems ni gnyis su gsal/ /gang nas bzung ste sems can khams/ /mtha' yas rab tu sgrim pa'i ④phyir/ /mi ldog pa yi sems kyis su/ /sems de yang dag blangs gyur pa/ /deng nas bzung ste ④gnyid log gam/ /bag med gyur kyang bsod nams shugs/ /rgyun mi 'chad par du ma zhig /nam mkha' mnyam par rab tu 'byung / /byang chub smon pa'i sems las ni/ /'khor tshe 'bras bu cher 'byung yang / /ji ltar 'jug pa'i sems bzhin du/ /bsod nams rgyun chags 'byung ba min/ /'di dag gis ni dge ba'i chos/ /zag bcas zag med thams cad kyis/ /lam 'bras dang bcas mtshan nyid rnams—/ /yang dag bsdus te ji bzhin gsungs/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i le'u ste bdun pa'o// //mchog tu dge ba bzung ba dang / /mi dge thams cad spangs pa ste/ /de yis sdom pa bzung ba ni/ /ji lta ba bzhin yongs su bsrungs/ /bstan pa'i sems kyis 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rjes su dran par bya/ /sdug bsngal 65—555

rgyu ni spang ba'i phyir/ /gnyen po yongs su gzung bar bya/ /de ni dge bsnyen bsnyen gnas dang / /dge tshul dang ni dge slong rnams/ /lnga dang brgyad dang bcu dang ni/ /thams cad spong zhing bsrung bar gzung ①/ /pho dang mo yi dbye ba yis/ /mdor na slar yang brgyad du dbye/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom zhes pa/ /'dul ba nyid du rgyas par spros/ /dge slong lus ni ④bsdams pa ste/ /dge slong ngag ni bsdams pa yin/ /dge slong yid ni bsdams pa ste/ /dge slong kun du bsdams pa yin/ /sdig pa thams cad mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /de dag nyid ni theg chen la/ /zhugs nas khyad par 'phags pa nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang / /ldan zhing de rnams so sor 'brang / /byang chub sems kyi babe+eb pa ni/ /mtha' yas thub pas gsungs pa rnams/ /byang chub spyod 'jug la sogs su/ /bsdus pa de rnams blta bar bya/ /mdor na byang chub sems rnams kyis/ /basbab pa sems can don bsgrub cing / /phung po la sogs chos rnams kyi/ /ngo bo nyid med rnam par bsgom/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa ma nyams pa/ /rab tu 'bad pas spyad par bya—/ /nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' ni/ /kun rdzob pa dang don dam ste/ /sdom pa blangs nas bsrung ba ni/ /kun rdzob pa ru 'dod pa yin/ /tshad med pa ni bzhi rnams la/ /bsnyen cing bsten pa don dam ste/ /sdug bsngal dang ni sdug bsngal gyi/ /rgyu las 'gro ba bsgral ①'dod nyid/ /de ni snying rje ④ chen por gsungs/ /ston ka'i zla 'od bzang bzhin no/ /'gro ba bla med bde ba la//sbyor bar 'dod pas byams pa nyid/ /nam mkha' kun ni mthar thug pa'i/ /65—556

in+d+ra be+e la'i 'od mnyam pa'o/ /gzhan la phan 'dogs la mkhas shing / /byang chub la phyogs sems can de/ /mthong nas tshim pa dga' mtshan nyid/ /pad+ma rā ga'i 'od dang mtshungs/ /rnyed pa la sogs 'jig rten chos/ /de dag kun la btang snyoms pa'i/ /ting 'dzin de bskyed rnal 'byor pa/ /btang snyoms pad+ma'i 'dab ma'i 'od/ /rang bzhin dang ni mtshan ma dang / /'bras bu dang mngon 'du sdebyed kyi/ /stong pa nyid kyi snying rje sogs/ /rim bzhin 'khyud par shes par bya/ /tshangs pa'i gnas ni bzhi po rnams/ /dbye ba rnam bzhi rtag ④bsgom bya/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo de yis/ /gal te 'khyud par ma gyur na—/ /'di dag zag pa dang bcas so/ /tshangs par spyod pa 'di gnyis ni/ /rgyal ba'i sras po rnams kyi'o/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan pa/ /bsgom zu pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /rang gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa/ /spong zhing dben par gnas pa 'i / /bza' ba la sogs pa rnams ni/ /srog bsrung tsam gyis chog shes pa/ /gsungs pa'i mtshan nyid 'di nyid ni/ /ldan pa'i mi de rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub lam ni dang ⑤po la/ /bsgom rjopa'i snod gyur ④gzhan du min—/ /'khor ba'i bde dang longs spyod ni/ /sred pa nyid du sred par byed//de yis rnam g.yengs ⑧sems kyis ni/ /lam la goms pa shin tu ring / /thos bsam rab 'phel las byung zhing / /sred dang srid pa rnams spong ba/ /thar pa'i cha mthun dge ba ste/ /de thob thub ⑨sras chung ngu'o/ /bsgom pa'i lam ni rnam gnyis te/ /so so'i skye dang 'phags pa yi/ /dbye ba zag bcas zag med do/ /mthong ba zhes bya zag pa med/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las sdom pa brjod pa'i le'u ste brgyad pa'o// //65—557

'di ltar skyes pa'i rin chen sems/ /bsrung ba ru ①ni 'dod pa yis/ /phan dang mi phan dngos po ni/ /rim bzhin blang dor shes par bya/ /dor bya'i dbye ba rang bzhin dang / /bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba'o/ /kha na ma tho mi dge'i las/ /phye nas phye ste bshad par bya/ /rang bzhin kha na ma tho nyid/ /mi dge bcu po 'di dag ste/ /rnam smin mi bzad sdug bsngal nyid/ /de dag rnam par spang bar bya/ /srog gcod pa ⑤ni ma 'khrul par/ /bsams bzhin srog chags gsod pa'o/ /ma byin len pa gzhan gyi nor/ /mthu dang 'jab bus bdag gis 1byed/ /bgrod min bgrod par dhi'adod pa yi/ /log par g.yem pa rnam pa bzhi/ /brdzun tshig 'du shes gzhan bsgyur ba'i/ /tshig don mngon ⑤par go ba'o/ /mig rna duyid kyi rnam shes dang / /gsum byis nyams su pyong gang de/ /mthong thos rnam par shes pa dang / /rtogs pa yin te rim bzhin bshad/ /phra ma pha rol dbye ba'i phyir/ /nyon mongs can gyi sems kyi tshig /tshig rtsub po ni mi snyan pa/ /nyon mongs can kun kyal ba ⑦yin/ /gzhan yang nyon mongs can sems kyi/ /kha gsag glu dang rol mor bcas/ /bstan bcos ngan pa'i tshig yin no/ /brnab sems gzhan nor log par chag2 /gnod sems ⑨can la sdang ba'o/ /dge dang mi dge med ⑩lta ba/ /log par lta ba yin 'di la/ /gsum mam ⑪bdun ni las kyang yin/ /de la rnam smin thams cad du/ /dmyal bar yongs su brjod pa ste/ /rgyu ⑫mthun rgyu 'bras mthun par ni/ /sa steng nyid du stsong bar byed/ /bdag pos phyi yul 'dod pa'i don/ /phyin ci log tu 'byung ba'o/ /sdug bsngal phyir dang gsad phyir 65—558

dang / /gzi byin med phyir 'bras rnams ①gsum/ /sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes rnams kyis/ /gnas skabs go rims ④bzhin du'o/ /rgyu mthun srog gcod pa yis ni/ /tshe thung lus la nad zug ste/ /ma byin par ni blangs pa yis /dbul por 'gyur zhing rgyal po dang / /chom rkun sogs kyis nor zad byed/ /'dod pas log par g.yem rnams kyis/ /chung ma ④gzhan la 'phyo bar 'gyur/ /brdzun ④du smra bas skur pa 'debs/ /phra mas grogs dang dbye bar 'gyur/ /tshig rtsub brjod pas mi snyan thos/ /ngag 'khyal byus ni legs bshad kyang / /mi len gzhan gyi bzhad ⑤gad rgyu/ /brnab sems kyis ni 'dod chags dag /drag cing longs spyod zad par 'gyur/ /gnod sems kyis ni zhe sdang drag /lus kyang ngan pa nyid yin no/ /gti mug drag pya cing lta ba ngan/ /log par lta ba'i 'bras bur grags/ /'di ni rgyu mthun 'bras bu'o/ /bsad ④pas phyi rol dngos po rnams/ /'bras bu bcud chung la sogs pa/ /ma byin blangs pas thog sge'abab cing / /rdul gyis rab tu gang ba nyid/ /'dod pas log par g.yem pa yis/ /phyogs kun rdul gyis khyab pa nyid/ / brdzun du smra bas rmyethams cad du/ /dngos po thams cad dri mi zhim/ /phra ma'i tshig gi 'bras bu ni—/ /shin tu mtho dang dma' ba nyid/ /tshig rtsub smras pa las byung ⑫ba/ /sa ni chu med tsha sgo can/ /ngag 'khyal ⑩smras pa las byung ⑫ ba/ /dus tshigs rnams ni log par 'byung / /brnab sems kyis ni 'bras bu phra/ /gnod sems kyis ni 'bras bu rtsub/ /'bras med pa'am 'bras bu chung / /log par lta ba las byung ba'i⑫/ /lhan skyes kha na ma tho ba/ /'bras bcas gsungs pa de smad pa'o/ /'di ni bdag po'i 'bras bu'o/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 65—559

'jug pa las mi dge ba rmyebacu brjod pa'i le'u ste dgu pa'o// //bag med la dga' skye bo gang / /'di ni thar pa'i snod ma yin/ /bag med dug gis brgyal ba ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa shin tu ring / /dgra bo 'jigs pa cher byed pa/ /bag med dang mnyam 'ga' yang med/ /gang yang bag med dbang song ba/ /dmyal ba ru ni thong ⑧bar 'gyur/ /bag med rab ldan mi dag ni/ /rtse zhing dogs med sdig pa spyod/ /de nas mi bzad dmyal bar ltung / /rtag par bag yod mi rnams ni/ /bsod nams ye shes pha rol phyin—/ /mchog tu zhi ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /de yi 'jigs pa thams cad zad—/ /gang zhig mi bdag thob nas kyang / /bag med pa la mi 'jug cing / /de las gzhan du bzlog pa ni/ /de ni mkhas pa zhes su brjod/ /sngon du bde ba ltar rtogs nas/ /bag med pa la rjes su 'jug /bag med las byung 'bras bu 'thob/ /phyi nas ①nges par de gdung 'gyur/ /dgra mang yid du mi 'ong dang / /grags pa ngan zhing shin tu 0da/ /tshogs pa'i nang du sma ④'bab cing / /bag med ldan pa sdug bsngal snod/ /kun du rtag par las kun la/ /bag med mchog tu nyes pa ste/ /gang yang nyin dang mtshan mo ru/ /de la dge ba rdzogs mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das bde ba/ /cung zad gang yod bag med des/ /rlag par byed par dogs nas ni/ /de nas de ni spang bar bya/ /bag med 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ste/ /bag yod mchog tu 'gro ba'o/ /de bas bag med spangs pa de/ /kun du rtag par bde bar 'gyur/ /bag med brgya yis bcings pa ni/ /yul gyi rgya mtshos g.yengs pa nyid/ /srid pa'i 65—560

sgog gis bcings pa yi/ /lha rnams dpag tu med par rtse/ /skyes pa tsam gyis lha yi ①ni/ /bde ba skad cig rim pas 'dzad②/ /bag med pa yis brgyal ba rnams/ /skad cig zad par mi shes so/ /rtag tu yul la rol pa rnams—/ /yid ni ④bag med kyis g.yengs 'khrul/ /'dod pa'i bde bas chog shes med/ /de yis bulha rnams sdug bsngal nyid/ /'dod pa'i rim gyes ⑤'khrul pa yi/ /lha rnams bag med mun pas gtibs rjo/ /'byor pa g.yo zhing srog kyang ni/ /mthar kyang 'jigs par mi shes so/ /thog mar grogs po gzhan ⑦du mthong / /phyi nas dgra bo bzhin du 'gyur⑧/ /lus can rnams kun bag med kyis/ /nya rnams lcags kyus brlag bzhin no/ /lha dang lha min mi rnams dang / /klu rnams la ni khyad par du/ /kun du don med byed par mthong / /bag med pas ni dgra bo mchog /srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyis skrag cing / /rang dang mdza' bo 'chi bsams te/ /sems can kun la brtse ba yis//bag med yang dag rab tu sel/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las bag med pa'i nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu pa'o// //'dod pa rnams la 'dod mi bya/ /'dod pa yis ni kun du bslus/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba drag po ste/ /kun kyang dmyal ba'i rgyu rnams so/ /'di la chags dang 'dod pa gang / /de yi ④sdug bsngal mtha' yas so/ /'dod pa'i sbrul gyis zin pa la/ /zhi ba'i rgyu ni gang yang med/ /chags pas bslus pa'i sems can rnams/ /zhe sdang yongs su 'bar ba ste/ /gti mug dbang du gyur pa yis/ /tshig rtsub po ni smra ba yin/ /gtum pa las byung gtum pa ste/ /65—561

gyur pa dang ni drag gtum nyid/ /'dod pa dug gi me 'dra ste/ /rab tu 'bad pas spang bar bya/ /so so'i skye bo dbang po ni/ /dbang po'i don la zhen byas te/ /'dod pa 'di ni byis pa yi/ /yid 'phrog byed cing dmyal bar ltung / /'dod chags me ni bsreg bya yi/ /yul tsam gyis ni tshim mi 'gyur—/ /de bzhin du ni dbang po yang / /yul las zhen pa tshim pa med/ /rtsol bas me ni 'byung ba ste/ /ma 'phrad ①par ni 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mi rnams kyi ni 'dod pa'i me/ /phrad dam ②ma phrad kyang ni skye/ /me ni ring na 'tshig mi byed—/ /'dod me ring yang bzod par dka'/ /dug ni zos pas 'chi ba ste//'dod chags dran pas 1 yis kyang 'joms/ /kun rtog las byung shing la ni/ /'dod pa'i rlung gis sbar ba ni/ /go la la sogs zhen chags kyi/ /mar blugs me yis shin tu bsregs/ /'byung po rnams ni sun par byed/ /mes ni mchog tu sreg byed de/ /chags med ④shin tu rno yang nadhi/ /mi rnams sun par mi byed do/ /da rte ltar byung ba'i 'dod pa ni/ /skyon dang bcas la khyad par du/ /mi rmongs bde bar gnas pa gang / /de ni brtan pa zhes su brjod//rlung gis bskyod pa'i shugs rlabs kyis/ /shin tu g.yo ba'i chu zla dang / /dbu ba lta bur snying med la/ /mkhas pa su zhig dga' bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog byung nas 'dod chags te/ /de nas zhe sdang rab tu skye/ /zhe sdang khong khros skye bo ni/ /de nas dmyal ba nyid du 'gro/ /de bas ri bo nyams dga' zhing / /sna tshogs ljon shing yod pa ru/ /brten ⑦cing nges pas ⑧bsam gtan bya/ /'dod pa'i kun 'byung mdzad pa yin/ /nges par skyon rnams 'di kun gyi/ /dang po'i byed mkhan ma rig nyid/ /de phyir ma rig gzhom bya 65—562

ste—/ /de yi ngo bo rnams ①dpyad bya/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las 'dod pa'i nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu gcig pa'o// //'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad kyi/ /'phel bar byed pa sred pa nyid//de phyir sdug bsngal zhi 'dod pas/ /de bas sred pa mkhas pas gzhom/ /dmyal ba'i me bas sred pa yi/ /me nyid shin tu bsran par dka'/ /lus ngag yid ni nges sred ②byed/ /dmyal ba'i me ni de lta min/ /khams gsum pa yi rjes 'jug cing / /jog ma med pa'i las gsum ni/ /'bar med dus gsum du 'byung ba/ /sred med zhes bya gzhan yin no/ /mtho ris 'dod chags me yis bsreg /dud 'gro zhe sdang gis bsreg ste/ /gti mug me yis ngan song bsreg /sred me kun gyis sreg ④byed do/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i me dud ni—/ /kun du rtog pa'i shing las byung / /'dod pa'i me yis 'jig rten bsreg /shing byung me yis ④de lta min/ /'dod pa'i sbrul gyis zin pa gang / /de dag sos par 'gyur ba med/ /'dod pa bsten dang bsgoms phyepa yis/ /phyir zhing de nyid 'phel bar 'gyur/ /ji ltar me yis bsreg dhibya thob/ /'phel bar 'gyur ba de bzhin 'di/ /'dod pa'i me ni 'phel ba na/ /bzlog par nus pa ma yin no/ /'khor lo bzhi 'khrul 'jig rten ni/ /'dod pas yongs su bslus pa nyid/ /thog med zag med 'jig rten la/ /'dod pa lta bu'i dgra med do/ /'dod pas bskul ba'i mi rnams ni/ /rgya mtsho drag shul can du 'jug /mtshon cha sbas pa'i g.yul ngo ni/ /zab mor rab tu 'jug pa'o / /'dod pa yis ni sa skyong yang / /phan tshun nges par gsod pa ste/ /65—563

spun dang spun ni lhan cig tu/ /pha dang bu yang phan tshun no/ /dug can mda' yis phog pa yi/ /ri dwags gang du rjes su rgyug /der ni dug de nyid 'gro ste/ /de bzhin sred dug mi la'o/ /sdug bsngal can gyi yi dwags rnams/ /yi dwags longs spyod la rgyug ste/ /dmyal ba dmyal ba nyid du ni/ /da ①ni sred pas cher bskul ba'o/ /yun du lha yi bde ba ni/ /spyad pa'i lha rnams lha yul nas/ /sred pa'i zhags pas drangs nas ni/ /slar yang dmyal bar ltung ba'o—/ /bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang ni/ /yon tan can dang btsun mo'i nor—/ /gnyis skyes sogs dang sdug phongs kyi/ /nor ni 'dod can 'phrog ⑧par byed/ /skye 'gro kun ni brtse med pas/ /sdig pa thams cad byed pa yin/ /nor de bor nas 'gro ba ste/ /shi nas sdig dang lhan cig 'brang / /de nas dmyal ba la sogs pa'i/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal de 'byung 'gyur/ /drag shul skyob pa rnged pa de/ /las de yis ni myong bar 'gyur/ /sred pa'i yul ni nges grol zhing / /chags pa'i sol me rnam spangs pa/ /rdo dang rin chen mnyam pa ni—/ /mya ngan 'das la bde bar 'gyur/ /blo ldan ye shes chu yis ni/ /'dod pa'i me ni 'bad de gzhom/ /'dod pa ma bkum pa la ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa shin tu ring / /skad cig dga' ste shes par dka'/ /rnam par smin pa me dang mtshungs/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i bde 'dod pas/ /de phyir sred pa nges gzhom bya/ /sred pa'i zhags pas rnam grol zhing / /chags dang ①zhe sdang spangs pa ④dang / /sdig pa'i dri ma bral ba yi/ /mkhas pa rnams ni pya ngan bral/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las sred pa'i nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu gnyis pa'o// //65byed564

med ngag nyan mi dag ni/ /tshogs pa ru ni bzhad gad rgyu/ /bud med rnams ni don med chags/ /g.yo dang ser sna che ba ste/ /'jig rten gnyis su rlag byed pa/ /skyes pa rnams la nye bar gnas/ /chags las skyes ①pa'i rnam 'gyur tshig /'jam zhing stsos byed rnam par lta/ /de yi snying ni gzhan du ste/ /yongs su brjod pa gzhan du'o/ /'jam zhing sgrum la reg bde yang / /'dzin ②na rdo rje lta bu ste/ /phan byas bkur byas mi dran zhing / /dri ma can gyi bsam pa'o—/ /gos dang zas dang lus rgyan sogs/ /ster ba'i gzhon nu yid 'ong ba④—/ /rang gi bdag po bor nas ni/ /byes ④mi la ni 'gro bar byed/ /gang du 'gro ba'i grogs de la/ /bud med dga' bar byed pa ste/ /gnas pa'i skyes pa myur myur ba/ /'di ni spong bar byed pa yin/ /ji lta bung ba me tog gi/ /bcud zad nas ni song ⑤ba ltar/ /de bzhin skyes rjopa nor zad nas—/ /bud med kyis ni spong bar byed/ /ral gri'i snying ste rtsub cing g.yo/ /sdig pa'i mun pas bsgribs pa ste/ /bud med skyes pa brlag bya'i phyir/ /skyes te rgyu gzhan ci yang med/ /lha rnams la yang bud med kyi/ /'ching ba las dam gzhan med de/ /bud med 'ching bas nges bcings pa/ /phyi nas dmyal bar ltung ba'o/ /bud med kyis ni byis pa ⑦las/ / sgyu gsog ④khram ni mngon pa'am/ /bud med chags pa ⑪ rmongs pa'i mi/ /rmongs pa'i phyir na mi rig go/ /blo gtad skyes pa slu brid kyi/ /'bad pa yis ni bcings nas kyang //longs spyod kyi ni bcud 'phrog ste/ /bur shing bzhin du 'jibs nas 'dor/ /65byed565

skyes pa thabs kun 'chang bas ni/ /rnam pa kun gyis yongs bsrungs kyang / /bud med dbang du bya bar ni/ /thams cad du ni mi nus so/ /yid 'ong tshig gis ①skyes pa rnams/ /ri dwags bzhin du rmongs ④byed cing / /phyi nas rgad par gyur pa ni④/ /mi gtsang thal ba bzhin du spong / /phan byas mi dran bkur byas nas④/ /de bzhin dbang phyug byams byas pa/ /khyod la rgud pa nyer gnas na/ /bud med kyis ni mi dran no/ /me tog rnying pa spangs nas ni//bung ba bzhin du rgyug pa ste/ /de bzhin khyo ni rgud pa la/ /mo la brtse rjodang ngo tsha med/ /snying dga' bar ni mi ⑦nges shing / /nges pa med cing snying bzang dang / /g.yo zhing byed pa yid du 'ong / /nga rgyal can ni thams cad du/ /ji ltar dug 'dres sbrang bzhin spang ⑦/ /bud med phal cher sdog bsam can/ /srid pa'i bang mdzod 'ching ba rnams/ /mi mthun thams cad 'byung ba'i phyir/ /thar pa 'dod pas shin tu spang / /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las bud med kyi nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu gsum pa'o// //gang ni skyon kun byed pa nyid/ /chang ni btung bar mi bya ste/ /de yis bag med kyang 'byung zhing / /khyad par du ni yon tan 'joms/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gnyi mug rnams/ /cher ni shin tu 'bar byed pa'o/ /'jig rten bzhad gad le lo dang / /ngag skyon kun dang nor zad byed/ /blo gtad med cing brdzun tshig dang / /rnam 'khrul ④bya ba nyams pa nyid/ /blo ni g.yo zhing lus dbang med/ /nang dang blo ni rgud pa dang / /ngo tsha med cing khrel med pa/ /rtsod cing pha rol kun smod dang / /nges pa med pa'i bya ba nyid/ /65byed566

de bzhin sdig pa spyod pa ste/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du/ /mi bzad sdug bsngal cher byed pa'o/ /'di dag la sogs nyes 'byung bas/ /de bas chang ni rnam par spang / /gang dang gang gis ①babe+eb pa'i gzhi/ /ji ltar thub pas bcas pa gang / /rgya cher bcas pa de nyams na/ /de ni kha na ma tho ba'o/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las chang gi nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu bzhi pa'o// //mang du brjod pas ci zhig bya/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs nyid/ /nyes pa kun gyi rten 'di rnams/ /rab tu 'bad pas gzhom par bya/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs 'byung / /'du byed rnams las dge sogs dang / /de las 'khor ba'i phung po 'di/ /mtshan nyid sdug bsngal rab tu skye/ /bag la nyal drug rtsa ba ste/ /'dod chags khong khro nga rgyal lta/ /ma rig the tshom nyon mongs te/ /'di la 'dod chags rnam pa gnyis/ /'dod pa'i 3khams kyi 'dod chags te/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags zhes su brjod/ /gzugs dang gzugs med gyur pa ni/ /srid pa'i chags pa'o lta bu ni/ /bdag dang bdag gi rtag chad dang / /med dang dman la mchog lta dang / /rgyu min lam min de 1lta ba/ /de rnams lta ba lnga yin no/ /nyon mongs bcu ni khams gsum du/ /dgu bcu rtsa brgyad du bye ba/ /'di dag 'phags pa'i bden bzhi ni/ /mthong dang bsgom dulam rnams kyis spong / /'di rnams rgya cher spros nas ni/ /mthong lam skabs su mngon par brjod/ /'di ni mi mthun phyogs kyi ni/ /gnas skabs tsam du brjod pa yin/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las 65—567

bag la nyal ba'i nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bco lnga pa'o// //khro dang khon 'dzin g.yo phrag dog /'chab dang 'tshig dang ser sna dang //sgyu dang rmugs dang nyes rtsom dang / /ngo tsha med dang khrel med dang / /thob 'jal dang ni tshul 'chos dang / /kha gsag rnyed pas rnyed 'dod dang / /gzhogs 1slong zhes bya 'di dag ni/ /log par 'tsho ba lnga rnams so/ /skyon zlos rgyags dang snungs snemed dang / /zhen dang yongs su zhen nyid dang / /yid la mi byed mi bzod dang / /chags dang mi rigs chags pa dang / /snyom ①pa dang ni chos min chags/ /zhum dang zas mi 'dod pa dang / /thob 'dod dang ni 'dod 'dun ④dang / /gnod sems dang ni rgod 'gyod dang / /rmugs dang gnyid dang sdig 'dod dang / /le lo dang ni 'dod chen dang / /bka' blo mi bde tshul med dang / /skye bo ngan mtshungs mi dga' dang / /rtog pa'i skye pyib bzhi dang ni/ /nga rgyal dbye ba bdun du shes/ /the tshom rnams ni nye nyon mongs/ /dri ma 'di rnams spang bya'o/ /nye ba'i nyon mongs pa mdor bstan pa'o/ /khro ba sems rab 'khrugs bupa ste/ /'khon ④'dzin de dang rab 'byel nyid/ /sems kyi gya gyu g.yo yin te/ /gzhan skyid mi bzod phrag dog go//rang skyon sgrib pa du'achab pa'o/ /'tshig pa snyig pa ⑨zhen pa nyid/ /ser sna rab tu mi gtong ⑫ba'o/ /sgyu ni pha rol slu ba'o/ /non pa spobs pa nyams gyur pa'o/ /nyes rtsom khros pas non pa'o/ /ngo tsha med dang khrel med pa/ /rang dang gzhan la mi 'dzem pa'o/ /thob kyis 'jal ba rnyed pa'i phyir/ /mngon sum gzhan la smod byed pa'o/ /tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur ste'i phyir/ /65byed568

dbang po sdom par byed pa ste/ /kha gsag rnyed dang bkur ste'i phyir/ /tshig 'jam sngar ni smra ba'o/ /rnyed pas rnyed pa rnams 'dod pa/ /sngar thob pa la bsngags ①byed pa'o/ /gzhan rmi rdzas la mngon zhen pas/ /gzhan gyi rdzas la bsngags ①byed pa/ / gzhogs slong ①nyid de lnga 'di dag /log pas 'tsho bar 'dod pa'o/ /skyon zlos gzhan khros sems la ni/ /gsos 'debs pa la brjod pa'o/ /rgyags pa dregs pa'o snungs dumed ni/ /sems ni rtog ⑤par gyur pa'o/ /zhen pa kun nas dkris pa chung / /'dod pa'i 'dod chags las byung ba'o/ /yongs su zhen pa 'dod pa la/ /kun nas dkris pa che ba'o/ /yid la mi byed don rnams la/ /sems kyi sor rtog ⑥med pa'o/ /mi bzod gnod pa byed pa dang / /sdug bsngal dag kyang mi bzod pa'o/ /chags pa rang gi rdzas la ni/ /chags pa'i 'dod chags ldan pa'i yid/ /gzhan rmi rdzas la zhen pa ni/ /ma ⑦rigs chags pa zhes bya'o/ /snyem ④pa rtsom pa med pa'i lus—/ /sgyid lug don gyi le lo'o/ /spang bya bud med la chags pa/ /chos la ④chags pa zhes 'dod do/ /rang gi yon tan bskyed nas kyang / /sems dman zhum pa yi chad pa'o/ /zas mi 'dod pa bza' drags pas/ /lus mi bde ba yin par brjod/ /thob 'dod bdag nyid ci nas kyang / /yon tan yang dag ldan zhes brjod/ /'dod 'dun ⑫yon tan lnga rnams la/ /'dod pa don du gnyer ba yin/ /gnod sems brlag par smon pa yis/ /gzhan la gnod par sems pa'o/ /lus sems rab tu ma zhi nyid/ /rgod par yang dag rab tu brjod/ /'gyod pa ngan byas phyi nas ni/ /yang dag rab tu gdung 'gyur ba'o/ /rmugs pa lus sems phyi ba yis/ /las la sbyor bar mi nus nyid//65—569

gnyid ni rnam shes dbang po la/ /'dus pa gnyid ces brjod pa'o/ /sdog 'dod yon tan med bzhin du/ /yon tan ldan par tshul 'chos pa'o le lo las la sun skyo bas/ /lus sems bying ba nyid yin no/ /'dod chen rab tu brkam tūpa ste/ /dpal ldan chog shes las 'da' ba'o/ /bka' blo mi bde gang gsungs pa/ /chos la smod ②pa'i tshig yin no/ /tshul med slob dpon bla ma yi/ /bya ba rnams la mi gus pa'o/ /bla mar gus pa nyams pa nyid/ /'di ni skye na mtshungs pa'o/ /sems ni 'dod sogs la zhen pas/ /brtan ①nyams pa ni mi dga' ba'o/ /nye du dang 'byel rtog pa ni/ /nye du la byams 'du shes so/ /de bzhin yul sred de don du/ /de yi yon tan brjod pa'o/ /de bzhin mi 'chir rtog pa gang ④// /'chi ba'i 'jigs pas mi dogs pa'o/ /rjes rnams rig dang ldan rtog ni/ /bdag nyid ci nas gzhan dag gis/ /yon tan bdog pa'i rnam pa yis/ /bla mar byed par 'gyur snyam pa'o/ /gzhan rjes chags dang ldan pa yi/ /rnam rtog gang yin gzhan dag la/ /chags dang gnod sems dregs ⑤pa yis/ /phan dang mi phan rnams rjosems pa'o—/ /kun du brtags pa'i khyad par gyis/ /gang gis ci nas yid kyi ni/ /rnam shes 'jug pa nga rgyal lo/ /'di ni thun mong nyid yin no/ /dman pas dman pa nga rgyal te/ /rang las dman las dman snyam pa/ /nga rgyal nyid du nges pa'o/ /dman pa nyid dang bdag nyid ni/ /mnyam snyam pa yang ⑦nga rgyal te—/ /dman pa las bdag lhag snyam pa'i/ /blo de yang ni nga rgyal nyid/ /mnyam dang bdag nyid mnyam snyam pa/ /mnyam pa yi ni nga rgyal lo/ /khyad 'phags pa dang bdag mnyam par/ /zlas pa lhag pa'i nga rgyal lo/ /khyad 65—570

'phags las bdag khyad 'phags blo/ /nga rgyal las kyang nga rgyal lo/ /gar yang bdag ni dgos med ces/ /dman pa'i nga rgyal nyid yin no/ /ngo bo nyid stong nyer len gye/ /phung po lnga la bdag blo gang / /nga'o snyam du zlas pa ni//de ni nga'o snyam par bshad/ /bsam gtan dang ni de 'bras bu/ /ma thob pa yang bdag gis ①ni/ /thob pa nyid du rtog pa de/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal zhes su brjod/ /log pa'i lam la sems chags pas/ /mi 'dod 'bras bu gang zhig la/ /bden pa'i las kyi ⑤dngos por rtogs/ /de ni log pa'i nga rgyal brjod—/ /tha dad 'du shes 'du shes gang / /chags sdang myun gyis bsgribs pa'o—/ /bden dang dkon mchog gsum sogs la/ /blo rnams ⑦gnyis ni the tshom mo/ /'di dag nye ba'i nyon mongs te/ /lnga bcu rtsa bdun rab tu brjod/ /phran tshegs gzhir ④ni drangs ⑤pa rnams/ /thar pa 'dod pas spang bar bya/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las nye ba'i nyon mongs pa'i nyes dmigs brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu drug pa'o// //'di dag chos kyi bdag med pa/ /rtogs pas bag chags bcas pa rnams//rab tu spang pe ngo yang na ni/ /rten cing 'byel par 'byung ba rnams/ /yang dag par ni mthong bas so/ /yang na 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ /yang dag mthong zhing phung po sogs/ /stong pa nyid du goms pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la bsgom pas ⑦spong / /phung po 'di spangs gzhan du ni/ /nying mtshams tsasbyor bar byed pa gang / /phung po rnams las gzhan pa'i bdag /srid pa'i lam du 'gro ba med/ /byed pa po dang las rnams dang / /de 'bras spyod dang 65—571

rtag pa la/ /de ni byed po za ba'o①/ /bya ba'i nus pa bral ba nyid/ /phung po bdag min bdag la ni/ /phung po mi ldan bdag gi ni/ /phung po ma yin bdag kyang ni/ /phung po la ni gnas ma yin/ /gzhan gyis yongs su brtags pa nyid/ /brtags phyir bdag tu rigs ma yin/ /phung po bdag la ④'byel med do/ /de dag rnam par 'gal bas so/ /sngon dang phyi ma gcig pa'i gzugs—/ /mi rtag dang 'byel ga la srid/ /'on te 'byel na rtag pa yang / /mi rtag bdag nyid du ni 'gyur/ /mi rtag pa yang rtag nyid du/ /rtag tu 'byel pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de ltar dpal ldan 'phags pa ni/ /klu sgrub ④zhabs kyis gsungs pa ste/ /myu stegs can gyis gang brtags pa'i/ /bdag de rigs ④pas rnam dpyad na/ /phung po kun gyi nang rnams ni/ /gang zhig nas kyang rnyed min te⑤/ /phung po rnams yod de rtag bumin/ /de yang bdag gi ngo bo min/ /gang yang rtag dang mi rtag ⑦dag /rten dang brten pa'i ngo bor med/ /phung po tsam zhig bdag tu ni/ /'dod pa nyid ni mi 'gegs te/ /de nyid sbom dang dgar la sogs/ / da rung ④rlom pas 'phel ba nyid/ /de yang sgyu ma ltar brjod de/ /gang phyir rnam dpyad spyod yul min/ /rnam par spyod ⑨pa rgya che'i phyir/ /'dir ni bdag gis ⑩ma spros te/ /de yi don ni rtog ge dang / /dbu ma'i bstan bcos dag na yod/ /chos dang gang zag dbye ba yis—/ /bdag med rnam pa gnyis su 'dod/ /dbu ma la ni 'jug pa ru/ /zla grags zhabs kyis gsungs pa ni/ /bdag med 'di ni 'gro ba rnam grol phyir//chos dang gang zag dbye bas rnam gnyis gsungs/ /de nyid rnam mang phye ste slar yang ni/ /de ltar gdul bya rnams la ston pas gsungs/ /spros dang bcas 65—572

nas stong pa nyid/ /bcu drug bshad de mdor bsdus nas/ /be+er yang bzhi ①ru bshad pa ste/ /de dag theg pa chen por 'dod/ /gang phyir de yi rang bzhin te①/ /yin phyir mig ni mig gis stong / /de bzhin rna ba sna dang lce/ /lus dang yid kyang brjod par bya/ /ther zug gnas min 'jig min nyid/ /nye bar bzung ④ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /mig sogs drug po gang yin pa/ /nang stong nyid du de 'dod do/ /gang phyir de yi rang bzhin de/ /yin phyir gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong / /de bzhin sgra ro dri dang chos/ /reg bya'i bar du'ang shes par bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa dngos med pa/ /phyi rol stong pa nyid du 'dod—/ /gnyi ga'i ngo bo stong pa ni/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yin no/ /chos rnams rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /mkhas pas stong pa nyid ces brjod/ /stong nyid de yang stong pa ni/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor 'dod/ /stong nyid stong pa nyid brjod pa/ /stong nyid stong pa nyid 'dod de/ /stong nyid dngos po'i blo can gyi/ /'dzin pa bzlog phyir gsungs pa yin/ /sems can snod kyi 'jig rten ni/ /ma lus pa la khyab byed phyir/ /tshad med dpe med mu mtha' ni/ /med phyir phyogs rnams chen po nyid/ /phyogs rnams bcu nyid 'di dag kyang / /phyogs kyi stong pa nyid de ni/ /chen po stong pa nyid du gsungs/ /chen por 'dzin pa bzlog phyir ro/ /de ni dgos pa mchog yin phyir/ /don dam mya ngan 'das pa yin/ /de ni de yis stong nyid gang / /de ni don dam stong nyid de—/ /myang 'das dngos blo can rnams kyi/ /dngos por 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir/ /don dam pa yi stong pa nyid/ /don dam mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin—/ /rkyen las byung phyir khams gsum po/ /'dus byas yin par nges 65—573

par brjod/ /de ni de yis stong nyid gang / /de ni 'dus byas stong nyid gsungs—/ /gang la skye gnas mi rtag nyid/ /de dag med pa 'dus ma byas/ /de ni de yis stong nyid gang / /'dus ma byas stong nyid du gsungs/ /gang la mtha' ni yod min pa/ /de ni mtha' las 'das par brjod/ /de ni de nyid kyis stong nyid/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong nyid brjod/ /thog ma dang po tha ma mtha'/ /de dag med pas 'khor ba ni/ /thog ma tha ma med par brjod/ /'gro 'ong bral phyir rmi lam lta'i/ /srid 'di de yis dben nyid gang / /de ni thog ma dang tha ma/ /med pa stong pa nyid do zhes/ /bstan bcos las ni nges par brjod/ /dor ba zhes bya bkram pa de/ /btang ba la ni nges par brjod/ /de spangs dor ba med pa ste/ /'ga' yang btang med gang de ni/ /dor ba med pa de nyid kyis/ /de nyid stong pa nyid gang yin/ /de phyir de la dor ba med—/ /stong pa nyid ces nges par brjod/ /slob ma rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /byang sems de bzhin gshegs rnams kyis/ /'dus byas sogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /gang phyir ma byas de phyir ni/ /'dus byas sogs kyi ngo bo nyid/ /rang bzhin du ni brjod pa ste/ /de nyid kyis de stong nyid gang / /de ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid/ /bco brgyad khams dang reg pa drug /de las skyes pa'i tshor ba drug /gzugs can gzugs can min pa'i chos/ /de bzhin 'dus byas 'dus ma byas/ /gang yin de dag des dben phyir/ /chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid/ /gzugs la sogs pa dngos med gang / /de ni rang mtshan stong pa nyid/ /gzugs ni gzugs rung mtshan nyid de①/ /tshor ba myong ba'i mtshan nyid can/ /'du shes mtshan mar 'dzin pa ste/ /'du byed 65—574

mngon par 'du byed pa/ /yul rnams so sor rig pa ni/ /rnam shes rang gi mtshan nyid do/ /phung po'i mtshan nyid sdug bsngal te/ /khams kyi mtshan nyid sbrul gdug 'dod/ /skye ba'i sgor gyur skye mched de/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis ①skye mched gsungs/ /rten cing 'byel 'byung gang yin pa/ /rkyen tshogs pa yi mtshan nyid can/ /gtong ba sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin/ /tshul khrims gdung ba med mtshan nyid/ /bzod pa khro med mtshan nyid de/ /brtson 'grus kha na ma tho med/ /bsam gtan sdud pa'i mtshan nyid can/ /shes rab ma chags mtshan nyid can/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /mtshan nyid 'di ni bstan ② pa yin/ /bsam gtan rnams dang tshad med rnams/ /gzhan yang gang dag gzugs med pa/ /'di dag mi 'khrugs mtshan nyid du/ /yang dag mkhyen pas gsungs pa yin/ /sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub phyogs/ /nges par 'byung byed rang mtshan nyid/ /stong pa nyid gang dben pa'i phyir/ /de yi mtshan nyid dmigs med nyid/ /zhi ①phyir mtshan ma med pa ste/ /gsum pa'i nyid mtshan sdug bsngal dang / /rmongs med rnam par thar pa yi/ /mtshan nyid rnam par grol ba'o/ /shin tu rnam par nges pa yi/ /ngo bor stobs rnams kyang brjod do//skyob pa mi 'jigs pa rnams ni/ /shin tu brtan pa'i ngo bo'o so so yang dag rig rnams ni/ /spobs sogs tshad med mtshan nyid can/ /'gro la phan pa nyer sgrub pa/ /byams pa chen po nges par brjod/ /snyug bsngal can rnams yongs skyob pa/ /snying rje chen po'o ④dga' ba ni/ /rab dga'i mtshan nyid btang snyoms ni/ /ma 'dres mtshan nyid can zhes bya/ /sangs rgyas chos ni ma 'dres pa/ /bcu dang brgyad du gang 'dod rnams/ /gang phyir ston pa des mi 65—575

'phrogs—/ /de phyir mi 'phrogs mtshan nyid can/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /mngon sum mtshan nyid can du 'dod/ /gzhan ni phyogs gcig pa yin phyir/ /mngon sum zhes byar mi 'dod do/ /'dus byas mtshan nyid gang yin dang / /'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid gang / /de de kho nas stong pa nyid/ /de ni rang mtshan stong pa nyid/ /da ltar 'di ni mi gnas shing / /'das dang ma 'ongs yod ma yin/ /gang du de dag mi dmigs pa/ /de ni mi dmigs pa zhes brjod/ /mi dmigs pa de rang ngo bo/ /de yis dben pa nyid gang de/ /ther zug gnas min 'jig ①min pas/ /mi dmigs zhes ①bya'i stong nyid do/ /sbyor ba las byung ①gzugs rnams med/ /dngos po'i rgyan ④las byung ba'i phyir//rkyen las byung rnams de nyid kyis/ /stong pa dngos po stong pa nyid/ /dngos po'i sgra yis brjod pa ni/ /mdor bsdus phung po lnga rnams te/ /de rnams de yis stong nyid gang / /de dngos stong pa nyid du bshad/ /mdor bsdus na ni dngos med par/ /'dus ma byas chos rnams la brjod/ /de ni dngos med de stong nyid/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid/ /rang bzhin ngo bo nyid med ni/ /ngo bo nyid brjod stong nyid de/ /'di ltar rang bzhin ma byas pas/ /ngo bo nyid ces bstan pa yin/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung yang rung / /ma byung yang ni dngos po nyid/ /dngos po kun gyis khyastong pa nyid/ /gzhan byi dngos por gyerab tu bsgrags/ /yang dag mtha' dang de bzhin nyid/ /gang de gzhan dngos stong pa nyid/ /shes rab pha rol phyin tshul las/ / ⑦de dag dge khyoni rab tu bsgrags/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las bdag med pa brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu bdun pa'o// //65—576

thog ma med pa'i srid 'khor lor/ /rgyun du yongs su 'khor ba ste/ /dpal ldan dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis ni/ /chos mngon mdzod du gsungs pa ni/ /bdag med phung po tsam nyid de/ /nyon mongs las kyis mngon 'dus byas/ /srid pa bar ma'i rgyun gyis ni/ /mar me bzhin du mngal du 'gro/ /ji ltar 'phangs bzhin rim gyis rgyun/ /skyes nas las dang nyon mongs kyis/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo thog ma med/ /de ni rten cing 'byel 'byung ba'i/ /yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum mo/ /sngon dang phyi mar gnyis gnyis dang / /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ /sngon skabs nyon mongs ma rig pa/ /'du byed dag ni sngon las kyi/ /rnam shes mtshalas sbyor phung po yin/ /ming dang gzugs ni de phan chad/ /skye mched drug dod tshun chad do/ /de ni gsum dus tshun chad do/ /reg pa bde sdug la sogs kyi/ /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /tshor 'khrig tshun chad sred pa ni/ /longs spyod 'khrig pa'i chags can gyi/ /nye bar len pa longs spyod rnams/ /thob par bya phyir yongs rgyug pa'i/ /de srid 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /las byed gang yin de srid pa/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba skye ba yin/ /tshor ba'i bar ni rga shi yin/ /'di ni gnas skabs bar 'dod la/ /gtso bo'i phyir ni yan lag bsgrags/ /sngon dang phyi mtha'i rmyebar dag la/ /rmongs pa rnam par bzlog phyir ro/ /nyon mongs gsum po las gnyis so/ /bzhi bdun de bzhin 'bras bu yin/ /gnyis kyis ①rgyu 'bras mdor bsdus gyepa/ /bar ma'i rjes su 65—577

dpag pa las/ /nyon mongs pa las nyon mongs dang / /bya ba nyid do de las bzhi—/ /de las bzhi dang nyon mongs skye/ /'di ni srid pa'i yan lag lugs//'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las rten 'byel gyi 'khor lo brjod pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi rnams te/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung de bzhin du—/ /sdug bsngal 'di ①yi 'gog pa dang / /sdug bsngal 'gog par 'gro ba'i lam/ /bden pa 'di rnams so sor yang / /rnam pa bzhir ni nges pa ste//thar pa 'dod pas 'bad pa yis/ / 'chad par ⑤'gyur ba bsgom par bya/ /sbug bsngal gyi ni bden pa yang / /mi rtag ④sdug bsngal stong bdag med/ /rgyu ni rgyu dang kun 'byung dang / /rab tu skye ba de bzhin rkyen/ /'gog pa'i 'gog dang zhi ba dang / /gya nom pa dang nges 'byung ba'o/ /lam gyi lam dang rigs ④ pa dang / /sgrub dang nges par 'byin pa'o/ /de ltar nyon mongs spang ⑪bya'i phyir/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi bsgom par bya/ /rgyu dang rkyen gyis bskyed pa'i phyir/ /mi rtag skye dang 'jig pa nyid/ /sdug bsngal rjes su mi mthun phyir/ /zag pa dang bcas dngos po ni/ /bdag med deng ⑦mi ldan pa'o—/ /brtags pe pa'i chos ni stong pa'o/ /rnam pa bzhi po 'di dag ni/ /thar pa 'dod pas rtag shes bya/ /sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i phung po rnams/ /dga' ba'i bag chags yang dag 'byung / /dga' la chags dang yang dag ldan//sred dang srid pa'i byed pa po/ /rtag tu bden pa'i lam bsgoms skepas/ /'di ⑨ni 'bad pas gzhom ⑫par bya/ /rgyu de sa bon chos yin phyir/ /nad 65—578

dang sdug bsngal gzhi ①nyid do/ /sdug bsngal yang dag skye de'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal kun 'byung nyid shes bya/ /glo bur myong ba'i sdug bsngal la/ /'bras bu zhes ni mngon par brjod/ /rab tu skye ⑤ba 'byel sbyor nyid/ /de ni sdug bsngal zug rngu'i rgyur/ /mngon par brjod bya don gyis ni/ /rkyen ni chu bo 'ching ba nyid/ /'phel ba'i rgyu ni nyon mongs rnams/ /bral ba'i sbyor ba 'gog pa'o/ /sdug bsngal phung po dang bral bas/ /zhi ba zhes su mngon par brjod—/ /nyon mongs sdug bsngal bral ba dang / /dge dang bde ba gya nom pa/ /nges par 'byung ba bdag med de/ /phan dang bde ba rjes su 'phel/ /yang na ma rig 'gog pas na/ /'gog pa yi ni bdag nyid do/ /zhi ba sdug bsngal yang dag zad/ /gya nom bde ba 'ba' zhig go/ /nges par 'byung ba stong nyid sogs/ /rnam thar bde ba'i mtshan nyid do/ /bdag dang bdag gi bas stong phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis stong pa'o/ /'dus byas kun kyi rgyu rnams ni/ /rnam par zhi ba mtshan ma med/ /smon pa med pa khams gsum ni/ /kun du smon pa zad pa'o/ /las rnams mngon par 'dus byas te/ /dngos med mngon par 'dus ma byas/ /yang na 'khor ba'i phung po rnams/ /rgyu ni zad pa 'gog pa ste/ /zhi ba chags sogs nyon mongs pa/ /mi bzad me dpung zhi ba nyid/ /gnod pa kun las nges grol zhing / /bde ba mi zad gya nom pa'o/ /mi mthun phyogs kun nges grol ba/ /nges par 'byung bar rab tu grags/ /'di yis rgyal ba'i sras rnams ni/ /de nyid don tshol byed phyir lam/ /rigs pa yang ni mi rigs pa'i/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen po ni/ /thob par byed pa sgrub pa ste/ /lam ni rnam par bsgoms ④pa yis/ /rtag par phyin ci 65—579

log zad byed/ /chags thogs med pa'i theg pa gang / /nges 'byung yin te der 'byung ba/ /nges par 'byin pa zhes brjod de/ /srid las shin tu 'byung phyir ro/ /yang na 'gro ba'i don gyis lam/ /rigs pa sbyor bas rigs pa'o/ /yang dag par ni thob byed pa'i/ /don gyis sgrub par rab tu brjod/ /'khor ba las ni yang dag par/ /'byung bas nges par 'byen pa'o/ /'di rnams bshad pa khyagazhan yang ni/ /rnam par gzhag ②pa yod mod kyi/ /gzhung bsdus pa yi phyir na 'dirasne/ /ma sbyar bzod pa nyid du rigs/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi po ni/ /kun du de ltar rtag ④bsgom bya/ /'di ni nyan thos rang rgyal gyi⑤/ /byang chub lam kyi rjes 'brang ste/ /gzhan du srid mtsho'i sdug bsngal las/ /sus kyang pha rol bgrod pa med/ /'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi/ /ngo bo nyid med dmigs pa nyid/ /chags pa thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /byang chub sems dpas bsgom bupar bya/ /'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i rnam pa ni/ /rang gi rang gzhan ④bral ba nyid/ /ji lta bar ni gsungs pa rnams/ /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsgom par bya/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i lam la 'jug pa las 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi brjod pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o// //'on kyang mi mthun phyogs dang ni/ /gnyen po'i chos rnams nges pa ni/ /dam chos mnyan las gzhan du min/ /de bas dam chos mnyan par brjod/ /nyes pa thams cad spang phyir dang / /kun mkhyen go 'phang thob byed pa'i/ /rgyu ni dam chos nyid yin te/ /de bas 'bad pas 'di mnyan ⑧bya/ /dam chos 'bad pas mnyan byas nas/ /yang dag bsam zhing yongs su bsgom/ /sdug 65—580

bsngal thams cad rnam grol ba/ /kun kyi bdag po rgyal bar 'gyur/ /shin tu gya nom gos dang ni/ /bza' ba dang ni stan dag dang / /bzhon pa'am ni mal cha yis/ /rang gi lus ni bskyed mi bya/ /byas pa mi gzo sran mi thub/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi 'byung gnas te/ /lus ni dgra ste de don du/ /mkhas pa su zhig sdig pa byed/ /nad kun rmi rten gnod pa can/ /mi gtsang mtha' dag 'dus pa ste/ /shin tu dri nga'i bdag nyid can/ /rang dbang med pas 'jig ①pa'i rgyu/ /glog dang mgal me'i 'khor lo bzhin/ /②'dod pas tshim med shes byas nas/ /mkhas pas 'di yi bsnyen bkur spang / /de yang 'tsho ba tsam byin nas/ /'di yi buyongs su bskyang ④bar bya/ /rang gzhan bsod nams sogs la sogs/ /bsgrub phyir legs par 'tsho bar bya/ /dam chos 'dzin lus don med du/ /sdug bsngal nyid du mi bya ste/ /lus la brten nas srid pa yi/ /rgya mtsho las ni brgal bar bya'o/ /ji srid 'chi ba ma byung zhing / /blo ni rtogs par ma gyur pa/ /de srid blo ldan 'bad pa yis/ /yid ni chos la dga' bar gyis⑤/ /'tsho ba thams cad brlag phyir dang / /bde ba thams cad zad bya dang / /snyug pa kun dang bral bya'i phyir/ /'chi ba mngon par 'ong bar 'gyur/ /mchog tu mi bzad sde'achi ba ni/ /thob nas shin tu bzlog dka' ste/ /de tshe chos las gzhan skyabs med/ /de bas chos la dga' bar bya//shi nas ngan song las skyob la④/ /chos las mchog ni gang yang med/ /sdug pa'i bu dang chung ma sogs/ /'byel pa yang ni shin tu ring / /gang yang bdag dang bdag gis 'byel/ /sngon dang phyi mar gang dang ni/ /gang la yang med par bgyi yang / /tha snyad phyir na mi rigs ⑧pa/ /de yang rang gis byas 65—581

pa'i las/ /dge ba'am yang na mi dge ba/ /bde dang sdug bsngal nyer spyod phyir—/ /'khor dang mdza' dang mi mdza' med/ /de phyir bu dang chung ma sogs—/ /shin tu zhen pa spang bar bya/ /sdang la be+er yang zhe sdang spang / /dben par chos ni bklag par bya/ /gal te 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtshos/ /'jig ⑨pa mi bzad yod na ni/ /chos kyi blo ni bya ba ste/ /'di ltar bde ba thob par 'gyur/ /gang nyid skyes pa'i skye 'gro ni/ /de nyid 'chi bar nges pa ste—/ /ji ltar nyin mo'i mtha' ru ni/ /mtshan mo cis kyang 'byung ba bzhin/ /ji srid 'chi ba ma byung ba/ /de srid nyid du rab 'bad nas/ /bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs tezhu/ /chos bsam pa nyid 1mchog tu brjod/ /sems ni kun du dam chos la/ /mkhas pas zhen pa nyid du bya/ /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul tshogs las/ /'bad pas rab tu bzlog par bya/ /sems ni kun du rtag par ni/ /rang dag byas te blo can gyis/ /sems kyi dbang du 'gro mi bya/ /sems kyi dbang gyur dmyal bar ltung / /bzlog par dka' zhing 'khrul pa dang / /g.yo zhing dri ma can nyid gang / /dam chos 'dzin pas g.yo med cing / /dri ma med par byas pa ste/ /bag chags kun dang bdud dang ni//mtha' dag dgra ni pham —byed cing / /mya ngan 'das pa'i grong gi lam/ /skyes bu dam pas sbyong ba nyid/ /sems kyi dbang gis ⑤las 'byung ste/ /las kyi dbang gis ⑥'bras bu 'byung / /sems kyi las las yang dag 'byung / /'khor ba zhes ni yongs su brjod/ /sdig dang bsod nams las dang ni/ /de yi 'bras bu sems kyis 3byas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal gang cung zad/ /sems las gzhan pa'i byed po med/ /bya ba thams cad sems dbang ste/ /65—582

'bras bu'ang sems kyi dbang du shes/ /ji ltar sems ni sna tshogs pa/ /de bzhin 'bras bu yang ni shes/ /ji ltar ri mo mkhan gcig gis/ /ri mo sna tshogs 'dri byed pa/ /de bzhin sems ni gcig gis kyang / /sna tshogs srid pa'i las byed do/ /sems kyi sprul pa las yin te/ /las kyi sprul pa 'gro ba'o//las kyi sprul pa bsdus ①pas ni/ /sa gnyis po ni bsdus par 'gyur/ /ji ltar sems ni sna tshogs pa/ /de las 'bras bu sna tshogs shes/ /'gro ba gsum po 'di dag kun/ /sems kyis bris pa nyid du dgongs/ /thog med ma rig pas bcings pa'i/ /sems ni 'khor bar brjod pa ste/ /de nyid 'ba' zhig dag pa ni①/ /mya ngan 'das 'chi med zhi ba'o/ /sems dang sems de'i sprul pa yis①—/ /bskyed pa yi ni khams gsum pa/ /sgyu ma lta bur rnam shes pa'i/ /blo dang ldan pa'i don dam nyid/ /des na de bzhin gshegs pa yi④/ /yang dag dam chos mnyan la 'bad/ /kun rtog thams cad bsdus nas ni/ /blo ldan byis ni chos don bsgoms/ /'di ltar dam chos kun la ni/ /rtag par brdzun ni mi mthun nyid/ /srid sdug bsngal gyis skye 'jigs 'di la/ /blo dang ldan pas de dag spang / /bde ⑥dang mi ldan mi rnams ni/ /legs pa thams cad rnam par spangs/ /'jig rten 'dir ni rtswa bzhin 'gro/ /pha rol ngan 'gro sdug bsngal nyid/ /gang zhig chos la mchog rton pa/ /gang du yang ni brdzun mi smra/ /mchod 'os yid ches pa yi gnas/ /de yi ngag ni 'grub par 'gyur—/ /brdzun smra ngag ni mi btsun zhing / /shin tu skal ngan chung bar 'gyur—/ /kha ni rul ba'i dri ma can/ /phyis nas 'gyod pas gdungs par ⑦'gyur—/ /'di ltar bden pa nyams pa na/ /de yi chos ni shin tu ring / /65—583

chos ni nyams par byas pa yis①/ /mtha' yas sdug bsngal rim par brgyud/ /ji tsam bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /rtsa ba bden pa mchog tu 'dod/ /de las bzlog pa skyon du bzhed/ /bden pa mchog tu 'gyur ba yin/ /②gzhan nas bden pa ④btsal mi bya/ /yul gzhan du ni 'gro mi dgos⑦/ /'jug ngogs rnams las 'jug ngogs mchog /chu yis ⑤bkang ba 'jug ngogs yin/ /sgon ma'i nang na sgon mchog tu/ /bden pa sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /sman gyi nang na de mchog sterjo/ /sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar byed/ /bden pa gnyis don 'di nyid du/ /dam chos sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs/ /bden pa smra ba thob gyur pa/ /'khor ba'i 'ching ba las grol ba'o—/ /brdzun ④dang phra ma tshig rtsub dang / /ngag 'khyal ⑧pa ni smra ba ste/ /dmyal ba'i me dang khyad rnged pa'i/ /ngag skyon de dag spang bar bya/ /bden dang phan dang yid tshim dang / /rgya chen don ni tshig nyung ba/ /skabs dang legs par 'brel ba dang / /brjod bya 'jam por smra bar bya/ /chog shes pa dang rgyags min dang / /sems can kun la phan 'dod cing / /chags dang ⑨zhe sdang rnam grol ba'i/ /bya ba sgrub ⑫par nges par gnas/ /mdza' dang mi mdza' dbye ba med/ /sems snyoms pa yi ⑪lus can ni/ /ngan song las ni rnam grol zhing / /bsam pa'i don ni rab sgrub 'gyur/ /sdom la gnas shing zhi ba dang / /bla ma mchod la dga' ba dang / /bya dang bya min cho ga shes/ /nan tan don ni rab tu 'grub/ /g.yo med shin tu brtson pa dang / /rtag par ngag ni yid 'ong dang / /bsam gtan kha ton la chags pa'i/ /bya ba 'grub pa ring ba min/ /yul dang dus dang cho ga shes/ /sgrub dang sgrub min 65—584

bye brag shes/ /nus pa dang ni thabs dang ldan/ /dngos grub thams cad nye bar gnas/ /gzhan yang mi khros khro ba 'joms/ /bzod pas mi bzod yid 'joms te/ /chos kyis chos min nges par 'joms/ /'od zer kyis ni mun pa 'joms/ /brdzun ①kyi tshig ni bden pas 'joms/ /phra ma ting nge 'dzin gyis te/ /tshig rtsub 'jam pa'i sems kyis so/ /ngag 'khyal ④phan par smra nyid kyis/ /gsod pa byams pa bsgoms pas te/ /rku ba sbyin pas rtag tu rgyal//tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed pa/ /de kho na nyid bsgoms pas 'joms ji ltar nyi mas ④mtshan mo bzhin/ /ma rig rig pas nges par 'joms /dkar po'i phyogs kyis nag po yi/ /phyogs ni 'joms pa de bzhin du/ /'dod log spyod dang 'dod pa rnams/ /blo yis de nyid brtags pas so /'phags pa'i bden pa'i lam gyis ni/ /lam ④ngan pa rnams rtag par 'joms/ /mi 'jigs bzhi po de dag gis/ /nyam nga ba ni legs par spang ⑤/ /brjed ngas spong ba dran pa ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mi shes spong / /me yis shing la byed bzhin du/ /yang dag gis 'joms yang dag min/ /'jig tshogs la ni lta ba kun/ /stong nyid bsgoms ⑥pas 'joms pa'o/ /rtag par 'dzin pa rab 'joms pa/ /skad cig 'jig par bsgoms pas so/ /le lo'i gti mug 'phel ba kun/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni 'joms pa'o/ /ye shes lhag ldan rtag par dul⑦/ /skyes bu de nyid smra ba yis/ /brdzun ④smra ma rungs las can gyi/ /mi rnams nges par 'joms pa'o/ /mu stegs gya gyu'i bsam can kun/ /sangs rgyas kyis ni pham par mdzad/ /lha min lha yis pham pa ste/ /chos nyid kyis ni gnas pa yin/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i ⑨lam la 'jug pa las dam pa'i chos 65—585

mnyan pa la sogs pa ①brjod pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //chags pa thams cad rnam spangs nas/ /sbyin pa btang ste rnam pa bzhi/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang ni/ /byams par brjod de la lar snegasum/ /ji srid gang du chags gyur pa/ /de srid 'khor ba'i 'ching ba ste/ /chags pa thams cad spang don du/ /'di ltar sbyin pa sbyin par bya/ /gang zhig phyug ①dang dbang phyug dang / /nad med pa dang rgyal po ni/ /stobs kun dang ni ldan pa dang / /skal bzang tshe ring gyur pa ni/ /de ni sbyin pa las byung 'ams/ /lha dang de bzhin mi rnams kyi/ /rab tu sbyin pa stobs kyi mchog /sbyin dang mi ldan ngan 'gror ltung / /skyes bu kun byi tha ma'o/ /'dod dang ser snas bcings pa rnams/ /bu dang chung ma'i dbang du 'gro/ /bza' ba 'ba' zhig 'dod pas ni/ /mi dag brlag nas 'gro ba ste/ /'dod pas bcings pa dgrol phyir dang / /nga rgyal shing ni zad bya dang / /sdig pa'i phung po gzhom bya la / /rab tu sbyin pa stobs kyi mchog /sbyin pa mdun nas 'gro ba ste/ /sbyin pa po ni de rjes 'gro/ /lam ston pa ni sbyin pa'o/ /'jig rten pha rol rab 'gro ba'i/ /sbyin pa'i chu yis ma gye bkrus nas/ /tshul khrims rlabs kyis yongs bsgos te/ /ye shes kyis brgal dri ma med/ /sdug bsngal pha rol rab tu 'gro/ /skyes bu phan par 'dod pa yis/ /sgon ma gsum ni rab bsten khye bya//sbyin dang tshul khrims ye shes te/ /'di dag skyon rnams sel byed pa'o/ /sbyin pa ma byas ngo tsha yis/ /nyon mongs skyon gyis bslus pa rnams/ /lhar skyes nas kyang dman 'gyur te/ /de phyir sbyin pa mchog tu 'gyur/ /sbyin pa'i skye65—586

rim gyis 'phel ldan pas/ /ser sna'i stobs ni spangs pa rnams/ /lha yi rtsed mo la gzhol zhing / /sems ni tshil pa nyid du 'gyur/ /yi dwags yang dag rab gzir ba'i/ / bkres skam ①rang bzhin me gang yin/ /ser sna dgra yi 'bras bur ni/ /thams cad sangs rgyas nyid kyis gsungs/ /snying rje'i mchog ldan gang zhig ni/ /sdug bsngal can la bde sbyin pa/ /sbyin pas de la bde bar 'gyur/ /de phyir sbyin pa rab tu bsngags/ /sbyin pa 'jig rten sgron ma byed/ /gang du 'gro ba'i rjes su 'gro/ /nyes pa zad pa'i tshig gi gnas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis gsungs/ /ser sna'i sgra ni nges bcom par /byas nas sems ni legs bsgoms te/ /gang zhig sbyin pa rab gtong ba/ /de ni srid pa'i mtsho las brgal/ /dang po rtag tu sbyin pa sbyin/ /'bad pas tshul khrims bsrung bar bya/ /sred pa ye shes kyis gzhom bya/ /lam 'di bde bar 'jug pa'i lam/ /ser sna dang ni ldan pa'i sems/ /rtog tsapar kun du de gzhom bya/ /bdag med bsgoms lapa goms pa yis/ /chags pa thams cad gzhom par bya/ /sbyin pa ma btang bkres skom gyis/ /yi dwags gnas su gdung bar 'gyur/ /sbyin pas chos dang ldan pa yi/ /'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por 'gyur/ /sbyin pa'i sa la brten nas ni/ /tshul khrims srung rnams mkhas pa yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa dus kyis ni/ /ye shes kyis ni yongs su grol—/ /sdug bsngal nges ④'byung lam du ni/ /'di ni thob pa rnams kyis bsngags—/ /de ltar rig nas mkhas pas ni/ /rtag tu sbyin pa ⑤dga' bar bya/ /sngon du bag med spyad pa gang / /sbyin pa la sogs ma spel ba/ /phyi nas 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe/ /de ni rang sems gdung bar 'gyur/ /sbyin pa byed min nor 65—587

de ni/ /rtag par longs ni mi spyod pa/ /'bad pas yongs su bsrungs pa yis/nor de rnams ni chud zos 'gyur/ /bla ma'i tshogs la sbyin pa'i phyir/ /rtag tu nor be+e spyod byed pa'i/ /nor de mdzes par lta ba yin/ /de las bzlog pa rtswa dang mtshungs/ /stobs chung ba dang dul rnams la①/ /sdig dang ma 'dres sbyin byin na/ /sems can rnams kyi mig ji bzhin/ /'jig rten 'di dang pha rol du④/ /sbyin pa mi yi 'jig rten du/ /byin pas dge bar 'gro ba'o/ /lha rnams sbyin pa mi gtong ste/ /'di ni 'bras bu'i sa ru 'dod/ /mi rnams las kyi sa yin te/ /lha rnams 'bras bu'i sa yin no/ /las kyi dbang gis ①'bras bu ste/ /rgyu med pa las 'bras bu yin/ /bsam gtan dang ni nyan pa spangs ④—/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims rnams duspang zhing / /rtsod dang tsub dang rmongs pa yin/ /gson yang shi dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gang zhig chos kyi rjes 'brang na/ /'jig rten 'dir ni srog dang bcas/ /rang gis ⑥thams cad rab byen pas/ /rtag par sems can don bya ste/ /sems can la gnod sbyin pa ni/ /rgyal sras rnams kyis mi bya'o/ /'jigs dang skrag dang ngo tshas min/ /lan pyal re bas sbyin mi bya/ /lhag bsam ma yin g.yo dang sgyu/ /rgyags dang bcas pas mi sbyin no/ /de yi 'bras bu spyod 'dod dang / /brdzun dang rgod pa'i sems kyis min/ /bdag bstod nupa dang gzhan smod dang / /khro dang zhe sdang gti mug dang / /yid la gcags dang 'gyod pa dang / /grags dang bde ba'i 'dun ⑨pas min/ /de ni sbyin pa byas nas kyang / /sangs rgyas nyid du yongs su bsngo/ /khams gsum kun du khyab pa yi/ /bdag med pa ni yongs su bsgom/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rnam grol te/ /bdud kyi 'jigs pa 65—588
