tshul khrims gang da ltar phyogs bcu na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims dang bslab pa'i gzhi gang yin pa rnams te/ bslab pa'i gnas rnams ①dang tshul khrims gang rnams la 'das pa'i dze+ebyang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs 1pa dang ldan pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis slob par 'gyur ba dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams da ltar slob pa rnams nod dam/ des kyang nod lags so zhes dam bca'o/ /lan gsum du'o/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgye bas/ gang cung zad lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / ma dang pha dang /de las gzhan pa'i sems can rnams la brten nas bskyed pa'i ④'di dang srid pa gzhan rnams su bdag gis sdig pa bgyis pa dang bgyid du sprul ba dang / rjes su yi rang ba yang rung ste/ de dag thams cad gcig tu bsdus shing bzlums te bsdoms nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / slob dpon gyi spyan sngar mchog dang gtso bo'i bshags par bgyi'o/ /shes shing dran pas ⑤rab tu mi 'chab po/ /'di ltar lan gsum du'o/ /bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi bas 'di ltar sdig pa bshags nas dus 'di nas nye bar bzung ste byang chub kyi snying po la nye bar mchis kyi bar du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po can/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa/dgra'i 'jigs pa thams cad las 'das pa skyes bu chen po mi phyed pa'i sku/ bla 65byed651

na med pa'i sku/ chos kyi sku/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi'o—/ /bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi bas 'di ltar sdig pa bshags nas/dus 'di nas nye bar bzung ste/ byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi bas 'di ltar sdog pa bshags nas/ dus 'di nas ①bzung ste/byang chub kyi snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun tshogs rnams kyi mchog la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'di ltar lan gsum du'o / /bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi bas 'di ltar sdig pa bshags nas/gsum la skyabs su mchis te/ mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams bsgral ba'i phyir dang / 'byung dze+eba'i phyir dang / 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bla na med pa la gzhag pa'i phyir/ 'di 1ltar 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas nyid rtogs pa dang ldan pa dang / rtogs par gyur pa dang / rtogs par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad sgrib pa dang bral ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa rnams dang / ji ltar chos rnams ④ kyi chos nyid mkhyen pa'i cho ga des/bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi ba slob dpon dang nye bas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyan sngar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /'di ltar lan gsum mo/ /bdag gis sdig pa bshags pa 'di dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub 65—652

tu sems bskyed pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /skyabs med pa dang /skyob pa med pa dang / gnas med pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dang /gling med pa'i 'jig rten la skyabs dang / skyob pa dang / gnas dang dpung gnyen dang / gling du gyur cig /sems can thams cad kyang 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las ma bsgral ①ba las sgrol ④bar gyur cig /sgrib pa las yongs su ma 'das pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mya ngan las 'das pas yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar gyur cig /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs 'byin par gyur cig /'di ltar lan gsum mo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'di ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed pas/ sems can gyi khams mtha' med pa la ji ltar ma dang pha dang sring mo dang spun dang / bu dang bu mo dang / gzhan gnyen dang snag gi gnyen mtshams su gyur pa rnams 'di ltar so sor gzung pebar bgyi'o/ /bzung ④nas kyang nus pa ji lta ba dang / stobs ji lta ba dang / brten pa ji lta bas ⑤dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bskyed par bgyi'o/ /'di nas bzung ste/ cung zad sbyin pa gtang dubar bgyi'o/ /tshul khrims bsrung bar bgyi'o/ /bzod pa bskyed par bgyi'o/ /brtson 'grus brtsam par bgyi'o/ /bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug go/ /shes rab brten par bgyi'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la yang slob po/ /de dag thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don dang /phan pa dang / bde ba dang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las brtsams te/ sa chen por chud pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po can de rnams kyi theg pa chen po'i 'jug pa'i rjes su mchi'o/ /'di 65—653

ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bdag byang chub sems dpar dus 'di nas bzung ste/ bdag slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol/ 'di ltar lan gsum mo/ /de nas slob dpon des sku de'i spyan sngar phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bzhugs shing 'tsho zhing 'dzin pa dang / gzhes pa rnams la zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal nas btud de gsol bar bya'o/ /ming 'di skad ces bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa' ⑫ bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang nye ba las ji srid du lan gsum du/ yang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa' chaming 'di skad ces bgyi ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i bdag nyid dpang du gyur par yang dag par shes te/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' med pa rnams su 'phags pa'i mchog lkog tu gyur kyang / sems can gyi don la lkog tu ma gyur pa rnams la/ 'di byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa ④la mkhyen par gsol lo/ /'di ltar lan gsum mo/ /'di ltar yang tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa'i las kyi rjes la/ 'di ni nges par chos nyid yin te/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kyi khams mtha' yas pa la gtugs pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams bzhugs shing 'dzin pa rnams gzhes pa rnams dang / sa chen por chud pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i rang bzhin byi ltas 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gang gis de rnams la 'di lta bur 'gyur ba ste/ ming 'di skad ces bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang nye bas ming 'di skad ces bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa' dang nye ba las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi 65—654

sdom pa yang dag par blang ba blangs so zhes so/ /'di ltar re zhig gzhan yang blang ba'i cho ga brjod pa/ gal te yon tan dang ldan pa gang zag de dang nye bar ma gyur na/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' des de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mdun du rang nyid kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa blang bar bya'o—/ /'di ltar bya ste bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / sa chen por bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la btud par bya ste/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am—/ tsog tsog pos tshig 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ bdag ming 'di skad ces bgyi bas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / sa chen por chud pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsol bar bgyi'o/ /de rnams kyi yang spyan sngar byang chub sems dpa'i babe+eb pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thams cad blang ba la/ tshul khrims gang zhes bya ba la sogs pa sngar bzhin no/ /ji srid du byang chub sems dpa' bdag byang chub sems dpar tsa'adi nas bzung ste/sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas kyang bdag gzung chadu gsol zhes pa ni las so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub bzang po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po bla ma su nā ya shrī mi tra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ①ba dge slong dar ma grags kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o// //65—655

2199༄ga /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi tsit+ta ut+yā da sa mā dā 1na bi dhi/bod skad du/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga /thugs rje chen po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mes po ni/ /'jam mchog mgon la rab btud nas/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed dang / /yi dam gsal po bri bar bya/ /de la dang po re zhig rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo rten dang bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang ldan pa'i thad du song nas/ dkyil 'khor bya ba sngon du btang nas ④pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te ④thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces/ rigs kyi bu skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub kyi sems bdag la stsol cig ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des kyang nus pa ji lta ba bzhin du sbyin no zhes khas 65—657

blang ngo / /de nas sa phyogs yid du 'ong bar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can kyi mchod rten nam/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs sam/ ri mo bzhugs su gsol te/ chu dri zhim pos sku khrus gsol la/ gos dkar pos phyis nas na bza' sna tshogs gsol te/ 'og nas 'chad tū/ pa'i cho gas dkyil 'khor rnams byas nas/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog la sogs pas phyi rol gyi mchod pa bya'o/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /dri dang lha bshos nyid 1dang ni/ /na bza' dang ni rgyan dang gdugs/ /gar dang rol mo glu dbyangs ni / /yid 'ong sangs rgyas spyod yul dag /nam mkha' mtha' dag kun khebs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyan sngar ni/ /blos sprul nas ni bdag 'bul lo/ /zhes yid kyi bhumachod pas mchod par mdzad do/ /mchod par bya ba dang / mchod par byed pa dang / mchod pa rnams rang bzhin gyis dbyer med par dmigs te/ ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pa/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis ngade bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod/ /ces sgrub pas mchod par bya'o/ /dus gsum bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams/ /chos dang tshogs kyi mchog bcas la/ /zhing rdul kun gyi grangs rnyed kyi/ /lus btud nas ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum phyag byas la/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun rnam pa kun du 'bul/ /sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi/ /ces 3bya ba 'dis bdag gi lus sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ /tshe rabs 'di 'am gzhan dag la/ /bdag 65—658

gis ①ma 'tshal sdig babyis pa'am/ /bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni/ /gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te/ /rjes su yi rang gang bgyis pa/ /de ni 'gyod pas shin tu yang / /'gyod par bgyes te bdag 'chags kyis/ /'dren pa rnams kyis ⑤nyes pa la/ /nyes pa lags par gzung du gsol/ /'di ni bzang po ma lags pas/ /mgon po be+en chad bdag mi bgyid/ /ces nyes pa thams cad bshags pa byas nas/ zag bcas zag pa med pa yi/ /dge la dga' bas yi rang ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor be+ed du/ /sangs rgyas rnams la bdag bskul lo/ /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das bzhed rnams/ /bskal pa mtha' las zhubazhugs su gsol/ /bdag gis dge kun ltos 5med par—/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /zhes brjod pas bsod nams la rjes su yi rang ba dang / sangs rgyas la bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba byas nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba sbyin no/ /de la rang la mngon du phyogs shing tsog tsog por ⑤'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas gnas pa la rigs kyi bu khyod kyis 'di skad ces brjod cig ces smrar gzhug ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje chen po can rnams kyang bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgye ba sangs rgyas la sogs pa la mchod pa la sogs pa bgyis pas/ byang chub snyeng por mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas la ni skyabs su mchi/ /chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod par bya'o/ /de'i rjes la/ lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang //65—659

dus gsum gyi ①ni dge ba rnams/ /sems can don grub bya ba'i phyir/ /ltos ② pa med par gtang 1bar bgyi/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang / /sems can dpag tu med pa yi/ /rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir ④yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas rjogatugs pa'i//sems can khams ni rnam kun du/ /thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du/ /bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog /mgon po'i spyan sngar rdzogs pa yi/ /byang chub tu ni sems bskyed de/ /sems can de dag thams cad kun/ /sangs rgyas bde la mgron ⑥du 'bod/ /ces don pa'i mtshan nyid mngon du bya'o⑦//de nas/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang / /de dag byang chub thugs bsrung ⑧la/ /dus kun du ni gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /bdag gis byang chub sems bskyed cing / /de bzhin du ni dus kun du/ /bdag gis de ni bsrung bar bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyi bar du smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems gzung ⑨bar babyi'o/ /de nas gal te byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa bzung ⑩ba la mos pa brtan ⑪po yod na de'i tshe sdom pa sbyin no/ /ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i basbab bzung ste/ /de dag byang sems babe+eb pa la/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas pa ltar/ /de bzhin 'gro la phan don du/ /byang chub sdom pa gzung ⑫bgyi zhing / /de bzhin basbab pa de dag la/ /rim pa bzhin du gnas par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa sbyin no/ /rtsang ba dang lhung ba med pa'i gzugs brnyan yang skabs ji lta ba bzhin du de dag dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bstan par bya'o/ /de nas langs te dkon mchog gsum la phyag 65—660

btsal nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ①zhabs gnyis la gtugs te nus pa ji lta ba bzhin du yon phul nas/ de ring bdag tshe 'bras bu yod/ /mi yi srid pa legs par thob/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su bdag gyur to/ /skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la/ /ji ltar rnyog par mi 'gyur bar/ /de bzhin du ni rang rigs dang / /mthun pa'i las ni bdag gis bya/ /zhes bya bas mjug rgyas par bya'o/ /rnam pa de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen med na ni sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i spyan sngar bya'o zhes bya ba ni dkon mchog la skyabs su 'gro ba sngon du song ba can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i cho ga'o/ /de ltar byang chub kyi sems dang sdom pa bzung ②ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs gnyis po spyod pas yongs su rdzogs par byed pa des na spyod pa la mngon par sbyar bar bya'o/ /de yang rnam pa gsum ste/ las dang po pa la ni sdom pa'i tshul khrims gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na/ yi dam gyi spyod zhupa'o/ /mos pas spyod pa'i spyod pa can la ni dge ba chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod pa'o/ /sa la bzhugs pa la ni sems can gyi don bya ba nyid gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na/ sems can ston pa'i spyod pa'o/ /de la las dang po pa'i yi dam gyi spyod pa brjod do④/ /nang par langs te/ oṃ pra kṛ ta dhipa ri shudha sarba dharmāḥ pra kṛ ta dupa ri shurnyophohaṃ/ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs shing yongs su brtags pa'i chus gdong la sogs pa dag par bya zhing kun du spyod pa ⑦gtsang bas/ sa phyogs yid du 'ong bar⑪ sangs 65—661

rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs sam/ ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i mchod rten nam/ thang ka bkram zhing / bar snang la yang phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams yid kyis dmigs te/oṃ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ swa bhā ba shudhaḥ①swā hā/ zhes brjod la/chu dri zhim pos sgu khrus gsol te/ gos dkar pos phyis nas/ ji ltar rnyed pa'i gos dang rgyan rnams sngags 'dis dbul lo/ /oṃ ā ①badz+ra waste ①hūṃ/ oṃ ā ④badz+ra ā phyelo ka re hūṃ/ de rjonas mdun du mngon par phyogs te bsdad ⑦la/oṃ badz+ra bhū mi hūṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sa'i char/ oṃ badz+ra u ⑧da ka hūṃ/ zhes bya bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyi ba dang / chus kun du bzang po'i dkyil 'khor nye bar byugs la/ oṃ badz+ra re khe hūṃ/ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor btang nas lag pa bkru'o/ /de nas dbus nas brtsams te/dbus nyid kyi mthar thug par me tog sngags 'dis dgram mo/ /oṃ haṃ ma hā me ra be+e swā hā/ dbus su'o/ /shar dang lho dang byang dang nub rnams su ni/oṃ yo pūrba bi de hā spuya swā hā/ oṃ ram̐ rdza bu dī pā ⑫ya swā hā/ oṃ lo ut+ta ra ku ra be+e swā hā/ oṃ baṃ a ba ra ko da na ⑪ye swā hā/ me dang bden bral dang dbang ldan dang rlung gi phyogs dag tu ni/ oṃ ya⑫ཿu pa dī pā ⑫ya swā hā/ oṃ raḥ.u pa dī pā tshuya swā hā/ oṃ laḥ.u pa dī pā ⑫ya swā hā/ oṃ baḥ.u pa dī pā ⑩ya swā hā/bar gyi shar dang lho dang byang dang nub rnams su ni/ oṃ ya ga dza rat+na ya swā hā/oṃ ra pu ru ṣa rat+na ya swā hā/ oṃ la sdi ⑩rat+na ya swā hā/ oṃ ba a shwa rat+na ya swā hā/me dang bden bral dang dbang ldan dang rlung rnams su ni/ oṃ yā khaṅga spyorat+na ya swā hā/ oṃ rā ma ṇi raṭ+wā ya swā hā/ oṃ khā ma hā ni dha nā ⑪ya swā hā/ oṃ bā tsakra 65—662

rad+mā ya swā hā/ oṃ haṃ ①a sgo me ra be+e swā hā/ zhes bya bas yang dbus su bzhag la dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra pu྾ hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra sgru pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra gan dhe hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ṣ+pe ①cha r+ya hūṃ/ zhes bya bas ji ltar rnyed pa'i me tog dang / bdug pa dang / mar me dang / dri dang /lha bshos dag dbul bar bya'o/ /de nas/ rgyal ba gang zag bla na med pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad dang / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa//kun gyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang / /gang du byang chub la reg dang / /zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / /zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang / /bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang / /'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang / /seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi/ /gnas de la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /steng dang bar dang 'og dag dang / /phyogs dang phyogs mtshalas rnams su yang / /skur bcas sku ni med pa yi/ /mchod rten la ni bdag phyag 'tshal/ /zhes bya bas lan gsum du phyag byas la 'dug ste/ rten gyi stobs la sogs pa rdzogs par bya ba'i don du phung po gsum pa gdon par bya'o//sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa yang rjes su dran par bya'o/ /de nas bar snang la rang gi gzhi bdag dang 'jig rten skyong ba rnams yid kyis dmigs te/ oṃ ṣāzhuhūṃ zhes bya bas lan gsum byen gyis brlabs pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsam yid kyis de dag nyid la byen nas/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dhas+thā buhūṃ ār+ya nuta pan+da tāta oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brjod pas bdud rtsi des tshim pa rnams rang gi gnas su song par blta'o⑤/ /de nas theg pa chen po'i mdo lnga dang /de dang rjes su mthun pa dag las mdo gang yang rung ba ci nus kyis bton nas/65—663

sdug bsngal ba dang mgon med pa dag la gos dang zas la sogs pa tha na kham gcig tsam tshun chad byin la/ 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas pha rol tu phyin pa rnams yang dag par bsdus nas smon lam 'di skad ces gdab bo/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i/ /sems can kun gyi don bsgrub phyir/ /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs spyod mdzad pa/ /bdag gi spyod pa'ang de 'drar shog /ji srid nam mkha' gnas pa dang / /'gro ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /de srid 'gro ba'i sbug bsngal ni/ /'joms pas bdag kyang gnas par shog /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i dba' klong 'khrugs ①pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes bya bas dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol te/ de nas byang chub kyi sems dang bslab pa dran pa sngon du btang bas ④ji ltar bde bar gnas par bya'o/ /zan za ba'i dus su na sngar bshad pa'i cho gas gtor ma bya'o/ /oṃ ha ri te ma hā ①yak+ṣi ṇi i dam ba ling greṇ+ḍa kṛṇ+ḍa ④k+ṣi/ zhes bya bas 'phrog ma la zan changs gnyis sbyin no/ /oṃ a gra paṇ+ḍi a shi bh+yo esni/ zhes bya bas thog mar za ba rnams la zan changs gcig sbyin la ran pa tshod zin par zos nas/ oṃ uts+tshaṣ+ṭa paṇ+ḍi a shi bh+yaḥ swā hā/zhes bya bas lhag ma za ba rnams la lhag ma byin duno/ /gal te nus pa yod na nyi ma phyed dang dgongs ka'i thun dag la yang de bzhin du bya'o/ /nus pa med pa ni sngar ji skad brjod pa'i cho gas dkyil 'khor skyong ⑦nul byas la/ mchod pa dang phyag btsal ba yang byas nas phung po gsum pa bton te smon lam gdab po/ /de ni yi dam len pa'i cho ga'o/ /65—664

ting nge 'dzin dang sems can mgu bar bya ba'i cho ga ni①/ mdo sde dang byang chub spyod 'jug dang bslab pa kun nas btus pa la sogs pa las shes par bya'o—/ /byang chub sems dang yi dam kyi/ /cho ga bdag gis byas pa las/ /dge ba thob pa gang yin des/ /'gro ba byang chub bsten par shog /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po chen po su ma ti tīrnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/ 657 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉phro ga / /byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang yi dam blang ba'i cho ga byang chub sems dpa' dgra las rnam par rgyal bas mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉masad pa ta sa ma da/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skad/ ④〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉ras/658 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉zad chad/ ④〈〈pe 〉mdos/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7)sa/ bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉grog/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra sa/659 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉sprod/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉kyi/ 1〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉 sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thaltos/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lbār/66 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉5)sa/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉thaltos/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉7tang / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazhir/bu〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7tha'/ khye〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉〈na/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ra sa so/ zhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bsrungs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazung / ⑫〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉sngagazung / ⑪〈〈pe 〉'i〈snar 〉ra stan/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉thazung /65byed665

cho ga'i rim pa//1 ༄gro/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsit+ta u da rngusasba ra bi bye kra ma/ bod skad du/ sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngan song thams cad 'jig pa dang / /sgrib pa thams cad las grol zhing / /rdzogs sangs go 'phang stsol mdzad pa/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang / /de bzhin byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sdom pa'i rim pa bri bar bya/ /de la dang po zhusangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa sngon du song bas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed nas/ 'di skad ces gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ ji ltar sngon rmi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / byang chub sems 65—667

dpa' sa chen po la bzhugs pa rnams kyis dang por bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed pa de bzhin du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang slob dpon kyis 1bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du gsol zhes lan gsum gyi bar du brjod do/ /de ltar gsol ba btab nas dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol—/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub ①snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub dusnying po la mchis kyi bar du chos rnams kyi mchog zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid byang chub dusnying po la mchis kyi bar du tshogs rnams kyi mchog 'phags pa byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan gsum du brjod do/ /de ltar skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yid kyis ⑤ dmigs te/ phyag btsal ba dang /ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa la sogs pa ④byas la/ slob dpon mdun du byas te pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am tsog pur ⑦yang rung bas 'dug ste/thal mo sbyar bas ⑧sems bskyed par bya ste/ phyogs bcu rnams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/65—668

slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas skye ba 'di dang skye ba gzhan dang gzhan dag tu sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang / tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang / bsgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bdag gis bgyis pa dang / babyid du stsal ba dang / bgyid pa la rjes su yi rang ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dang / sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu thugs bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung sdenas ji srid byang chub ②snying po la mchis kyi bar du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen po la sems bskyed par bya'o/ /sems can ma brgal ①ba rnams bsgral bar babyi'o/ /ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o/ /dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o—/ /yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla bar bgyi'o rjozhes lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar slob dpon med kyang bdag nyid byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga nirjo/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa dang phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la bsams te/ phyag 'tshal ba dang / mchod pa'i cho ga la sogs pa byas nas/gsol ba gdab pa dang slob dpon zhes pa'i tshig spangs pa'i skyabs su 'gro ba la sogs pa'i go rims rjogong ma bzhin du bya'o/ /de ltar sems bskyed pa'i gang zag gis ⑦byang chub kyi sems spel bar bya ba'i phyir tha na nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /byang chub 65—669

bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis—/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /byang chub kyi sems nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi las ldog par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ bla ma dang mchod par 'os pa slu ba dang / gzhan 'gyod pa'i gnas ma yin pa la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang /sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gis tshigs su bcad pa ma yin pa brjod pa dang / sems can thams cad la g.yo dang sgyus spyod pa'o/ /byang chub kyi sems mi nyams par byed pa'i chos bzhi la bslab par bya ste/ bzhi gang zhe na/ srog gi phyir yang bsams bzhin du brdzun mi smra ba dang / sems can thams cad lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pas gnas par bya'i g.yo dang sgyus ma yin pa dang / sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la ston pa'i 'du shes bskyed cing phyogs bcur yang dag pa'i yon tan brjod par bya ba dang /sems can 'ga' zhig dge ba la 'god pa de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god kyi nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la ni ma yin no/ /khyad par du mngon par shes pa myur du thob par 'dod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis zhus pa'i chos bdun pa zhes bya ba'i theg pa chen po'i mdo la basbab par bya'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i phan yon ni/ sdong po bkod pa'i mdo la sogs pa las shes par bya'o/ /de la dang por cho ga bzhin du byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la legs par slob par 'dod pas/ byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sdom 65—670

pa la gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga shes pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa 'bogs pa'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su gzung bar nus pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen la phyag byas te/ de'i rkang pa la gtugs nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob dpon byed las bdag byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa ①yang dag par blang ba de len par 'tshal gyis/ de la gnod pa ma mchis na bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du cung zad cig gsan cing byed ba'i rigs so zhes de ltar lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /rigs kyi bu byed nyon cig /byed 'di ltar sems can ma brgal ④ba rnams bsgral ba dang / ma grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang / yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las bzla ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gdung rgyun mi 'chad par 'dod dam/de las byed kyis sems bskyed pa brtan pa dang yi dam brtan par bya'o/ /gzhan dang 'gran ①pa'i ched du ma yin nam/ gzhan byi nan gyis lan rjodu bcug pa ma yin nam zhes 'dri'o/ /de'i 'og tu de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa'i lugs sku'am ras ris ④la sogs pa mdun du bzhugs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mdun du bsam la bu/ ci nus pa'i phyi'i mchod pa lngas mchod pa dang phyag byas la—/ de ma thag tu dge ba'i bshes gnyen stan mthon po la 'dug pa la ston pa'i 'du shes kyis phyag byas te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs pa'am tsog tsog por 'dug ste thal mo sbyar nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen la byang chub 65—671

sems dpa'i sdom pa nod pas 'di ltar bskul bar bya ste/ slob dpon byis byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa bdag la myur du zad du gsol zhes de ltar lan gsum du dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bskul nas—/ de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'dug pa'am langs pa yang rung ste/des lku/byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nod pa de dag la 'di skad ces dri ba bya ste/ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod byang chub sems dpa' yin nam/ byang chub tu smon lam btab bam zhes dris pa na/ len pa'i byang chub sems dpa' des kyang btab lags so zhes khas blang bar bya'o/ /de nas mi zad pa dpag tu med pa bla na med pa'i bsod nams kyi gter chen por gyur pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan rin po che'i 'byung gnas byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa ring por sdemi thogs par thob par 'gyur ro zhes snyam du bsam zhing sems rab tu dang bar gyur pas dga' ba dang bcas pas cang mi smra bar thal mo sbyar te 'dug par bya'o//de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des dus gsum kyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhi thams cad dang tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba chos sdud pa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don byed pa'i tshul khrims mdor bsdus pa slob ma la go bar byas te/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi slob pa'i gzhi rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims de dag ci bdag las len par 'dod dam zhes slob ma la 'dri bar bya'o/ /des de ltar len par 'tshal lo zhes khas len par gyur na/byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa sbyin par bya ste/ btsun pa'am/ tshe dang ldan pa'am—/ rigs kyi bu ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod bdag byang chub sems dpa' 65—672

ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi babe+eb pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi bslab pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa dang / da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi babe+eb pa'i gzhir gyur pa gang yin pa dang / tshul khrims su gyur pa gang yin pa'i bslab pa'i ①gzhi gang dag dang tshul khrims gang dag la/ 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bslabs ④par gyur pa dang / ma byon pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ④thams cad kyis slob par 'gyur ba ④dang / phyogs bcu dag na da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad da ltar slob pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i babe+eb pa'i gzhi thams cad dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims thams cad de/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims dang dge ba chos sdud rjopa'i tshul khrims dang / sems can gyi don bya ba'i tshul khrims nod dam zhes smros shig /des kyang nod lags so zhes sgos shig /de ltar slob dpon gyis lan gsum gyi bar du len nam zhes brjod cing slob mas rab tu len lags so zhes lan gsum brjod pas sdom pa blangs par 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen des/ slob ma la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa byin nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la yan lag lngas phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas thal mo sbyar te/ 'di skad ces lan gsum brjod par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas/ bdag byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi 65—673

sdom pa yang dag par blang bar bya ba lan gsum gyi bar du mnos lags te/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba 'dis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khyems kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa la/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dpang du gyur par 'phags pa'i mchog sgog tu gyur kyang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gye khams mthas gtugs pa'i chos thams cad sgog tu ma gyur pa'i thugs mnga' ba thams cad la mkhyen par gsol lo zhes lan gsum byi bar du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la brjod de/ phyag btsal nas bla ma dang slob ma ldang bar bya'o/ /de nas langs la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mnos pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de la 'di skad ces brjod par bya ste/ byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khyod nyon cig /'di ni chos nyid yin te/ gang gi tshe byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par len pa'i las brjod pa rdzogs pa de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'di lta bu'i ltas 'byung bar 'gyur te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi zhing ga ge mo zhig na/byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya bas byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba las byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa mnos so zhes yang dag par mkhyen par 'gyur ro/ /de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' de rnams kyis chos kyi brtse bas bu dang spun zla'i dgongs pa mdzad la de ltar dgongs pa mdzad pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes bya ba brjod par bya'o/ /de nas dge 65—674

ba'i bshes gnyen des byang chub sems dpa' de la 'di skad ces brjod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' ming 'di zhes bya ba khrod nyon cig /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa 'di dad pa med pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ gang gi phyir/ dad pa med pa rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa rab tu bstan na/ dad pa med pa'i sems can de dag byang chub sems pa'i sdom pa ①ma dad pas spong bar byed de/ des na ji snyed byang chub sems dpa' byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa la gnas pa la bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ba de snyed kyi bsod nams ma yin pa'i phung po ma dad pa de dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi phyir byang chub sems dpas zhusems can sdug bsngal thams cad las yongs su bsrung bar bya ba yin pas gzhan sdig pa las bzlog par bya ste/ de'i phyir mchog tu dge ba'i byang chub sems dpas ④gsang bar bya ba yin no/ /de nas bslab pa'i gzhi pham pa'i gnas su gyur pa sdom pa 'jig pa'i rgyu bstan cing / nyes byas kyi ltung ba nyon mongs pa can dang nyon mongs pa can ma yin pa yang bstan par bya'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis mdor bsdus pa byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa nyi shu pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i tshul khrims kyi le'u bshad par bya'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i cho ga /slob dpon chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar byi mkhan po de nyid dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ④ba dge slong dge ba'i blo gros kyis bsgyur ba lags so / /⑤slad kyis rjopaṇ+ḍi ta de nyid dang / lo tsā ⑦ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bcos shing gtan la phab pa④ //65—675

bsdur mchan/667 ༅/mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa sa / /sems bskyed pa dang sdom pa'i cho ga'i rim pa bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉cistot+pa ta/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉por/668 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉gyi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉nekyi/ ①〈〈snar 〉〉 kyi/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 kyi/ me〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kyi/ ⑥ 〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉por/ ni〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stanas/669 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanazung / ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉 kyi/ ②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉tal/ du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stana'o/④〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradi/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉rem/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stag/671 tu 〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉par/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉rnal/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pang 'dren/ rjo〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉spon/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉)bros/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉〉bsams la/ 〈〈snar 〉〉bsams pas/672 kye〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉de/ 〈〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉po/673 ①〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bslab/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dpa'i/ du〈〈pe 〉〉gyur pa/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉sdus/675 64〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapa'i sdom pa la/ ezhu〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉stanapa'/ me〈〈pe〉྾〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/ du〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉// // skyo〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉nyakyi/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉phots+tsha/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉pa'o/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (150)65wa 676

3201༄ga /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i cho ga hu sngal/ /rgya gar skad du/ bo dhi satwa sasba ra kṛṇ+ḍa ṭubi bye/ bod skad du—/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i cho ga /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla med bsam gyis mi khyab 'bras bu skye ba yi/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpag bsam shing ljon sa bon ni/ /sdom pa dam pa bskyed cing spel bar byed pa ste/ /'bras bu mchog des sems can tshogs rnams tshim par byed/ /'dir nges par sdom pa gzung ba ni sdom pa 'bogs pa'i cho ga la mkhas shing /len 'dod kyi sdom pa dang ldan pa'i bla mas gsungs pa'i rjes su brjod par bya ste/dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas sam maṇ+ḍal med kyang rung ste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bkyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid 'tsho'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi bhu mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du zhi ba 'dod chags dang bral ba 65—677

rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /ji srid 'tsho'i bar du tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de ltar gsum mo/ /skyabs gsum yongs su 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen du bdag gzung ①du gsol②/ de'i rjes su bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spong ngo / /srog gcod pa las rab tu ldog par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pa las log par g.yem pa dang /brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par gyur pa bag med pa'i gnas las rab tu ldog par bkyi'o/ /de ltar gsum mo/ /deng nas bzung —nas/ bdag mchog gi dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol zhes pa'o/ /de ltar 'dis ④yan lag gsum yongs su rdzogs pa dang / yan lag lnga yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge bsnyen du 'gyur ro/ /bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa nyin zhag gcig pa ni rtag tu mi 'dogs pa'i rgyan bzhag ste/ nyi ma shar ba nas sngar bzhin du bzung sneste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid sang gi nyi ma ma thushar gyi bar du srog gcod pa spong ngo / /srog gcod pa las slar ldog par bgyi'o/ /de bzhin du ma byin par len pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba 7bag med pa'i gnas dang / khri stan mthon po dang / mal stan chen po dang / dri dang / phreng ba dang / byug pa dang / kha dog 'chang ba dang / gar dang / glu dang / rol mo'i sgra dang / ltad mo blta ba dang / dus ma yin pa'i kha zas las rab tu ldog par bgyi'o/ /dgra bcom pa yon tan brgyad kyis brgyan 65—678

nas bzhugs pa bzhin du ①bgyi'o/ /bdag gis ④gso sbyong gi tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa 'di yang sems kyi rgyan dang / sems kyi yo byad dang /rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang / ma thob pa'i don gyi mchog sangs rgyas nyid thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /de ltar gsum mo/ /de ltar 'di ni bsnyen gnas yan lag brgyad pa'i sdom pa ste 'phags pa rnams dang nye bar gnas par 'gyur ro/ /nyin par tsam yang dag par len pa la dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid nyi ma nub kyi bar du zhes brjod par bya'o/ /mtshan mo tsam la ni dus 'di nas bzung dunas ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du zhes brjod par bya'o/ /gso sbyong gi sdom pa kho na ji srid 'tsho'i bar du len pa ni go mi'i sdom pa ste—/ de blang ba ni dus 'di nas bzung ④nas ji srid 'apa'i bar du zhes brjod par bya'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa don du gnyer bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs mdun du byas nas mchod pa byas te/ de'i mdun du dkon mchog gsum dang bla ma'i maṇ+ḍal byas nas nye bar spyod pa lngas yang dag par mchod de/phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la rab tu dang ba yang dag par bskyed nas phyag byas te/ pus mo gnyis sa la btsugs pa 'am tsog tsog por yang rung bas thal mo sbyar te mdun du 'dug nas bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bya ste/ rigs kyi bu bdag byed las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par len pa de la spro yis/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi sdom pa thugs brtse ba'i slad du byed du gsol zhes de ltar gsum mo/ /bla ma des 'di ltar brjod de/ byed kyis byang chub tu smon lam btab bam/65—679

bdag las byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims kyi babe+eb pa 'dzin par 'dod dam zhes pa yang gsum mo/ /des kyang 'dzin par 'tshal bo zhes dam bca' bar bya'o—/ /bla ma las 'di skad du brjod par bya ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / ma dang pha dang sems can gzhan la brten nas skye ba 'di dang gzhan rnams su sdig pa'i las gang cung zhig bgyis par gyur pa dang bgyid du zad ba dang rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi'o / /shes shing dran pas mi 'chab bo zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ①ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du / rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa mkhyen pa thams cad ston pa 'jigs pa thams cad las 'das pa skyes bu chen po mi phyed pa'i sku bla na med pa'i sku la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog zhi ba'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgye bas mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las bsgral bar bya ba'i phyir dang / gdon par bya ba'i phyir dang / yongs su bskyab par bya ba'i phyir dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bla na med pa la rab tu dgod par bya ba'i phyir/ ji ltar 'das pa dang da ltar dang ma byon pa'i byang chub sems 65—680

dpas byang chub tu sems bskyed de sangs rgyas pa dang 'tshang rgya ba dang 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sgrib pa med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes dang sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis mkhyen cing gzigs pa dang / ji lta ba bzhin du chos rnams kyi chos nyid mkhyen cing rjes su mkhyen pa'i cho ga des/bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas slob dpon ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mdun du/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag gis sdig pa bshags pa dang / gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa las byung ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar bgyi'o/ /'jig rten na skyob pa med pa dang / skyabs med pa dang / gnas med pa dang / dpung gnyen med pa dang / gling med pa rnams kyi skyob ①pa dang / skyabs dang gnas dang / dpung gnyen dang / gling du 'gyur bar bgyi zhing /sems can thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho las ma brgal ①ba rnams bsgral ba dang /yongs su mi ldog pa'i sgrib pa med pa'i chos kyi dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi ba dang / dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas de ltar byang chub tu sems bskyed nas mtha' yas pa'i sems can gyi khams la ji ltar ma dang pha dang sring mo dang spun zla dang bu dang bu mo dang / gzhan yang nye du dang snag gi gnyen ④mtshams su gnas pa de ltar rab tu gzung ngo / /rab tu bzung nas kyang nus pa ji lta ba dang / stobs ji lta ba dang / snod ji lta 65—681

ba bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bskyed par bkyi'o/ /'di nas bzung nas ⑨gang cung zhig sbyin pa gtong bar 'gyur ba dang / tshul khrims srung bar 'gyur ba dang / bzod pa sgom ②par 'gyur ba dang / brtson 'grus rtsom par 'gyur ba dang / bsam gtan la sems mnyam par 'jog par 'gyur ba dang / shes rab rnam par dpyod par 'gyur ba dang / thabs mkhas pa la slob par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du'o/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las brtsams te sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de rnams theg pa chen po la yang dag par 'jug par byed pa des byang chub sems dpa' bdag slob pas 'di nas bzung nas khrubyang chub sems dpar slob dpon gyis gzung du gsol zhes lan gsum mo/ /'di dag thams cad byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs de nyid kyi mdun du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la phyag byas nas bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba las ming 'di skad ces bgyi ba 'dis byang chub sems dpa' ④tshul khrims kyi sdom pa yang dag par blangs so zhes bya'o/ /de 'dra ba'i bla ma yang med na rang gis yang dag par blang bar bya ste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol zhes bya ba dang / slob dpon ming 'di zhes bkyi ba bzhag nas/ 'di nas bzung nas bdag byang chub sems dpar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpas gzung du gsol zhes bya ba'i bar du brjod par bya'o/ /de ltar mkhyen par gsol ba'i mthar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas ⑤bsngags pa dang / rtag tu 'di'i dge ba mngon par 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir dgongs par 'gyur ro/ /65—682

byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod las gsungs pa'i cho ga bsdus pa'o/ /gzhung 'di'i bsod nams bdud rtsi yis/ /sems can yongs su tshim byas te/ /mkhas pa 'jigs pa med pa ni/ /kun rig dpag bsam go 'phang shog /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas bsdus pa'i sdom pa bzung ba'i cho ga rdzogs sto①// //kha che'i paṇ+ḍi ta chen po shākya shrī bha dra dang / chag lo tsā ba ②dge slong dgra bcom gyis bsgyur ba'o// //bsdur mchan/677 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉phro ra / /byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gzung ba'i cho ga slob dpon 'jigs med 'byung gnas sbas pas mdzad pa bzhugs so//zhes 'khod/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉d+kusna/ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉rgarnams kyi/678 ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thazung / ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉7lo// ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ngozung / ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉d+kudi/⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉razung / bu〈〈snar 〉7ma/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉ra ra pa/679 ①〈〈pe 〉sko'ar 〉7du/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉ṅkagis/ ①bu〈〈pe 〉sko' ra 〉razung /68༷ ①〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉'izung /681 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉skyo sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉zabal/ 1〈〈snar 〉ranyan/682 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉rgabazung nas/ ④〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉thasgom/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈zhar 〉7bdag ④〈〈pe 〉snga〈snar 〉〉dpa'i/ rjo〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉rapa'/683 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'a ra 〉she / ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉lots+tsha/65byed683

༄ga /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bdun byu pa/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri sha ra ṇa sap+ta nyi/ bod skad du/gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bdun cu pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge bsnyen gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /de ni sdom brgyad rtsa ba yin/ /sangs rgyas de'i chos dge 'dun ni/ /thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyi skyabs/ /dus gsum lam las nges grol zhing / /shes bya la ni blo rnam rgyas/ /rmongs pa'i zum pa bcom pas na/ /sangs rgyas pad ma ltar rnam rgyas / /thog mtha' med pa'i srid pa ru/ /ma rig gnyid kyis log pa yi/ /'gro la gang gang snang de de/ /brdzun te rmi lam lta bur 'dod/ /ma rig gnyid ni rgyun chad cing / /yang dag ye shes nges 'byung bas/ /gang zhig rnam sad de sangs rgyas/ /skyes bu gnyid sangs ji bzhin no/ /yang dag de nyid ston mdzad cing / /mi mkhas sems can rtogs mdzad pas/ /des kyang 65byed685

sangs rgyas sangs rgyas dang / /de yang sangs rgyas dang mtshungs 'dod/ /ye shes bla na med pa yis/ /yang na de nyid thugs chud pa'am/ /zhi ba nyid kyis rtogs sangs rgyas/ /de bas sangs rgyas sangs rgyas 'dod/ /sangs rgyas kyi ni gzugs kyi sku/ /mtshan dang dpe byad dag gis 'bar/ /'gro ba rang gi mos pa yi/ /dbang gis khyesna tshogs skur 'dzin gang / /bsod nams tshogs ni tshad med las/ /'khrungs pa de ni rgyal ba'i sras/ /sa bcu la ni gnas rnams kyis/ /mthong bar gyur pa sku de yis/ /chos kyi rdzogs longs spyod 'di rgo / /rgyal sras rnams ni spyod pa yin/ /rgyal ba sku de la bzhugs nas/ /bla med byang chub thugs su chud/ /ye shes spros pa med pa gang / /shes bya skye med pa las byung / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos sku de/ /ye shes tshogs las byung ba yinaphu/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ma 'dres chos/ /stobs dang ldan pa bco brgyad dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi stobs sogs kyis/ /ye shes de ni yang dag brgyan/ /ngo bo nyid ni rgyu rkyen las/ /'byung bar 'gyur ba rigs min te/ /rgyu dang rkyen las byung ba ni/ /rang bzhin bcos ma yin par 'gyur//ngo bo nyid rgo bcos ma ru/ /ji ltar yang ni 'gyur ba yin/ /bcos ma ma yin ngo bo ni/ /gzhan la ltos ①pa yod ma yin/ /chos rnams nyid kyi ngo bo ni/ /thams cad yod pa ma yin te/ /de phyir skad cig gcig gis ni/ /bde gshegs thams cad mkhyen par 'dod/ /ma rig nyon mongs can byas rtog /rang gi ngo bo sgo btags 'dod/ /byis pa rnams kyi 'khor ba'i rgyu/ /de rtogs gyur pa log shes yin/ /ma rig nyon mongs med yod pas/ /rnam pa kun mkhyen spangs pa nyid/ /slob ma rang sangs rgyas dag gis/ /byang chub 65—686

dngos po med pa yin/ /rgyal bas dngos po de rnams ni/ /gzugs brnyan dang yang 'dra mkhyen pas/ /gnyis med ye shes ma rig zad/ /shes bya skye med pas ①rab phye/ /de bas de ni cung zad kyang / /mi mkhyen ci yang ston mi mdzad—/ /sangs rgyas nam mkha' ji bzhin du/ /de ltar chos nyid la rab bzhugs—/ /yid bzhin nor bu ci yang ni/ /mi 'byed rtogs ④pa med na yang / /'gro ba'i bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /tshim par byed pa yin par bshad/ /rdzogs sangs thugs ①kyi rin chen ni/ /rang gi mos bzhin dgongs mdzad pas//'gro ba'i bya ba de dang ni/ /de bzhin mdzad par go ba yin/ /de yi phyir na 'phags pa rnams/ /bsam mi khyab pa'i rkyen las 'khrungs/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bya ba ni/ /mthong la 'thad pa yod ma yin/ /chos rnams dngos med nyid la ni/ /blo gnas sangs rgyas yin par bshad/ /'og min gzhal yas khang du ni/ /yang dag mngon sum yin par 'dod/ /sangs rgyas rtogs pa mnga' ba yirjo/ /gzugs kyi skur ni yang dag byung ⑤/ /sprul pa'i skus ni sa steng du'ang / /yang dag byang chub ston par mdzad/ /thub dbang rnams kyi sku gsum ste/ /chos dang longs spyod rdzogs sprul pa/ /mdor bsnyus nas ni bshad pa 'di/ /gus pas blo la bzhag par gyis④/ /sngon med pa las sbar byung zhing / /byung nas kyang ni yang dag med/ /rang gi ngo bo 'dzin pas chos//don dam par ni mi brjod ④do/ /gang zhig rmi lam sgyu ma dang / /chu zla lta bur slu byed pa/ /skyes sogs dang ldan de spang bya'i/ /chos spang ④bar ni rigs ma yin—/ /dus gsum du yang dngos gcig phyir/ /ngo bo nyid kyis rtag tu 'byung / /rga shi dag las grol ba nyid/ /chos rnams kyi ni chos zhes ⑨bshad/ /65—687

zad dang chags bral mya ngan 'das/ /'gog dang stong pa nyid zhi ba/ /de bzhin nyid kyang chos rnams kyis/ /rang gi ngo bo de nyid bshad/ /lam gang mya ngan 'das 'gro ba/ /thub pa rnams kyis yang dag gsungs/ /de yi rgyud las skyes gyur pas/ /des ni mngon sum dag tu gzigs/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam pa bzhi/ /rtogs te shes nas dad gyur pas/ /skyes bu gang zag zung brgyad po/ /mi phyed dge 'dun zhes bshad do/ /nyon mongs gzhom phyir slob pas na/ /gang zag bdun ni slob pa yin/ /nyes pa ma lus zad pa'i phyir/ /brgyad pa mi slob par bshad do/ /de rnams 'bras bur gnas pa bzhirka/ /bzhi ni zhugs pa po yin la/ /ston pa'i slob ma'i tshogs 'di ni/ /grol dang grol ba'i lam la gnas/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ni/ /bdud rnams bye ba brgya yis kyang / /gang phyir dbye bar mi nus pa/ /de phyir dge 'dun zhes bshad do/ /thub dbang gi ni sku gsum dang / /mya ngan 'das dang gang zag brgyad/ /sdom brtson bcas la mos pa yis/ /gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba/ /dge bsnyen du ni dam bcas pas/ /skyabs ni gsum po bsrung bar bya/ /mu stegs kun la gus pa yis/ /mchod dang phyag 'tshal mi bya'o/ /rten gyi dam pa blangs ①nas ni/ /slar yang dman la brten gyur na/ /nyes byas phyogs la gnas pa'i phyir/ /de ni dam pa'i bzhad gad 'gyur—/ /gang zhig 'phags lam ma skyes pa'i/ /byis rmongs so so'i skye bo dag /de ni slob dang mi slob pa/ /min zhes bstan bcos las bshad do/ /ji ltar 'khor lo la sogs pa/ /nyer bzung 'khor lor btags pa ni/ /yang dag gzhan du rnam dpyad pas/ /rnam pa kun du mi dmigs so/ /de bzhin 65—688

phung po nas brtsams te/ /sems can du ni btags pa yang / /yang dag gzhan du dpyad byas pas/ /ci nas kyang ni dmigs mi 'gyur/ /de 'dir thar pa'i cha nas ni/ /brtsams te rtag tu dge ba la/ /nyan thos 'di ①phyir 'bad na ni/ /rim gyis nyan thos nyid du 'gyur/ /gang zhig rang byung ye shes 'dod/ /rang rgyal byang chub don gnyer bas/ /rtsol ba de yang rang rgyal gyis—/ /byang chub kho na des 'thob bo/ /rang don la gzhol 'di dag ni/ /snying rje chen po dang bral bas/ /rang rgyal rgyal ba'i gsung las skyes/ /theg pa chen por mi bsngags so/ /rgyal ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa/ /theg pa che las gsungs pa dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu thos nas/ /des ni snod nyid 'gyur ba yin/ /de lani theg pa chen po'i shing / /ma lus rang gi las kyis ①bsregs/ /byang chub sems dpa'i nang du ni/ /skyes bu dbul po lta bur gnas/ /'di dag srid pas skrag pa yi/ /yid kyis byang chub gnyis thob pa—/ /tshe zad par ni dgar 'gyur zhing / /mya ngan 'das thob ④'du shes can—/ /de la mya ngan 'das yod min/ /'on kyang srid gsum skye ba ⑤ni/ /de dag la yang med mod kyi/ /zag pa med pa'i dbyings na 'khod/ /mi shes nyon mongs min spong buphyir/ /phyis ni sangs rgyas kyis bskul bas/ /byang chub kyi ni tshogs bsags nas/ /de yang 'jig rten 'dren par 'gyur/ /'khor los sgyur ba rgyal po yi/ /mtshan gyis dze+eyang dag brgyan pa la/ /blo dang ldan yang sgeblon po yis/ /rgyal po lta bur mtho bar mthong / /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dag gis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi rigs byung ba'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' blo ldan yang / /thub pa'i dbang po lta bur mthong / /byang chub 65—689

sems ni legs bskyed pa'i/ /sdom brtson mchil lham khur ba la①/ /byang chub sems sogs la gus pas/ /dgra bcom pa yis bzlog par bshad/ /shar ri'i lung las dgra bcom pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' phyag byas nyid/ /'di dag dkon mchog gsum gzhan min/ /sangs rgyas khongs su gtogs par 'dod / /ji ltar dgra bcom zad ye shes/ /sa bdun sngon ④du 'gro ba can/ /de bzhin rdzogs sangs rgyas ye shes/ /sa bcu sngon du 'gro ba yin/ /'di ni gcig pu mi 'gro yi1/ /sa bcu po ni sbyong byed de/ /gang phyir pha rol phyin pa bcus—/ /sa de rnams la rdzogs par byed/ /'bras bur gnas dang zhugs pa ni/ /'phags pa'i lam gyis rab phye ba'i/ /slob pa rnams kyi sa bdun —/ /mngon pa'i chos las ji skad bshad/ /de bzhin sde snod rgyas pa las/ /sa bcu'i bsngags pa brjod pa yin/ /thams cad 'phags lam bdag nyid can/ /de las 'phags min ji ltar 'gyur/ /nyan thos rnams kyi dbang mdzad nas/ /sde snod gsum du 'dod pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i gnas skabs kyi/ /nges pa der ni yod ma yin/ /'phags pa nub kyi rir bshad dang / /shar gyi ri pa'i nyan thos kyis/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang byas pa/ /sde snod bdun du bshad pa yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang / /de bzhin rig 'dzin zhes bya dang / /mdo sde chos mngon 'dul ba dang / /rgyas dang de bzhin skyes pa'i rabs/ /de ltar sde snod bdun po ni/ /lung ni gnyis las bstan pa yin/ /gang la de ni tshad min gyur④/ /des ni dgra bcom spangs pa nyid—/ /shes bya mtha' yas dbang gis na/ /'khor ba na ni skad cig yod/ /gal te re re'i dbye bas ring / /de bzhin 'di yang srid mtshungs 'gyur/ /65—690

bya ba rgya chen byed pa'i phyir/ /srid pa ring snyam ①mi sems so/ /bsod nams ye shes stobs kyis ni/ /lus sems sdug bsngal gyis mi non/ /de bas rnam pa thams cad du/ /byang chub sems dpa' smad mi bya/ /khams gsum par gtogs nyon mongs zad/ /byang chub kyi ni snod gyur nyid/ /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /gzugs brnyan mtshungs par mthong bas na/ /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dag ni/ /stong ni gnyis dang gsum po mthong / /rnam pa kun mkhyen ye shes ni/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi yin par bshad/ /rgyal bas lam gyi rnam pa shes/ /byang chub sems dpa' yin par gsungs/ /rab tu dga' ba thob pa na/ /kun sbyor gsum po legs zad pas/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'phags 'gyur zhing / /rdzogs sangs rigs las byung ba yin/ /sa ni gong ma gong ma la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan dang / /nyes zad gang yin sa bcu pa'i/ /mdo nyid las ni shes par bya/ /yon tan dam pa re re zhing / /mtha' yas de ni mkha' dang mnyam/ /byang chub la sems rtag phyag 'tshal—/ /blo ldan byang chub la skyabs mchi/ /theg chen tshul la brten nas ni//skyabs gsum rnam par phye ba las/ /bsod nams gang des 'jig rten rnams/ /dkon mchog gsum la mchog gzhol shog /gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bdun cu pa—/ slob dpon zla ba grags pa'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po paṇ+ḍi ta chen po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //65—691

nas /skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa/①༄tsho/ /rgya gar skad du/ ṣa ḍi a ga sha ⑤ra khaṃ/ bod skad du/skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo /skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa bshad/ /cis 'gro dgos dang yul dus dang / /phan yon bslab bya blang ba rnams/ /rtsa ba sdom du bshad pa yin/ /'jigs dang yon tan dran pas 'gro/ /gnas gsum bstan pa'i yul de la/ /'di nas byang chub thob par ro/ /mu stegs spyod las log pa yin/ /gsum du mi skye rten du 'gyur/ /bar chad med pas nad nyung ④ring / /'byang zhing sogs pa'i phan yon no④ / /skyabs gsum dang po'i babe+eb bya ni/ /gnod sbyin mi bsten phyag mi 'tshal/ /gnyis pa sems can thams cad la/ /'tshe ba spang zhing brtse bar bya/ /gsum pa bdag dang gzhan gyi yul/ /sdig pa can dang 'grogs pa min/ /sku gzugs tshigs su bcad pa dang / /lhan pa ser po 65—693

btab pa la/ /dad mos sgo nas brten par bdag① /zhal nas gsungs pa mtha' dag la/ /skur pa mi gdab spyi bor blang / /gang zag dag dang ma dag la / /dam par blta bar bya ba yin/ /lus srog phyir yang gsum mi spang / /dus 'dir rkyen rnams buci byung yang / /mgon skyabs gzhan du btsal ba min/ /che ba'i yon tan zas ①dag gis/ /rtag tu dran cing mchod pa yin/ /rgyun gyi skyabs 'gro brjod bya ba/ /dus drug rgyun gyi ④bskul ma yin/ /blang ba dang por shes bya ba/ /'jigs pa byung tshe bskul ma yin/ /rgyud la shes bya mang mchis kyang / /rgyal blon yid ches ma gyur pas/ /skyabs 'gro'i cho ga bdag gis bshad/ /legs par bris shig ku mā ra/ /bsod nams 'gro ba yang dul bsngo—/ /skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa/ slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa sdogs so// //65byed694

bsdur mchan/692 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa gag /skyabs 'gro yan lag drug pa slob dpon bi ma las mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉stan sa/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉lhung / ④〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉rna/694 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'ar 〉thartan par brtag ②〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉〉pang / ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉tshod/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉gyis/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉yongs/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (153)65wa 695

༄ga /1nga ba bshags pa'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā ④pasbyi de sha na be+e bye/ bod skad du/ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi ba byis pa nyid dang / mi shes pa nyid kyis 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug dang / phrag dog dang / ser sna'i dbang gis/ lus ma bsgoms pa dang / tshul khrims ma bsgoms pa dang / shes rab ma bsgoms pa dang /dran pa nyams pa nyid kyis/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis dge slong dang rjes su mthun pa ma lags pa bgyis pa dang / bgyid du stsal ba dang / gzhan barmid pa la rjes su yi rang ba de dag thams cad/ dge 'dun btsun pa rnams la bzod par 1gsol kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ khyed la ji ltar bzod par gsol ba de bzhin du mkhan po dang / slob dpon dang / lhan cig skyes 65byed696

pa dang / chos dang lta ba mthun pa dang / rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba dang /gtsug lag khang dang brang khang na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha dang / lam dang nye ba'i lam na gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha dang / bstan pa 'di la mngon par dga' ba'i lha dang / gzhan gyi bstan pa la mngon par dga' ba'i lha dang /pha dang / ma dang / gtong ba po dang / sbyin bdag dang / ji srid srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi sems can te①/ 'phrog ma'i bu lnga brgya 'khor dang bcas pa dang / nag po chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la nongs pa bgyis pa gang lags pa de bdag gi tshul khrims kyi yung po la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i sbad du bzod par gsol gyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas—/ thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /dge 'dun btsun pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge slong ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ldung ba rigs lnga po dag la3/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyis sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang mjug rnams su/ 'dod chags kyis kun nas bslang ba dang / zhe sdang gis kun nas bslang ba dang / gti mug gis kun nas bslang ba dang / chad pas kun nas babe+eng ba dang / skyed kyis kun nas babe+eng ba dang / de'i tshan du gtogs pa dang / de'i sder gtogs pa dang / de'i rigs 3su gtogs pa dang / de'i mtshan nyid dang / de'i ngo bo nyid dang / nang du btsos pa dang / nang du zhag lon pa dang / ched du byas pa dang / btang nas za ba dang / kham 'phror bcad pa dang / kha bkang nas smra ba dang / lag nyar blangs pa dudang / byin len ma byas pa dang / gsog 'jog byas pa dang /65—697

dus ma yin pa'i zas te①/ mdor na phas pham pa'i chos bzhi dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i ltung ba sbom po sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi dang / mjug gis bsdus pa dang / dge 'dun lhag ma'i chos bcu gsum dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbom po sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug dang /spang ba'i ltung byed kyi chos sum cu dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug dang / rtsang byed kyi chos bcu dgu ②dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang /mjug dang / so sor bshags par bya ba'i chos bzhi dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug dang / babe+eb par bya ba'i chos brgya rtsa mang po dang / des kun nas babe+eng ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug dang / rtsod pa nye bar zhi bar bya ba'i chos bdun dang / des kun nas bslang ba'i nyes pa sbyor ba dang / dngos gzhi dang / mjug ste/ de dag dang / gzhan yang gang sangs rgyas kyis bcas pa'i bslab pa dang 'gal ba dang / dge 'dun kyis bcas pa'i nang khrims dral ba dang / gos ④pa dang / gos par bgyis pa ④de dag thams cad bdag gi tshul khrims kyi phung po la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba'i slad du/ dge 'dun byi spyan sngar mi 'chab pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags so//mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur lags so/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bzlas/ lhang ba de dag la rtsang bar mthong ngam/ kha cig la khums lags—/ phyin chad shin tu legs par sdom mam/ chos ji lta ba dang 'dul 65—698

ba ji lta ba dang ston pa'i bstan pa ji lta ba bzhin du legs par sdom lags kyis/yang 'di ltar shes bzhin du phyin chad mi bgyid lags so zhes dang / thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga thams cad yod par smra ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta de ba shārnyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā na dang / bod kyi lo tsā ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa// //bsdur mchan/696 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉phro ༄ga /ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga paṇ+ḍi ta de ba shārnyis mdzad pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉mos/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉 rnyo〈〈snar 〉〉mdzad du/697 7〈〈pe 〉〉〈pornor 〉〉de/ ②〈〈snar 〉〉snga/ ④〈〈snar 〉stares/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉spong ba/698 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉dang / ②〈〈pe 〉lo〈snar 〉stanagu bcu/ ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉stanams/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉ngokus par ma bgyi ba/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (154)65wa 699

3205dam /smung ba bshags pa'i cho ga①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ ā 1patrī de sha na bi dhi/ bod skad du/ltung ba bshags pa'i cho ga /sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ btsun pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas 'khor ba thog ma ma mchis pa nas tha ma da lta la thug gi bar du 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug gi dbang gis lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sgo nas mi dge ba bcu bgyis pa dang /mtshams med pa lnga dang / de dang nye ba lnga dang / so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang 'gal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i babe+eb pa dang 'gal ba dang /gsang sngags kyi dam tshig dang 'gal ba la sogs pa mdor na mtho ris dang thar pa'i gegs su gyur cing / 'khor ba dang ngan song gi rgyur gyur pa'i nyes rtsang 65—700

gi tshogs ci mchis pa de dag thams cad bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /btsun pa'i spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so/ /mi 'chab bo/ /mthol zhing bshags na bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur byi/ ma mthol ma bshags na de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas mthong sdom dris la thabs yin no/ /legs so zhes brjod do/ /dang por spyor ba'i cho ga ni/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas kyi nyon mongs pa mang ba'am/ bag med pa la sogs pa'i stobs kyis nyes ltung gi tshogs mang po bdog ste mchi bas/ de dag dge 'dun byi spyan sngar bshags par 'tshal bas thugs kyis gzung ①'tshal zhes pa dang mjug thong ba las babe+eng ba shin tu bka' drin che lags zhes pa dang / chos bzhin du mdzad pa rjes su yi rang zhes brjod par bya'o/ /lhung ba bshags pa'i cho ga slob dpon dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po de nyid dang / bod kyi lo tsā ②ba dge slong tshul khrims rgyal bas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pazhu// //65—701

༄ga /kha ton glegs bam klog pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga bzhugs so//①༄4/ /kha ton dang glegs bam klag ④pa'i sngon du bya ba'i cho ga /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po re zhig byang chub sems dpa' chos kha ton du bya bar 'dod pa dang glegs bam du bya ba klog par 'dod pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi ④sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la gsol ba btab ste/ yid kyis kun du dmigs la/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang po'i spyod pa'i smon lam gyi cho gas④/ phyag 'tshal ba la sogs pa yan lag bdun gyi tshul du mchod pa rnams kyis yang dag par mchod do/ /de'i rjes la sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems nye bar gzhag byeste/ yang dag pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pas de ltar bsams pa'i rjes la/ tshig lan gsum brjod par bya ba ni/bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos kyi tshig gcig gi don gang yin pa de ni 65—703

chos thams cad kyi yang yin na/ 'on kyang bdag ni rang gi las kyi ①nyes pas shes rab chung zhing blo zhen te④/ de lta yin du zin kyang / gang bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab bzung nas des bdag gi kha ton byas te/ chos kyi sgra de sems can gang gi rna lam du grag ①pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spobs pa thob par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das kyis dugasungs pa'i chos tshig gcig gi don gang yin pa de ni/ chos thams cad kyi yang yin na/ 'on kyang bdag ni rang gi las kyi ④nyes pas shes rab chung zhing blo zhen tebu/ de ltar yin du zin kyang / gang bdag gis glegs bam du byas pa'i chos klag ⑦par bya ste/ chos kyi sgra de sems can gang rnams kyi rna lam du grag ⑧pa de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spobs pa thob par gyur cig /ces lan gsum du brjod par bya'o/ /kha ton dang glegs bam klag ⑨pa'i cho ga /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //

bsdur mchan/7༷3 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉ltar bkod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bklag ①〈〈snar 〉〉wakyi/ du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉stan ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag7༷4 ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉tonan/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kugs/ du〈〈pe 〉sno)/ ⑤〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉4)sa/du〈〈pe 〉tonan/ 〈〈snar 〉smonan te/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bklag ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉kugs/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bklagabasdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (156)65wa 705

3207༄ga /tsha tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bakhrugs/①༄4/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i tsha tsha ②gdab pa'i cho ga /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /①na mo bha ga ba te/ be+e ro tsa na ④pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyashā ⑤bud+dhā ya/ tar+ya thā/ oṃ susmre ⑥sa me sa ma ye sa ma te ④sa mā ro pe a na ba ra ṇizhata re bhe/ ya sho/ ⑨ma hā te dze⑩/ ni ra ku le/ ni ra ⑪ba ṇi/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ z-i da ya/ a tijo ⑩na a dhibye te swā hā/ gzungs 'di ⑫'jim pa'i gong bu'am bye ma'i gong bu la lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas la mchod rten bya'o/ /mchod rten de la rdul phra rab kyi grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi mchod rten bye ba byas par 'gyur ro/ /rdul phra rab grangs ji snyed yod pa de snyed kyi lha dang mi rnams kyi skye ba phun sum tshogs pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa na skye ba dran par 'gyur ro/ /myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 65—706

byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /dang por 'jim pa brdung ba bdag gam gzhan yang rung bas byams pa dang snying rjes byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya zhing brdung ngo / /de nas 'bi 'bi byin byis brlab ①pa/'og min nas bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal bo/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs pa la phyag 'tshal sdebar bsam zhing / sngags kyi grangs gong ma bzhin du brjod do/ /de nas rten ①'byel gyi sngags bzlas shing gdab po/ /de nas 'bru'am me tog la rten dhi'abyel gyi sngags lan gsum mam bdun bzlas la dbul lo/ /de nas/bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /job nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te/ /rga nad 'chi ba'i dba' klong 'khrugs pa yi/ /srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba 'don par shog /ces smon lam gdab bo/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga /slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs stodu// // rjoye dharmā he tu pra bha bā he tudhe ṣān ta thā ga to khya ba ⑦data/ te ṣāñca yo ni ro dha e baṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// //65—707

bsdur mchan/7༷6 ①mtshan byang 'di 〈〈sde 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa sa / /pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa'i sāts+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉slats+tsha/ ③〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉 sko du〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nā ya/ du〈〈snar 〉〉bamyagakle/ du〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉〉suḥ/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉sta'irnye brnye/ yin ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉paste/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉〉wa ti/ ⑩〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉mdza/ ⑪〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ni ri/ ⑫〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉burtse/ a dhiji/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉toradis/7༷7 ①〈〈snar 〉〉brlabs/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉btsal/ ③du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉brten/ du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉so/⑥〈〈pe〉sko〈snar 〉〉〉sko ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wab/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (157)65wa 708

༄ga /bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa/①༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ gu ru kri ④ya kra ma/ bod skad du/ bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang por tshad dang ldan pa'i slob dpon byis/ slob ma la dad pa dang yid ches pa dang 'dod pa'i dad pa bskyed ①la/ de nas byang chub kyi sems kyi phan yon brjod la spro ba bskyed par bya'o/ /de nas gnas khang khyad par can du mchod pa'i tshogs khyad par can bshams la/ 'phags pa'i tshogs spyan drangs te/ phyag 'tshal ④ba dang / zhabs bsil zhing gdan dbul ⑤ba dang / bla na yod pa dang / bla na med pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs kyis legs par mchod cing / mchod pa'i sprin gyi sngags kyang lan gsum brjod do/ /bstod rjopa byed pas bde bar gshegs pa'i yon tan khyad par can dran pa'i sgo nas gus pas bstod cing / de dang de 'phel ba'i tshig kyang brjod do/ /de 65—709

nas bshags pa dang / rjes su yi rang ba dang / bskul ba dang / gsol ba gdab pa dang / bsngo ba la sogs pa bya ste/ de nas slob ma dad pa dang ldan pas slob dpon la phyag byas la/ gsol ba gdab pa la sogs pas byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis legs par bskyed la/ de dag gi rang gi ngo bo dang /dbye ba dang / khyad par yang brjod do/ /de nas byang chub kyi spyod pa pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi dang / tshad sked pa bzhi la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang / bslab pa'i go rims hudang / nyams pa dang / ma nyams pa'i skyon yon dang / tshul ji ltar bslab pa la sogs pa yang rgyas par bstan par bya'o/ /de yang bag yod pa dang / shes bzhin dang / dran pas zin par bya'o zhes bslab par bya'o/ /de dag gi mtshan nyid dang / go rims ④dang / nyams pa dang / ma nyams pa'i skyon yon la sogs pa yang bslab par bya'o/ /de dag byed pa la yang brtson 'grus drag po ldu/bskyed la ji ④snyam pa dang / sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i bzod pa dang / ma yengs pa'i bsam gtan dang shes rab kyi ⑤rang bzhin med par shes par byas la/ babe+eb pa gsum mam/ shes rab rnam pa gsum la mnyam par gzhag ⑥pa dang / spyod lam gyi tshul byis babe+eb par bya'o zhes bstan par bya'o/ /mthar smon lam gyis yongs su rdzogs par kyis shig ces kyang brjod par bya'o/ /'di ni slob dpon kyis bstan pa'i las kyi go rims sog/slob mas kyang tshul ji ltar bstan pa de bzhin du bslab par bya'o/ /'di ni mtshan nyid theg pa chen po'i sems bskyed pa dang bslab pa bstan pa'i tshul lam go rims ④che long tsam bstan pa yin no/ /rgyas par ni gzhan nas shes par 65—710

bya'o—/ /bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po dpal mar me mdzad ye shes kyi zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //bsdur mchan/7༷9 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉lo'ar 〉phro sa bla ma'i bya ba'i rim pa mdor bsdus pa bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉shes/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉skyes/du〈〈pe 〉྾'dir 〉〉btsal/ 0〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉skarabul/ ⑥〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉snostod/71༷ ①②〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉rim/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pos/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉nemi/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉4)sa/ dhi〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉bzhag ⑦〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉stanam mo/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉starem/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (158)65—711

༄4/ /rgya gar skad du/ tri sasbra ra kra ma/ bod skad du/ sdom pa gsum kyi rim pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la byang chub sems dpa' khyem pa slob pa la/ bsnyen gnas dbog pa dang / dge bsnyen kyi sdom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems bskyed pa dang por bya'o/ /bsnyen gnas dbog pa ni/ btsun pa'am/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bgyi ba du/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /de bzhin du lan gnyis lan gsum du bya'o/ /de ltar btsun pas bdag la gsum la skyabs su song bar gzung ①du gsol zhes bya'o/ /btsun pa'am slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag dge bsnyen ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid sang nyi ma ma shar gyi bar du/ srog chags so cog 65—712

gsod pa dang / gzhan rmi nor 'phrog pa dang / mi tshangs par spyod pa dang /brdzun ①du smra ba dang / myos byed 'thung ba dang / dus ma yin par za ba dang / phreng ba dang / kha dog bsgyur ba dang / gar dang / glu dang /rtsed 'jo dang / mal stan mthon po la sogs pa ldog par bgyid pa/ yon tan brgyad kyis bdag dgra bcom pa rnams kyi tshul du 'jog go zhes bya ba ni bsnyen gnas dbog pa'o/ /tshe dang ldan pa brjod cing / bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'apa'i bar du rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /theg pa chen po'i chos mtha' dag la skyabs su mchi'o/ /tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /btsun pas bdag dge bsnyen du gzung du gsol/ thabs yin no—/ /legs so/ /tshe dang ldan pa brjod cig /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ji ltar 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'apa'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las log pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yang dus deng ②nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du srog gcod pa spangs te/ srog gcod pa las ④be+er ldog par bgyid do/ /yan lag dang po 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi babe+eb pa la rjes su slob pa dang ④rjes su sgrub po/ /rjes su bgyid do/ /gzhan yang 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gis ji srid 'apa'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang /'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang /65—713

bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ ma byen par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun ①du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par 'gyur ba'i ①bag med pa'i gnas las slar ldog pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ ma byin par len pa dang /'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun ①du smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang myos par gyur pa bag med pa'i gnas spangs te/ ma byin par len pa dang / 'dod pas log par g.yem pa dang / brdzun rjodu smra ba dang / 'bru'i chang dang / bcos pa'i chang stsos par 'gyur ba bag med pa'i gnas las be+er ldog par bgyid do/ /yan lag gnyis pa dang / gsum pa dang / bzhi pa dang / lnga pa 'dis bdag 'phags pa dgra bcom pa de dag gi basbab pa la rjes su bslab po/ /rjes su sgrub ⑤po/ /rjes su bkyid do/ /thabs yin no/ /legs so/ /dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dbog pa'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / byang chub sems dpa' chen po de dag gis/ byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed pa de bzhin du/bdag gis kyang deng nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du / sems can ma brgal ⑥ba rnams bsgral ba dang / sems can dze+em grol ba rnams dgrol ba dang / sems can dbugs ma phyin pa rnams dbugs phyin pa dang / sems can yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams ⑧mya ngan las bzla ⑨ba'i slad du/ byang chub kyi sems chen po bskyed par bgyi'o/ /bdag 65—714

gi de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi/ /spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni/ /bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis/ /lha dang mi ①la sogs pa ④dga' bar gyis①—/ /zhes de ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad la sogs pa'i lha dhirnams thams cad yid kyis phyedamigs te/ dad pa chen pos byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o/ /de ltar kun rdzob kyi rnam pa smon lam gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed do—/ /don dam pa la ni bsgoms dupa'i stobs kyis bskyed par bya'o/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /sdom pa gsum kyi rim pa/ slob dpon chen po rnyog med rdo rje'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rgya gar gyi mkhan po a tu be+e dā sa dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ④ba dge slong blo ldan shes rab kyis bsgyur ba'o// //

bsdur mchan/712 ①mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉〈snar 〉〉pa rig /sdom pa gsum gyi rim pa bzhugs/ zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bas/ ①〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bzung /713 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈'dir 〉〉rdzun/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉toradi/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉〉pa/ me〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉bo//714 5①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉)rdzun/ ②〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉ba/ ②du〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉mardzun/ ⑤〈〈snar 〉〉bsgrub/ rjo〈〈pe〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉tal/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉wasems can/ ⑧〈〈pe 〉po〈snar 〉〉〉yongs su/ ⑨〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉torada'/715 ①〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉min/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉mi pa/ ③〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉ba bgyis/ ④〈〈pe 〉〉lhag ⑤〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉kye/ du〈〈snar 〉〉bsgom/ ⑦〈〈pe 〉〉〈〈snar 〉〉thats+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (159)65wa 716

༄ga /chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa/①༄7/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tu dzā ②ga dharma tsār+ya①/ bod skad du/chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ston pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas ni/ /snying po byang chub mchis kyi bar/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum skyob pa bla med la/ /rab tu gus pas skyabs su mchi/ /rten gzung bar bya ba'i phyir skyabs su 'gro ba'i yan lag ste dang po'o/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis—/ /thog med dus nas da lta'i bar/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gis—/ /lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas/ /sdig pa mi dge ci bgyis pa/ /ma lus 'gyod pas so sor bshags/ /sban chad ci nus bsdam par bgyi/ /65byed717

rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir sdig pa bshags pa'i yan lag ste gnyis pa'o/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gtugs na/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / /'jig rten pa ni gang gis kyang / /ma lus dge ba ci bgyid pa//de la rang nyid byed pa bas/ /lhag par dga' bas yi rang ngo / /dge ba'i rtsa ba tshegs chung ngus bskyed pa'i phyir rjes su yi rang ba'i yan lag ste gsum pa'o/ /slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /ji ltar sngon gyi skyob rnams kyis//sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir/ /byang chub mchog rab thugs bskyed pa/ /de ltar bdag kyang ma rnams phyir/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub nges par bya ba'i phyir byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i yan lag ste bzhi pa'o/ /mthar dge ba'i rtsa ba gnyis don phun sum tshogs par bya ba'i phyir byang chub mchog tu bsngo ①ba'i yan lag kyang bya ste/ bdag gi ② bsod nams 'di yis ni / /sems can thams cad ma lus pa/ /gdul dka'i sems ni rab zhi nas/ /'gro ba'i bla ma thob par shog /ces bya ba'o/ /chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po shrī dza ga ta mi tā nan+das mdzad pa rdzogs so// //rnal 'byor gyi zhudabang phyug de nyid dang / lo tsā bub byams pa'i dpal gyis bsgyur ba'o// //65—718

717 lamatshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod cing / 〈〈pe 〉〉pa ༄7/ /chos spyod yan lag bzhi pa bzhugs so/ /zhes 'khod/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉pa/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉〉dharmā tsar+ya/718 ①〈〈pe 〉snordzo/ ②〈〈pe 〉྾〈snar 〉stanas/ ①〈〈pe 〉dze〈snar 〉〉wagyi/ du〈〈pe 〉sko〈snar 〉〉yots+tsha/bsdur 'bras re'u migadabu ma/ (160)65—719
